1456.d: Vaade Pärnu maanteelt. Esiplaanil üksik raagus puu ja hekk. Vasakule jääb pildi ülaservaga äralõigatud hoone vaateakendega. Paremal vana linnatorn ning roheliseks värvitud maja nurk.
1456.de: View from Pärnu Road. In the foreground a single bare tree and a hedge. On the left, cut off by the upper edge of the picture, a building with display windows. On the right an old town tower and the corner of a house painted green.

1457.d: Vaade sadamakaile väikeselt laevalt, mille metallosad ja peened vandid on paigutatud esiplaanile vasakul serval ja vasakul all. Paremal äärel valge laeva vöör. Keskplaanil hallikasroheline rahulik veepind, tagaplaanil kai kolme kaubavaguniga ja kahe punakollase kraanaga, tumedate teravatipuliste küngaste taustal. Helesinine taevas.
1457.de: A view of the harbour quay from a small ship, whose metal parts and slender shrouds are placed in the foreground on the left edge and lower left. On the right edge the bow of a white ship. In the middle ground a calm greyish-green water surface, in the background the quay with three freight wagons and two reddish-yellow cranes, against a backdrop of dark, sharp-peaked hills. A light blue sky.

1458.d: Poole pildi pinnast võtab enda alla haljasala, kahe, esiplaani horisontaalse ribana läbiva heki, ümmarguse klumbi ning põõsastega. Paremale ja vasakule jäävad mitmekordsed kivihooned. Vaade avaneb Võidu väljaku suunas.
1458.de: The green area occupies half of the picture's surface, with a hedge running as two horizontal strips across the foreground, a round flowerbed, and bushes. To the right and left are multi-storey stone buildings. The view opens towards Võidu Square.

1459.d: Pildi ülaosas roheline kõrge plankaed. Kahe väravaposti vahel ülalt kaarjas värav, väravapostidel suured kerad. Plangu tagant paistavad puud, värava ees laiadest mustadest ja peenematest värvilistest pintslilöökidest kuhjatis heledal foonil.
1459.de: In the upper part of the picture, a tall green board fence. Between two gate posts, an arched gate above, large spheres on the gate posts. Trees show behind the fence, in front of the gate a mass of broad black and finer coloured brushstrokes on a light background.

1462.d: Esiplaanil rohelise lauapaberiga kaetud pruun kirjutuslaud, millel rohelise klaaskupliga laualamp juhe üle laua stepslisse jooksmas; ümberläinud sinise tindi pott, hall vihik, pruun diagonaalse punase triibuga karp, tumepunane küünal, ülalt avarduvas topsis pintslid. Lauaplaadil paremal värviline õhuline kuhelik. Lambi taga kollane ristkülikukujuline pind. Foon helesinine, valgete, roheliste ja punaste rõngastega.
1462.de: In the foreground a brown writing desk covered with green table paper, on which stands a table lamp with a green glass dome, its cord running across the table to a socket; a spilled blue ink pot, a grey notebook, a brown box with a diagonal red stripe, a dark red candle, brushes in a cup widening at the top. On the right of the tabletop a colourful airy heap. Behind the lamp a yellow rectangular surface. Background light blue, with white, green and red rings.

1463.d: Keskel pruun ümmargune, taevasinist värvi linaga kaetud laud, mille tagumises servas raamatukuhi, kust lookleb alla kollane mõõdulint. Laual vasakul erepunane märkmik. Lauast vasakul koobaltsinine diivan, sein valge, paremas ülanurgas paistab osa maalist. Laua taga toetub vastu seina must pildiraam.
1463.de: In the centre, a round brown table covered with a sky-blue cloth, at its back edge a stack of books from which a yellow tape measure winds down. On the table to the left, a bright red notebook. To the left of the table, a cobalt-blue sofa, the wall white, in the upper right corner part of a painting is visible. Behind the table, a black picture frame leans against the wall.

1474.d: Kollakasroheline lopsakas maastik käharate põõsaste-puudega. Keskel, puude tagant paistavad kraananokad, jupike vett helesinise taeva all. Taimestiku osas pealmine maalikiht kaetud korrapäraste lühikeste rõhtsate pintslitõmmetega.
1474.de: Yellowish-green lush landscape with curly bushes and trees. In the middle, crane beaks visible behind the trees, a patch of water under a light blue sky. In the vegetation area the upper paint layer is covered with regular short horizontal brush strokes.

1475.d: Türkiissinise taeva ja kahe kähara põõsaga suvemaastiku taustal tehiskeskkonnast pärit, omavahel põimuvad, värvilised, kahele poole kõrguvad kuhilad. Detailid enamasti ruumilised: kõverad torud, silindrid, tahvlid, kastid jne.
1475.de: Against the background of a summer landscape with a turquoise-blue sky and two curly bushes, intertwined, colourful heaps originating from an artificial environment, rising to both sides. Details mostly three-dimensional: curved pipes, cylinders, panels, boxes, etc.

1476.d: Läbi valgete ruudukujuliste käepidemetega klaasukse, sinakasrohelistes toonides maastiku taustal sinkjasvalge lauaplaat. Laual pardel, ümbrik, raamat, elektripirn ja värvituub. Kõik maalitud läbipaistvas rohekasvalges gammas, kohati kontuure rõhutades. Klaasukse taga, kahel pool ääres maali ülemises neljandikus rõdu nurki meenutavad kujundid. Taevas elektersinine, pilvevines.
1476.de: Through a glass door with white square-shaped handles, against the background of a landscape in bluish-green tones, a bluish-white tabletop. On the table a razor, an envelope, a book, a light bulb and a tube of paint. All painted in a transparent greenish-white gamut, in places with emphasized contours. Behind the glass door, on both edges in the upper quarter of the painting, shapes reminiscent of the corners of a balcony. The sky electric blue, with hazy clouds.

1477.d: Esiplaanil värviliste kohvrite ja kottidega täidetud transpordikärule toetumas külgvaates noormehe põlvfiguur. Tumedad juuksed, korrapärane kreeka profiil, nägu veidi vaataja poole pööratud. Noormehel seljas helevalge särk mustade pükstega. Mehe parem käsi toetub kõverdatult pakkidele. Fooniks hele, punase käsipuuga lõppev eresinine taevas musta ja valge nelinurgaga.
1477.de: In the foreground, a young man's knee-length figure in profile, leaning on a handcart loaded with colourful suitcases and bags. Dark hair, a regular Greek profile, face turned slightly toward the viewer. The young man wears a bright white shirt with black trousers. The man's right hand rests, bent, on the packages. The background is a bright blue sky ending in a red handrail, with a black and white rectangle.

1478.d: Pilt jaotatud kaheks osaks. Parempoolsel, suuremal osal tehase sisevaade juhtimispuldi, mootorite, juhtmete, torude ja kaitsevõrkudega. Vasakpoolses osas sinisel foonil punaste ja siniste joonte ning kuulikeste kogum, mis mõjub väga ruumiliselt. Domineerib sinine toon, üksikute detailide maalimisel on spektritriipude kombel kasutatud punast, kollast, rohelist, tumelillat. Peamiselt pihustiga maalitud.
1478.de: The picture is divided into two parts. In the larger, right-hand part, an interior view of a factory with a control panel, motors, wires, pipes and protective grilles. In the left-hand part, against a blue background, a cluster of red and blue lines and small balls, which creates a very spatial effect. Blue tone dominates, in painting individual details red, yellow, green and dark purple have been used in the manner of spectral stripes. Mainly painted with a spray gun.

1479.d: Lahtikäristatud roosasse paberisse mähitud pakk, millest paistab intensiivselt sinises toonis teraline mass. Pakk kinni seotud punase paelaga, paki sisse on püsti torgatud neli peenikest varrast.
1479.de: A package wrapped in torn pink paper, from which an intensely blue granular mass is visible. The package is tied shut with a red ribbon, four thin rods are stuck upright into the package.

1482.d: Vaade kahte lagedasse, mahajäetud rohelisse ruumi, mille põrandal lahtimonteeritud radiaatorid ja vasakpoolses ruumis prahti. Aknaavausest vaade oranžile teele ja tribüünile, mille pingid sektorite kaupa eri värvi. Tribüüni taga park kahe puuga teedevahelisel rohuribal. Aknaavavustes mustad ruudud. Rohekas värvigamma.
1482.de: A view of two bare, abandoned green rooms, on the floor of which are dismantled radiators, and in the left-hand room, rubbish. From the window opening a view onto an orange path and a grandstand, whose benches are of different colours by sector. Behind the grandstand a park with two trees on a strip of grass between the paths. Black squares in the window openings. Greenish colour scheme.

1489.d: Heledal taustal vasakul heledapäise vuntsidega noormehe pea, vasak pool varjus. Paremal keskel pliiatsiga markeeritud nuga ja aimatav lõikekaar.
1489.de: On a light background at left, the head of a fair-haired young man with a moustache, the left side in shadow. At centre right, a knife marked with pencil and a suggested cutting arc.

1490.d: Poolelioleva ehitise sisevaade fluorestsentslambi ja juhtmejupiga. Lamp ja juhtmejupp teravustatud, nende taustale jäävad ehitusplokkidest sein ja uksest avanev vaade udused. Toonid külmad, rohekas-sinikad, teostatud osaliselt aerosooltehnikas.
1490.de: Interior view of an unfinished building with a fluorescent lamp and a piece of wire. The lamp and the piece of wire are in focus, while the wall of building blocks and the view opening through the doorway in the background are hazy. Tones cold, greenish-bluish, executed partly in aerosol technique.

1491.d: Interjöörivaade peegli ja punase uksega. Vasakul ümarate nurkade ja esemealusega peegel, millest paistab ukseava riidenagiga ruumi ja pildistaja välgust tekkiv valgussõõr. Punasele uksele kleebitud loodusfoto, ukse kohal ümmargune lamp.
1491.de: Interior view with a mirror and a red door. On the left a mirror with rounded corners and a shelf, in which is reflected a doorway leading to a room with a coat rack and the circle of light created by the photographer's flash. A nature photo glued onto the red door, above the door a round lamp.

1493.d: Heledates toonides topeltportree tagasi vaatava mehega. Kompositsiooni keskmes blondi pintsakus mehe kahekordne poolfiguur: parempoolne välja maalitud näojoonte ja õlaga, vasakpoolne vaid väljamaalitud õlaga. Taustaks kaugusesse ulatuv asfalttee roheliste aasadega mõlemal pool, kogu kompositsioon maalitud osaliselt tasapinnaliselt ja matilt, osaliselt reljeefselt ja emailituna.
1493.de: A double portrait in light tones with a man looking back. At the centre of the composition a double half-figure of a man in a blond jacket: the right one painted out with facial features and shoulder, the left one only painted out with a shoulder. The background is an asphalt road extending into the distance with green meadows on both sides, the whole composition painted partly flat and matte, partly in relief and enamelled.

1495.d: Maali pind jaotatud neljaks erinevas tumedusastmes mustaks pinnaks, millest kolmel keskel kokkupuutuvad nurgad hõõguvpunased.
1495.de: The surface of the painting is divided into four black areas of varying darkness, on three of which the touching corners glow red in the centre.

1500.d: Pildi pind on jaotatud väikesteks hallideks ruutudeks, milles erinevates toonikombinatsioonides sinised, hallid, mustad, valged ja punased kolmnurgad ja ringid.
1500.de: The surface of the picture is divided into small grey squares, in which, in various tonal combinations, there are blue, grey, black, white and red triangles and circles.

1504.d: Süsimustal foonil pildi keskel hõõguv roheline nelinurk.
1504.de: On a jet-black background, a glowing green rectangle in the middle of the picture.

1505.d: Peamiselt roosadest ja sinistest, erinevates suurustes kolmnurkadest koosnev kompositsioon sinisel foonil. Keskel suur must kolmnurk, mille keskel omakorda tilluke valge kolmnurk.
1505.de: A composition consisting mainly of pink and blue triangles of various sizes on a blue background. In the centre a large black triangle, in the centre of which in turn a tiny white triangle.

1508.d: Smaragdrohelisel taustal punastest joontest korrapärane sõrestik, igas ruudus omakorda kolmnurk. Keskosas pool must, pool valge kaldjoon, otstel tume ja hele ring. Ülemise ääre keskel valge, all must ring.
1508.de: On an emerald green background a regular lattice of red lines, in each square in turn a triangle. In the centre part black, part white diagonal line, at the ends a dark and a light circle. At the centre of the upper edge a white, at the bottom a black circle.

1511.d: Värvilistest geomeetrilistest kujunditest koostatud abstraktne kompositsioon: keskel peentest punastest joontest moodustuv ruut, milles samasuguse joonega antud ring ja kolmnurk. All osalt ruutu ulatuv kollane ring, üks segment servas must. Paremal ülemises neljandikus osalt samuti ruutu ulatuv roheline kolmnurk, paremal taevasinine ruut. Üla- ja alaserv mustad. Foonil hall ja valge pind.
1511.de: An abstract composition made up of coloured geometric shapes: in the middle a square formed by thin red lines, in which a circle and a triangle given with the same kind of line. From below a yellow circle reaching into the square, one segment at the edge black. In the upper right quarter a green triangle also partly reaching into the square, on the right a sky-blue square. Upper and lower edges black. Background a grey and white surface.

1514.d: Hallidele üleminekutoonidele rajatud, üksteise sees paiknevatest geomeetrilistest pindadest kompositsioon: helehallil taustal mustjashall ring, selles veidi heledam ruut, milles omakorda veidi heledam võrdkülgne kolmnurk. Kujundeid läbivad vasakult ülalt kolm peent musta paralleelset diagonaaljoont, paremalt ülalt peened vikerkaarevärvilised jooned, joonte ristumiskohad valged.
1514.de: A composition of geometric surfaces nested within one another, built up in grey transitional tones: on a light grey background a blackish-grey circle, within it a slightly lighter square, within which in turn a slightly lighter equilateral triangle. The shapes are crossed from the upper left by three thin parallel black diagonal lines, from the upper right by thin rainbow-coloured lines, the points where the lines cross are white.

1515.d: Lennuvälja maandumis - ja stardirada: vasakul servas keskel lennuk vaataja poole küljega, sabal punane viisnurk ja küljel punane number. Pildi keskel maanduv lennuk, mille sabal samuti viinurk, küljel punane viisnurk ja numer 23. All paremal auk, millest ulatuvad välja kollased torud. Ülaservas helesinine taevas. Hallikassinises üldkoloriidis pilt maalitud kohati väga pastoosse valge värviga.
1515.de: An airfield landing and take-off strip: on the left edge in the middle an aircraft with its side facing the viewer, a red five-pointed star on the tail and a red number on the side. In the centre of the picture a landing aircraft, on whose tail also a five-pointed star, on the side a red five-pointed star and the number 23. Below right a hole, from which yellow pipes protrude. At the top edge a light blue sky. In an overall greyish-blue colouring the picture is painted, at places with very pastose white paint.

1522.d: Altvaade hotelli "Kopli" neoonkirjaga fassaadiosale. keskel reklaam sõnadega: KOPLI, selle all tumedal, fassaadist eenduval alusel: hotell, (sama vene keeles). Ümbritseb liivapruun poollagunenud sein, millel vasakul maja numbrimärk valgustiga selle kohal, osa kaablist. Ülal keskel ja paremal paistab osa avatud aknaist. Kasutatud slaidi. Maalitud beezides, sinkjais toonides pahtli, pulverisaatori, pintsliga kohati väga pastoosselt.
1522.de: Front view of a section of the facade of the hotel "Kopli" with a neon sign. In the middle, an advertisement with the word: KOPLI, below it, on a dark base projecting from the facade: hotell, (the same in Russian). Surrounded by a sandy-brown, half-decayed wall, on which, at left, is the house number plate with a light above it, part of a cable. Above, in the middle and at right, part of open windows is visible. A slide has been used. Painted in beige, bluish tones with putty knife, spray gun, brush, in places very impasto.

2923.d: Rohelistes ja sinistes toonides abstraheeritud maastikuvaade kaherealise maantee ja suitseva korstnaga tööstushoonega taamal. Maantee maalitud pruunis, suits taamal rohelises toonis.
2923.de: An abstracted landscape view in green and blue tones with a two-lane highway and a smoking industrial building in the distance. The highway is painted in brown, the smoke in the distance in a green tone.

2924.d: Sinistes ja pruunides toonides abstraheeritud maastikuvaade kahesuunalise maantee ja suitsevate korstendega tööstushoonetega taamal. Maantee maalitud valges, eraldusriba ja suits pruunides ja maastik sinistes toonides.

2925.d: Heledates ja pruunides toonides abstraheeritud maastikuvaade kahesuunalise maantee ja suitsevate korstendega tööstushoonetega taustal. Maantee maalitud heledates toonides, ümbritsev maastik markeeritud katmata pruuni lõuendiga, taevas helesinine.

2926.d: Kollaažielementidega abstraheeritud maastikuvaade kaherealise maantee ja suitseva korstnaga tööstushoonega taustal. Maantee maalitud heledates toonides, ümbritsev maastik markeeritud mustades toonides ja pruunide kollaažielementidega, taevas hele.

2930.d: Abstraktne linnamotiiv, kus annab aimata majade fassaade ja katuseid ning rohelisi põõsaid ja puid.
2930.de: An abstract urban motif, in which façades and roofs of houses as well as green bushes and trees can be discerned.

3223.d: Baretti kandva vanema mehe üleelusuuruses antud pea kerges pöördes paremale. Mehel prillid, tugev nina, pilk pööratud vaatajale. Mehel seljas avatud kaeluse ja triibulise rinnaesisega särk ning kuub. Paremat õlga varjab osa molbertist. Foon paremal ja ülal sinakasroheline. Maalitud sinistes, veinipunastes ja hallides toonides, kohati pikkade lahtiste pintslilöökidega, kohati pastoosselt.
3223.de: The over-life-size head of an older man wearing a beret, turned slightly to the right. The man has glasses, a strong nose, his gaze directed at the viewer. He wears a shirt with an open collar and striped front, and a jacket. Part of an easel obscures his right shoulder. The background at the right and top is bluish-green. Painted in blue, wine-red and grey tones, at places with long, loose brushstrokes, at places impasto.

3368.d: Põikformaadis lüpsja kaksikportree. Kompositsioon: Maal jaotatud kolmeks. 2/3 pildi pinnast kujutab külgvaates kükitavat valge kitliga ja mütsiga lüpsjat (pildi keskel) lüpsimasinat lehmale seadmas. Pildi vasemal pool lüpsja ees lehm, tagant vaates. 1/3 maalist jaotatud helerohelise raamiga pooleks. Ülal L.Peipsi poolprofiilis näoportree.  All aasta 1976 ja numbrid 5323 511 T.  Maalitud realistlikus laadis, pruunides, rohelistes toonides. Maali keskne osa (lüpsja) valge, hele roosakas, sinakas hallid toonid. (eesti)
3368.de: A double portrait of a milkmaid in horizontal format. Composition: The painting is divided into three parts. 2/3 of the picture surface depicts, in profile, a milkmaid crouching (in the centre of the picture) in a white smock and cap, setting a milking machine on a cow. On the left side of the picture, in front of the milkmaid, a cow, seen from behind. 1/3 of the painting is divided in half by a light green frame. Above, a semi-profile face portrait of L. Peips. Below, the year 1976 and the numbers 5323 511 T. Painted in a realistic manner, in brown and green tones. The central part of the painting (the milkmaid) in white, light pinkish, bluish-grey tones.

3369.dm: kõrgus: 81.0 cm (koos raamiga); laius: 92.0 cm; kõrgus: 73.0 cm; laius: 100.0 cm (koos raamiga)
3369.d: Maastkumaal - Järvemaal sooja lillakas- kollakas koloriidis keskne koht- Järv pildi keskel- läbiv - tume lillas toonis. Silmapiiril - taamal lillades toonides metsatukad. Esiplaanil paremal metsatukad. Esiplaanil paremal mürkroheline roosa katusega maja, kõrge korstnaga. Pildi keskel all kaks kuuske kõrvuti. Maalitud üldistatult, ilma oluliste detailideta.(eesti)
3369.de: A landscape painting - Lake District - in a warm lilac-yellowish colouring, a central place - a lake in the middle of the picture, running through - in a dark lilac tone. On the horizon - in the distance, clumps of forest in lilac tones. In the foreground on the right, clumps of forest. In the foreground on the right, a poison-green house with a pink roof and a tall chimney. In the middle of the picture at the bottom, two spruces side by side. Painted in a generalised manner, without significant detail.

3370.dm: laius: 73.0 cm (koos raamiga); kõrgus: 89.0 cm (koos raamiga)
3370.d: Maastikumaal- järvemaal, kujutatud lossimäge ja Viljandi järve- mõlemat, raamivad kogu maali. Vasakul lossimäe külg, paremal intensiivses sinises toonis järve tipp ja nende vahel puude ja majade grupp. Vasakul ülal intensiivsete siniste toonidega taevas, koloriidilt kirju: oranzides kollastes sügistoonides.(eesti)
3370.de: A landscape painting – a lake view, depicting the Castle Hill and Lake Viljandi – both framing the whole painting. On the left the side of the Castle Hill, on the right the tip of the lake in an intense blue tone, and between them a group of trees and houses. Above on the left, a sky in intense blue tones, varied in colouring: in orange, yellow autumn tones.

3371.d: Lillemaal - kujutab hoogsate pintslilöökide ja erksate värvidega kolme sorti lillebuketti vaasides. Pool maali ülemist pinda kujutab kollastes, oranžides toonides kullerkuppude buketti, mille õied laiuvad üle kogu ülemise maalipinna. Pildi keskel väike hele vaas siniste meelespeadega, all paremal roosakad-lillad lilled. Maali foon (alumine osa) lahendatud abstraktsete vana-roosa, sinakasrohelise ja tumepruunide värvipindadega.(eesti)
3371.de: Flower painting - depicts, with bold brushstrokes and vivid colours, three kinds of flower bouquets in vases. Half of the upper surface of the painting shows, in yellow and orange tones, a bouquet of globeflowers, whose blossoms spread over the entire upper painting surface. In the centre of the picture a small light-coloured vase with blue forget-me-nots, at the bottom right pinkish-purple flowers. The background (lower part) of the painting is rendered with abstract surfaces of old-rose, bluish-green and dark brown colour.

3372.d: Püstformaadis poolabstraktne helehallides pruunides rohelistes toonides segatehnikast tulenevalt kohati krobulise faktuuriga maal. Kujutatud tormist räsitud pooleks murdunud kännukujulist puutüve, mis nagu pildi alumisest osast välja kasvab. Maaliliselt - stiiliselt lahendatud(kännuront) kubistlikus geomeetrilises laadis. Maali taust jagatud kolmeks: hall, pruun, hall.(eesti)
3372.de: A vertically formatted, semi-abstract painting in light grey, brown and green tones, with a surface that is in places rough in texture due to the mixed technique used. Depicted is a storm-battered, split tree trunk resembling a tree stump, which seems to grow out of the lower part of the picture. Pictorially and stylistically the (stump-shape) is treated in a cubist, geometric manner. The background of the painting is divided into three parts: grey, brown, grey.

3789.d: Keskosa: Keskel laulvad inimfiguurid ja istuv ema lapsega. Külgedel seisvad figuurid.
3789.de: Central part: In the middle singing human figures and a seated mother with a child. Standing figures on the sides.

3791.d: Pindadesse jaotatud foonil habemega mehe rinnaportree. Kontuurid rõhutatud, maalitud pruunikas gammas, kuub punane. Raam must.
3791.de: Bust portrait of a bearded man against a background divided into planes. Contours emphasised, painted in a brownish gamut, coat red. Frame black.

3792.d: Maali keskplaanil stiliseeritud puudevormid, vertikaalsed jooned rõhutavad kõrgust, värvid loovad mulje sügisest. Tagaplaanil sinetab veepind.
3792.de: In the middle ground of the painting, stylised tree forms, vertical lines emphasising height, colours creating an impression of autumn. In the background a bluish water surface.

3793.d: Kogu pildi pinna täidab suur sinine sõõr. Sõõri keskel pikas valges rüüs naisefiguur, parem käsi rinna kõrgusele tõstetud. Tema kohal kosmonauti kujutav horisontaalis olev figuur. Ülejäänud osal sõõri pinnast kujutatud inimesi mitmesuguste tegevuste juures.
3793.de: The whole surface of the picture is filled with a large blue circle. In the centre of the circle a female figure in a long white robe, right hand raised to chest height. Above her a horizontal figure depicting a cosmonaut. On the remaining surface of the circle, people are depicted engaged in various activities.

3798.d: Grupid teatrimaskide ja butafooria hulgas. Kompositsiooni vasakul kollakasvalge pind kitsa musta vertikaalliistuga vasakul serval, allääres inimmass. Mustal ja pruunikal foonil paremal ees kaks baleriini suure butafoorse moodustise taustal, mille peal asetsevad kaks maski ja millele kuldlõikes ronib redeliga puhvpükstes mees.
3798.de: Groups among theatre masks and stage props. On the left of the composition a yellowish-white surface with a narrow black vertical batten on its left edge, at the bottom edge a mass of people. Against a black and brownish background, in the foreground on the right two ballerinas in front of a large prop structure, on top of which sit two masks, and on which, in golden-section position, a man in puffed breeches climbs a ladder.

3800.d: Perspektiiviliste "vigadega" tasapinnalisust toonitav, erinevate esemete suhtes mitmest erinevast kõrgusest jälgitud natüürmort tihedalt asetatud esemetest ebakorrapäraselt paigutatud geomeetriliste värvipindadega foonil ning ebakorrapärase liigendatud kujuga geometriseeritud, erinevates värvitoonides alusel. Ees keksel nelinurkse, voolavates vormides sügavas anumas kaks punast puuvilja. Selle taga vasakul vanaaegne käsikohviveski, paremal kõrge idamaine kann peene pika püstjase tilaga. Selle foonil ülal värvilinebukett lilledest ja lehtedest. Laual vasakul all murelioks lehtede ja oranžikate-punakate marjadega.
3800.de: A still life emphasising flatness through perspectival "errors", with closely placed objects viewed from several different heights in relation to different objects, set against a background of irregularly arranged geometric colour planes and on an irregularly articulated, geometricised base in various colour tones. In front, in the middle, two red fruits in a deep quadrangular vessel of flowing forms. Behind it on the left an old-fashioned hand coffee grinder, on the right a tall oriental jug with a thin, upright spout. Above, against this background, a colourful bouquet of flowers and leaves. On the table, lower left, a branch of mahaleb cherry with leaves and orangish-reddish berries.

3801.d: Vasak tiib: keskel valges sportlikus riietuses noormehe täisfiguur pea kohale tõstetud kettaga (keskel sini-valge maakera sümbol, servas tekst KOGU MAAILMA NOORED). Tagaplaanil sammastik, ees all neegritar lilledega, sombreeroga ladinaameeriklane, kitarri mängiv pikkade juustega neiu.
3801.de: Left wing: in the centre the full figure of a young man in white sportswear with a discus raised above his head (in the centre a blue-and-white globe symbol, on the rim the text KOGU MAAILMA NOORED [YOUTH OF THE WHOLE WORLD]). In the background a colonnade, in front below a black woman with flowers, a Latin American man with a sombrero, a girl with long hair playing a guitar.

3805.d: Vasakul ühtlasel, heledal, rohekashallil pinnal tumedas ruudus akna motiiv. Paremal pruunikashall pind. Nende vahel punastes, sinistes, valkjates ning pruunides toonides abstraktsetest pindadest kompositsioon, millest kerkivad esile: all servas vuntsidega mehe rinnafiguur, sellest paremal vanema naise nägu ja ülal noore naise täisfiguur. Maalipind kergelt fraktuurne.
3805.de: On the left, on an even, light, greenish-grey surface, a window motif in a dark square. On the right, a brownish-grey surface. Between them a composition of abstract surfaces in red, blue, whitish and brown tones, out of which emerge: at the bottom edge the chest figure of a moustached man, to the right of it the face of an older woman, and above the full figure of a young woman. The paint surface is slightly fractured.

3806.d: Pruunides-valkjates toonides geomeetrilistest pindadest ja inimfiguuridest kompositsioon. Kesksel kohal sinises lühikeses seelikus, last süleskandva naise figuur. Kontuurid rõhutatud.
3806.de: Composition of geometric surfaces and human figures in brown-whitish tones. In the centre a figure of a woman in a short blue skirt carrying a child in her arms. Contours emphasised.

3807.d: Ees- ja keskplaanil kergelt geometriseeriva joonega maalitud kuus poolfiguuri. Taamal rohekal merepinnal sinise nelinurkse pinnaga eraldatud valge laeva kujutis
3807.de: In the foreground and middle ground, six half-figures painted with a slightly geometricising line. Further back, on a greenish sea surface, the image of a white ship separated by a blue rectangular area.

3814.d: Figuraalne kompositsioon, mille keskel frontaalselt grupp naisi, teine grupp neist paremal trepiga hoone taustal, millel paistab säravvalgete hammastega groteskne pea. Hoonest vasakul jupp maastikku ja noormees neiuga seismas kohvri kõrval platvormil. Vasakul servas, joonega muust kompositsioonist eraldatud 3 figuuri, üks neist lõõtspilliga, maastiku taustal.
3814.de: A figural composition, in the centre of which a group of women frontally, a second group of them on the right against the background of a building with a staircase, on which a grotesque head with brightly white teeth can be seen. To the left of the building, a piece of landscape and a young man with a girl standing next to a suitcase on a platform. On the left edge, separated from the rest of the composition by a line, 3 figures, one of them with an accordion, against a landscape background.

3815.d: Vasakul tellingutes torniga Niguliste kirik, keskel kraana kollase kabiiniga, selle taga "Viru" hotelli risttahukakujuline hoone. Esiplaanil müüri taustal kollane teerull ja jupp punase-kollasekirjut piirdeaeda. Foonil sinine taevas kandiliselt antud valgete pilvedega. Domineerivad summutatud hallid, rohelised, sinised toonid. Pildil struktuuri rõhutav maalimisviis.
3815.de: On the left, St. Nicholas' Church with its tower in scaffolding, in the middle a crane with a yellow cabin, behind it the cuboid building of the "Viru" hotel. In the foreground, against a wall backdrop, a yellow road roller and a piece of a red-and-yellow patterned fence. In the background a blue sky rendered in an angular manner with white clouds. Muted grey, green and blue tones dominate. The painting emphasises structure in its manner of execution.

3851.d: Hallil foonil väga tinglikud pruunikates ja hallikates toonides figuurid.
3851.de: Against a grey background very conventionalised figures in brownish and greyish tones.

3861.d: Beežika taeva ja pruunides toonides maastiku taustal, pildi keskel rohekatest, pruunidest, valgetest ning oranžidest pindadest ja joontest moodustuv kolmefiguuriline grupp.
3861.de: Against a beige sky and a landscape in brown tones, in the middle of the picture a three-figure group formed of greenish, brown, white and orange planes and lines.

3862.d: Kollasel taustal, sinistest, rohelistest ja punastest pindadest moodustuv fantastiliste, abstraktsete figuuride grupp. Nende keskel kaks inimfiguuri, parempoolsel pea kallutatud paremale.
3862.de: On a yellow background, a group of fantastical, abstract figures formed from blue, green and red surfaces. Among them two human figures, the one on the right with its head tilted to the right.

3863.d: Rohekas-pruunil foonil sinistest, mustadest ja valkjatest joontest ning pindadest kompositsioon. Kompositsiooni ülemises pooles ülekaalus tumedad toonid, allosas heledad.
3863.de: A composition of blue, black and whitish lines and surfaces on a greenish-brown background. Dark tones predominate in the upper half of the composition, light tones in the lower part.

3864.d: Kolm pikaksvenitatud, tugevasti stiliseeritud figuuri heledal foonil.
3864.de: Three elongated, strongly stylised figures on a light background.

3866.d: Vana naine ja mees kartuleid koorimas. Naine paremal pool profiilis, valges rätis, punakas seelikus. Kartulikauss kahe vahel taburetil. Kogu maal tumedates pruunides toonides, valgus helendab kartulitel ja pearätil.
3866.de: An old woman and man peeling potatoes. The woman on the right in profile, in a white headscarf, reddish skirt. A bowl of potatoes on a stool between them. The whole painting in dark brown tones, light gleaming on the potatoes and the headscarf.

3869.de: Against a coloured background, light-coloured, various irregular shapes.

3870.de: On a light background, a dark, irregular shape. On it whitish, blue, red formations.

3899.d: Erinevatest geomeetrilistest pindadest abstraktne kompositsioon: horisontaalsel keskteljel punane ja roosa triip, millest vasakule alla suunduvad punased ja kollased triibud. Triipudel sinise triibuga ääristatud seest punase-kollasetriibulised ja siniste laikudega pinnad. Paremas ülemises nurgas punase laubapaelaga profiilis indiaanlane, kellest vasemal suure halli laigu sees punakas laik. All paremal neljakandiline, seest labürindijoontega kaetud kujund.
3899.de: An abstract composition of various geometric surfaces: on the horizontal central axis a red and pink stripe, from which red and yellow stripes descend to the left. On the stripes, surfaces bordered by a blue stripe, striped red-yellow inside with blue spots. In the upper right corner, an Indian in profile with a red headband, to his left a reddish spot within a large grey spot. Below on the right a quadrangular figure filled inside with labyrinth lines.

Paremal alumises nurgas kolm märkidega kaetud roosat ketast, viimaste all kollakashallid ja sinised triibud ja sõna - DOORKEEPER

On the left, against a pink background, two discs covered with geometric shapes. In the lower right corner three pink discs covered with symbols, below the latter yellowish-grey and blue stripes and the word - DOORKEEPER

3901.de: On the left a reddish-pink door covered with patches of green and yellow tones, with a dark pink handle ending in a metal knob. To the right of the door, at the edge, a mainly yellow disc against a lighter pink background.

3904.de: View of the Ponte Vecchio bridge in Florence, with jewelry shops. In the background the dome of the Santa Maria del Fiore cathedral, in the foreground people in a mixture of historical and modern clothing. On the right the emblem of the goldsmiths' guild made by Lucca Della Robbia

3910.d: Erkrohelisel ja kollasel foonil värvilised laigud ja geomeetrilised kujundid. Kollasel, lisaks kujundile, mustade joonte rägastik.
3910.de: Coloured patches and geometric shapes on a bright green and yellow background. On the yellow, in addition to the shape, a tangle of black lines.

3911.d: Marmoritaolisel roosakasoranžil foonil keskel neli suurt abstraktset kujundit, milles igas oma värviliste geomeetriliste kujundite süsteem.
3911.de: On a marble-like pinkish-orange background, four large abstract shapes in the centre, each containing its own system of coloured geometric shapes.

3912.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon, mille keskosas üks poolik ja üks terve roosa ring (otsekui aastaringidega kaetud). Ülaservas paremal osa vikerkaarest. Piki paremat serva hallikaslilla triip, ülalt heledam, alt tumedam. Üle pildi pinna otsekui suurendatud jäälilled, millest paistab läbi roosa, tumesinine ja kollakas foon.
3912.de: An abstract composition, in the middle part of which one half and one whole pink circle (as if covered with annual rings). At the top right part of a rainbow. Along the right edge a greyish-purple stripe, lighter at the top, darker at the bottom. Across the surface of the picture as if enlarged frost flowers, through which a pink, dark blue and yellowish background shows.

3913.d: Suurtest värvilistest kujunditest koosnev kompositsioon: keskosas ülalt alla kollakas, servades heleroheline pind. Kollasel ja rohelisel foonil kirjud ja triibulised geomeetrilised kujundid.
3913.de: A composition consisting of large coloured shapes: in the central part a yellowish surface from top to bottom, light green surface at the edges. On the yellow and green background, mottled and striped geometric shapes.

3914.d: Värviline abstraktne kompositsioon: ülal vasakul ja vertikaalteljel kahvatukollane pind. All vasakul kirev abstraktsete kujunditega pind, domineeriva ringi kujundiga. Paremal mitme erineva abstraktsete kujundite süsteemi vööndid.
3914.de: Colourful abstract composition: upper left and on the vertical axis a pale yellow surface. Lower left a colourful surface with abstract shapes, with a dominant circle shape. On the right, zones of several different systems of abstract shapes.

3916.d: Erksates värvides abstraktne kompositsioon: allosas keskel roheline, otsekui sügavusse suunduv silmapiiril ahenev pind, kollakasrohelised triibud kahel pool koonduvad samas suunas. Keskel neljakandiline ümarate nurkadega kujund peamiselt roosades, rohelistes ja kollastes toonides. Kujundi foon on roosakaspunane, roheliste ja kollaste suurte laikudega kahel pool. Ülaosas peamiselt sinistes ja punastes toonides abstraktsete kujundite süsteem.
3916.de: An abstract composition in bright colours: at the bottom centre, a green surface that seems to recede into depth, narrowing toward the horizon, with yellowish-green stripes converging in the same direction on both sides. In the centre, a quadrangular shape with rounded corners, mainly in pink, green and yellow tones. The background of the shape is pinkish-red, with large green and yellow patches on both sides. In the upper part, a system of abstract shapes mainly in blue and red tones.

4181.d: Hallikal foonil klaasnõus õrnas kollases ning roosas toonis ja valged, peene joonega antud orhideed.
4181.de: On a greyish background, in a glass vessel, orchids in delicate yellow and pink tones and white, rendered with fine lines.

4182.d: Heledal foonil pildil paremas ääres valges sviitris, heledajuukselise, poisipeaga, prillidega noore naise poolfiguur; poolpöördes vasakule, kergelt ette kummardunud.
4182.de: On a light background, in the right edge of the picture, half-figure of a young woman with light hair, a boyish haircut and glasses, in a white sweater; in a half-turn to the left, slightly bent forward.

4184.d: Keskel suur anum punaste ja kollakas-punaste tulpidega, sellest paremal vaas nartsissidega. Esiplaanil all paremal klaasvaas punaste, kollaste ja roosade krüsanteemidega. Vasakul esiplaanil plekknõu punaste tulpidega, tagaplaanil vasakul kollased ja valged nartsissid, nende taga valged kallad. Fooniks valkjashall toasein aknaga ülal paremal.
4184.de: In the centre a large vessel with red and yellowish-red tulips, to its right a vase with narcissi. In the foreground below on the right a glass vase with red, yellow and pink chrysanthemums. On the left in the foreground a tin vessel with red tulips, in the background on the left yellow and white narcissi, behind them white calla lilies. Background of a whitish-gray interior wall with a window above on the right.

4185.d: Ülakehaga en-face, pea poolprofiilis vasemale kollakate juuste, habeme ja vuntsidega noormehe portree rohelisel foonil. Peen, veidi kongus nina, heledate silmade terav pilk, tugevad madalad kulmukaared heledate väikeste kulmudega.
4185.de: Portrait of a young man en-face from the upper body, head in half-profile to the left, with yellowish hair, beard and moustache, on a green background. A fine, slightly hooked nose, a sharp gaze of light eyes, strong low brow arches with light small eyebrows.

4186.d: Muhu lillelise vaiba foonil otsevaates väikese poisi rinnaportree. Seljas hele kampsun, mille alt paistab sinine särgikaelus.
4186.de: Frontal chest portrait of a small boy against the background of a Muhu floral carpet. Wearing a light-coloured jumper, from under which a blue shirt collar shows.

4187.d: Lähivaates fragment inimhulgast: osa nägudest otsevaates, osa profiilis, allservas üks pea kukla poolt. Mõned naisenäod ilmselt portreeliselt antud: all vasakul prillidega, pikkade heledate juustega ja pearätikuga. Kompositsiooni keskpunktis heledapäine lühikeste juuste ja sirge ninaga naine, parem käsi rinna kohale tõstetud. Domineerivad sinised ja kollakasrohelised toonid.
4187.de: Close-up view of a fragment of a crowd of people: some faces frontal, some in profile, at the lower edge one head seen from the back. Some women's faces apparently given as portraits: at lower left a woman with glasses, long light hair and a headscarf. At the centre of the composition a fair-haired woman with short hair and a straight nose, right hand raised to chest level. Blue and yellowish-green tones dominate.

4201.d: Üks üldine rahva pidupäev (olustikumaal), 1971. Stiliseeritud paljufiguuriline kompositsioon laulu- ja tantsupeost, mille esiplaanil on uhke puhkpilliorkester, neist natuke tagapool rahvatantsurühmi ja päris kaugel, laulukaare all lauljaid. Üle lageda maa avaneb vaade Tallinna lahele, kus seilavad uhked täispurjeis laevad, ning tornitippudega palistatud Tallinna linnale. Maali koloriit on pidupäevale kohaselt erk ja rõõmus. /tekst Liisi Aibel, 2013/
4201.de: A general festive day of the people (genre painting), 1971. A stylised multi-figure composition of a song and dance festival, in the foreground of which is a magnificent brass band, somewhat behind them folk dance groups, and quite far away, singers under the song festival arch. Over the open ground a view opens onto Tallinn Bay, where magnificent full-sailed ships are sailing, and onto the city of Tallinn lined with tower spires. The colouring of the painting is bright and joyful, as befits a festive day. /text by Liisi Aibel, 2013/

4363.de: The picture depicts collapsing old-town buildings and motifs with crumbling stairs in light-dark gray tones. In addition, above them ornaments composed of ribbons fluttering in the air.

4364.de: The picture depicts the roofs, stairs, and towers of the old town. In the middle a house with a weathervane. In addition, above them, ornaments composed of ribbons fluttering in the air.

4366.de: The picture depicts the Tallinn Town Hall in light-dark brownish tones. Additionally the sky and ornaments consisting of ribbons fluttering on the town hall roof.

4367.dm: kõrgus: 14.2 cm (pilt   ); laius: 18.2 cm; laius: 12.2 cm (pilt   ); kõrgus: 31.5 cm
4367.d: Pildil kujutatud mitmeid linnamüüri torne, tagaplaanil uuslinn. Lisaks taevas tornide taustal lill- ja väätornamendid, tornidel lehvivatest lintidest koosnevad ornamendid.
4367.de: The picture depicts several towers of the city wall, with the new town in the background. In addition, in the sky behind the towers floral and vine ornaments, and on the towers ornaments made of fluttering ribbons.

4368.dm: kõrgus: 14.0 cm (pilt   ); laius: 18.0 cm; laius: 12.3 cm (pilt   ); kõrgus: 31.7 cm
4368.d: Pildil kujutatud linnamüüri ja torne mustjas-hallides toonides. Lisaks taevas lillornament, tornidel lehvimas lintornament. Torni taustal puud.
4368.de: The painting depicts a city wall and towers in blackish-grey tones. In addition, a floral ornament in the sky, a ribbon ornament fluttering on the towers. Trees in the background of the tower.

4373.d: Neiud tumedal pruunil taustal, mida ümbritseb triibuline ümarkaar. Kolm piigat istuvad kolme voki taga. Neiud rahvariietes - põlledes, laiatriibulised seelikud, peas võrud, millel taga lindid.
4373.de: Maidens against a dark brown background, surrounded by a striped arch. Three maidens sit behind three spinning wheels. The maidens are in folk costume - in aprons, wide-striped skirts, on their heads wreaths with ribbons at the back.

4374.d: Pildil üleval triibuline ümarkaar (2 tükki). Pilt rohelistes toonides. Keskel uppuv neiu, juuksed laiali, jalad ülespidi. neiul seljas rahvariided. Ümberringi vesikuppude lehed ja teised veetaimed. Ümber ujuvad kalad.
4374.de: In the upper part of the picture a striped semicircular arc (2 pieces). The picture in green tones. In the centre a drowning maiden, hair spread out, legs upturned. The maiden is wearing folk costume. Around her leaves of water lilies and other water plants. Fish swimming around.

4375.d: Pildil valgel taustal ratsahobusel kuningapoeg, peas kroon. Ratsul kaunistustega sadul. Paremal osa kuningalossist ja tarast. Aia sees rohelised puud. Pildil üleval triibuline ümarkaar.
4375.de: In the picture on a white background a king's son on horseback, wearing a crown. The horse has a decorated saddle. On the right part of a royal castle and a fence. Inside the fence green trees. At the top of the picture a striped arch.

4376.d: Ümarkaarelise ja triibulise võlvi all, pildil paremal, istuvad vana kuningapaar ja noored. Kuningapoeg seisab ja neiu istub. Vana kuningapaar rahvariietes. Kuninganna peas punane, rohelise kaunistusega müts, rinnas sõlg, seljas triipudega seelik, valge põll, kaelas rätik. Kuningas pikas kuues, mis seotud triibulise vööga, peas kroon. Neiul triipudega seelik, peas pärg, kaelas helmed. Kuningapojal peas kroon, üle õla heidetud triibuline sall ja hoiab neiul käest kinni.
4376.de: Under a round-arched and striped vault, on the right of the picture, an old royal couple and young people are seated. The king's son stands and a maiden sits. The old royal couple are in folk costume. The queen has on her head a red cap with green trim, a brooch on her breast, a striped skirt, a white apron, and a kerchief around her neck. The king wears a long coat tied with a striped belt, and a crown on his head. The maiden has a striped skirt, a wreath on her head, and beads around her neck. The king's son has a crown on his head, a striped shawl thrown over his shoulder, and holds the maiden by the hand.

4424.d: Vasakule sammuvate inimeste grupp punase lipu all. Paremal jooksva lapse figuur.
4424.de: Group of people striding to the left under a red flag. On the right the figure of a running child.

4427.d: Pildi keskel kollasel alusel lühikese varrega metallist nõu, millele üksteise otsa kuhjatud pirnid. Sellest paremale jääb kaanega nõu ning vasakule silindrikujuline toos. Taustaks ikoon.
4427.de: In the centre of the picture, on a yellow base, a short-handled metal vessel, on which pears are heaped one upon another. To the right of it is a vessel with a lid and to the left a cylindrical box. Background an icon.

4430.d: Rohelisele murule laotatud valgel linal samovar, nõusid ja leivapätse. Paremal istub naine, laps süles. Taga palkidest madal talumaja, mille tumedal ukseaval figuur. Maja ees pingil korv marjadega. Pildiservadel palkseinad ja talad.
4430.de: On a white cloth spread on green grass a samovar, dishes and loaves of bread. On the right a woman sits with a child on her lap. Behind, a low log farmhouse with a figure in its dark doorway. In front of the house a basket of berries on a bench. Log walls and beams at the edges of the picture.

4434.d: Ees keskel vasknõu punaste õuntega, sellest paremal ja vasakul kaks etnograafilist eset. Tagaplaanil kolm ikooni. Neist keskmisel kujutatud stseen Kristuse elust (Templisse toomine).
4434.de: In the front center a copper vessel with red apples, to its right and left two ethnographic objects. In the background three icons. The middle one depicts a scene from the life of Christ (Presentation at the Temple).

4435.d: Viiefiguuriline kompositsioon. Vasakul, rohelise palktare foonil profiilis paremale valgesse riietatud neiu broshüüriga käes. Paremal äärel õlgadele heidetud pintsakuga lokkispäine noormees poolprofiilis vasemale.Foonika künklik maastik majade ja heinasaadusega. Suured sõõrjad, kohati figuure toonivad värvipinnad kompositsiooni keskel.
4435.de: A five-figure composition. On the left, against the background of a green log house, a girl in profile facing right, dressed in white, with a brochure in her hand. On the right edge a curly-haired young man with a jacket thrown over his shoulders, in half-profile to the left. The background a hilly landscape with houses and haystacks. Large round colour planes, in places toning the figures, in the centre of the composition.

4436.d: Valge laudlinaga ümmargusel laual kaks koonilise kujuga vaskkannu, nende vahel tagaplaanil mandlitega täidetud metallnõu, esiplaanil vasakus kuldlõikes suur kollane, kahe rohelise lehega aivaa.
4436.de: On a round table with a white tablecloth two cone-shaped copper jugs, between them in the background a metal vessel filled with almonds, in the foreground in the golden section on the left a large yellow pineapple with two green leaves.

4437.d: Vasakus servas allpool väga väikesed värvikihi varingud ja üksikud peened kriimustusjäljed.
4437.de: In the lower left edge, very small losses of paint layer and a few fine scratch marks.

4438.d: Esiplaanil mitmes kujus leivapätse, millede kohalt tõuseb triibuna taeva poole heledus, kus kombainide siluette, üleval pilvemoodustusi; paremal ja vasemal kollakas läbipaistev heledus sümboliseerimaks viljapõlde, taevas hallsinine.
4438.de: In the foreground several shapes of loaves of bread, above which rises a strip of brightness towards the sky, with silhouettes of combine harvesters, cloud formations above; on the right and left a yellowish transparent brightness symbolising grain fields, the sky grey-blue.

4439.d: Ümaral laual kaks pruuni, koonilise kujuga kannu. Nende ees kollane puuvili, vasakul suur arbuus, millest on sektor välja lõigatud ning asetseb viimase ees. Vasakul osa aknast, millest avaneb vaade kollakas-rohelistes toonides maastikule. Aknalaual kaks kolletanud puulehte.
4439.de: On a round table two brown, conically shaped jugs. In front of them a yellow fruit, on the left a large watermelon, from which a section has been cut out and placed in front of it. On the left part of a window, from which a view opens onto a landscape in yellowish-green tones. On the windowsill two yellowed leaves.

4440.d: Aknalaual pruun kann punakaspruunides toonides heinakõrte ja punaste kuivanud hiina laternatega. Tagaplaanil paistab läbi aknaklaasi kolletanud rohuväli ähmaste puudega ja tuhmsinise taevaga.
4440.de: On a windowsill a brown jug in reddish-brown tones with straws of hay and red dried Chinese lanterns. In the background, through the windowpane, a yellowed meadow with hazy trees and a dull blue sky is visible.

4441.d: Alusraamil ülal punasega: autori nimi, töö nimetus, mõõdud, daatum ja tehnika. Samas vasakus nurgas KF lipik.
4441.de: On the stretcher, above, in red: the author's name, the title of the work, measurements, date and technique. In the same, left corner a KF label.

4443.d: Esiplaanil oranzikaskollase pinnana viljapõld. Taamal kõrgendik puudesaluga.
4443.de: In the foreground, a grain field as an orange-yellowish surface. In the distance, an elevation with a grove of trees.

4444.d: Esiplaanil nukrailmeline pikas rohekashallis kleidis naine, tume rätik tihedalt ümber pea seotud. Vasakus käes peene kaelaga hele kann, mis toetub servapidi ookrikarvalisele puupingile. Vasakul, naise selja taga, linaga kaetud laud, paremal maja piirjooned. Maja ees kõveraks kooldunud, vähese rohelusega puu. Kannuga pingi ees maas mõned puuviljad.
4444.de: In the foreground, a woman with a mournful expression in a long greenish-grey dress, a dark shawl tightly wrapped around her head. In her left hand a light-coloured jug with a slender neck, resting by its rim on an ochre-coloured wooden bench. On the left, behind the woman's back, a table covered with linen, on the right the outlines of a house. In front of the house, a tree bent into a curve, with sparse foliage. On the ground in front of the bench with the jug, some fruit.

4445.d: Roosa linaga kaetud, ümberpööratud perspektiivis antud laual ümmargune metallkandik kolme suure kollase ning kolme väikese punase puuviljaga. Kollased puuviljad peegelduvad kandiku metalselt pinnalt. Kandiku taga samuti metallist elegantse joonega kann, millel nupuga kaas. Foon sinakaslillades toonides, pintslitööd selgelt paista laskev.
4445.de: On a table covered with a pink cloth, rendered in inverted perspective, a round metal tray with three large yellow and three small red fruits. The yellow fruits are reflected on the metal surface of the tray. Behind the tray also a metal jug with an elegant line, with a knobbed lid. Background in bluish-lilac tones, the brushwork clearly showing through.

4449.d: Esiplaanil hele korv hiina laternate teiste kuivatatud viljade ning kõrtega oranzikas-kollastes toonides. Korvi fooniks püsti asetatud must, laineliste servade ja maalitud lilledega kandik. Paremal kitsas riba akent. Foon ja esemete alus hall.
4449.de: In the foreground a light-coloured basket with Chinese lanterns and other dried fruits and stalks in orangey-yellow tones. The background of the basket is a black tray with wavy edges and painted flowers, standing upright. On the right a narrow strip of window. The background and the base of the objects are grey.

4450.d: Esiplaanil keskel kunstiteadlase Mai Levini poolfiguurportree; seljas hele pluus ja rinna kohale tõstetud kätes helesinine sall. Pea pisut vasakule pööratud, lõug tõstetud, näo parempoolsele osale langeb hele valgus. Figuuri taga foonil upakil sambaid, paremal osa arkaadist, vasakul kapiteeliga antiikne sammas ja peata antiikskulptuur. Foonil vasakul värvilistes rõivastes grupp inimesi sammumas silmapiiril asuva antiiktempli varemete suunas. Hele, pastelne värvigamma.
4450.de: In the foreground, centre, a half-length portrait of the art historian Mai Levin; she wears a light blouse and holds a light-blue shawl in her hands, raised to her chest. Her head is turned slightly to the left, her chin raised, and bright light falls on the right side of her face. Behind the figure, in the background, leaning columns, on the right part of an arcade, on the left an antique column with a capital and a headless antique sculpture. In the background on the left, a group of people in colourful clothing walking towards the ruins of an antique temple on the horizon. Light, pastel colour range.

4454.d: Esiplaanilt paremast nurgast vasakule pildi sügavusse suunduv uus halli teekattega tee. Teeservas betoonist kanalisatsioonitorud ja punased piirdevaiad. Teest vasakul ja paremal puid ja põõsaid, mille lehekroon õhukeselt, skitseerivalt maalitud. Taamal, tee kohal heledate viilkatustega majadekobar. Ülal rohekashall taevas. Maalitud kahvatutes rohelistes, hallides ja roosades toonides.
4454.de: A new road with a grey road surface running from the right corner of the foreground to the left, into the depth of the picture. At the roadside, concrete sewage pipes and red boundary posts. To the left and right of the road, trees and bushes whose foliage is painted thinly, sketchily. In the distance, above the road, a cluster of houses with light-coloured gable roofs. Above, a greenish-grey sky. Painted in pale green, grey and pink tones.

4460.d: Pikkade blondide juustega tütarlapse nägu poolprofiilis vasakule, kitsas sirge nina, kitsas teravajooneline suu. Seljas tumeroheline jakk ja pruun pluus. Foonil suvine maastik heinaküüniga vasakus servas ja helesinine õrnade pilvedega taevas.
4460.de: Face of a girl with long blond hair in half-profile to the left, narrow straight nose, narrow sharp-lined mouth. Wearing a dark green jacket and a brown blouse. In the background a summer landscape with a hay barn at the left edge and a light blue sky with delicate clouds.

4461.d: Noore naise portree profiilis. Poolpikad punakasblondid juuksed kuklasse kammitud, sirge terav nina, selge suujoon. Seljas vanaroosat värvi kleit. Foon tumeroheline.
4461.de: Portrait of a young woman in profile. Shoulder-length reddish-blond hair combed back into the nape. Straight, sharp nose, a clear line of the mouth. Wearing an old-rose coloured dress. Background dark green.

4462.d: Valges kitlis ja mütsis kirju (oranžid lillekimbud kollasel foonil) traksidega põllega, roosa näojumega naine. Kõrvas punane kõrvarõngas, helepruunid juuksed taha kokku seotud. Väljasirutatud paremas käes roosa, kikkis kõrvadega seapea. Foon eest hall, ülalt tumepruun.
4462.de: A woman in a white smock and cap patterned with orange bunches of flowers on a yellow background, wearing an apron with straps, with a rosy complexion. A red earring in her ear, light brown hair tied back. In her outstretched right hand a pink pig's head with perky ears. The background is grey in front, dark brown above.

4465.d: Hallikal poodiumil, pruuni draperii ees tumedapäine sihvakas naisakt seismas otsevaates, vasak käsi toetub punase draperiiga kaetud postamendile, parem rippu küljel. Selgelt piiritletud pinnad, hele figuur tumedal taustal. Näo osa detailselt välja maalitud.
4465.de: On a greyish podium, in front of a brown drapery, a slender dark-haired female nude stands in frontal view, left hand resting on a pedestal covered with red drapery, right hand hanging at her side. Clearly delineated surfaces, a light figure against a dark background. The facial area painted out in detail.

4478.de: 116x81 Anu Variksoo portrait Lembit Sarapuu 1973(eesti). Location on object: on the reverse on the stretcher

4482.de: Portrait of Lieutenant Jo. M. Kozlov. Portret leitenanta J.M. Kozlova. Kozlov, J.M. (Russian letters). 1975 55x46 L. Sarapuu. Location on object: on the frame

4487.d: Rohtunud, üksikute kividega rannariba ja sinakas-roheline meri. Kaldaääres kaks murdlainete riba. Taevas 1/3, keskelt helenev.
4487.de: A grassy coastal strip with scattered stones and a bluish-green sea. Along the shore two bands of breaking waves. Sky 1/3, glowing from the centre.

4490.d: Väike, vanadest äärelinna majadest ja madalatest kuuridest tihedalt ümbritsetud lumine hoov. Vasakul kahe maja vahel kõrgub üle katuste üksik puu. Taevas hele.
4490.de: A small snow-covered yard densely surrounded by old suburban houses and low sheds. On the left, between two houses, a solitary tree rises above the roofs. The sky is light.

4495.d: Rohekasbeežil, laiade pintslitõmmetega maalitud alusel ja samades toonides tumedamal foonil paremal kuldlõikes valge korgiga taimeõli pudel; sellest vasemal kuldlõikes valge koorekann; paremal, veidi eespool sarnaste vormidega piimakann. Pudeli ja koorekannu ees kuus sidrunit.
4495.de: On a greenish-beige base painted with broad brushstrokes and against a darker background in the same tones, on the right a bottle of vegetable oil with a white cork in golden section; to its left a white cream jug in golden section; on the right, slightly further forward, a milk jug of similar form. In front of the bottle and the cream jug, six lemons.

4496.d: Sinakal laual valge, rohekates voltides draperii. Selle taga valge email-kohvikann, päts leiba, teeklaas ja erkkollased sidrunid - üks terve, teine lahtilõigatud.
4496.de: On a bluish table a white drapery in greenish folds. Behind it a white enamel coffee pot, a loaf of bread, a tea glass and bright yellow lemons - one whole, the other cut open.

4497.d: Tumedal foonil punase linaga kaetud laual natüürmort: sinaka helgiga valge teekann ja kaks kruusi, kolm klaasi, viis punast õuna, vasktaldrik ja ultramariinsinine draperii. Maalitud reljeefselt ja esemete materiaalsust rõhutavalt, läigete ja refleksidega. Punane lame ja läikiv raam. Tugev lakikiht.
4497.de: A still life on a table covered with a red cloth against a dark background: a white teapot with a bluish sheen and two mugs, three glasses, five red apples, a copper plate, and an ultramarine blue drapery. Painted in relief, emphasising the materiality of the objects, with gleams and reflections. Red flat and glossy frame. Thick layer of varnish.

4498.d: Keskealise, tumedate pikemate juuste ja habemega mehe rinnaportree. Seljas tuhmroheline džemper ja sinine pintsak. Foon džemprikarva roheline, näole langeb vasakult valgus.
4498.de: Chest portrait of a middle-aged man with dark, longer hair and a beard. Wearing a dull green sweater and a blue jacket. Background green like the sweater, light falling on the face from the left.

4499.d: Keskealise, tumedate pikemate juuste ja habemega mehe rinnaportree. Seljas tuhmroheline džemper ja sinine pintsak. Foon džemprikarva roheline, näole langeb vasakult valgus.
4499.de: Chest portrait of a middle-aged man with dark, longer hair and a beard. Wearing a dull green sweater and a blue jacket. Background green like the sweater, light falling on the face from the left.

4501.d: Tumedal foonil kollasel alusel valge silindriline vaas suure kimbu punaste ning kollaste tulpide ja kolme nartsissiga. Vaasi ees kõrge, kaarja sangaga koorekann ja lusikas; paremale jäävad tühi joogiklaas ning pildiservaga äralõigatud valge taldrik. Valgus langeb paremalt.
4501.de: Against a dark background, on a yellow base, a white cylindrical vase with a large bunch of red and yellow tulips and three narcissi. In front of the vase a tall cream jug with an arched handle and a spoon; to the right an empty drinking glass and a white plate cut off by the edge of the picture. Light falls from the right.

4502.d: Liivakarva riidega kaetud alusel, pruunil taustal valge, lühikese tilaga kann nelja, punase, avatud õiega tulpidega. Kannu ees paremal pool pätsi vormileiba, sibul ning valge riidetükk. Taustal, paremal langeb pehmetes voltides valkjas draperii. Valges langeb paremalt.
4502.de: On a stand covered with sand-coloured fabric, against a brown background, a white jug with a short spout with four open red tulip blossoms. In front of the jug on the right, a loaf of bread, an onion and a piece of white cloth. In the background, on the right, a whitish drapery falls in soft folds. Light falls from the right.

4503.d: Tumedal punakaspruunil taustal, mis vasakus ülemises nurgas veidi helendab, vaevu aimatav ühtlane pruun laua fragment, millel vasakult nurgeliselt drapereeritud valge riie, vaskne uhmer nuiaga, kollakaspruun ülespoole laienev savikauss, nupulise korgiga klaaskarahvin veega ja osa pruunist savinõust. Karahvini ees erkvalge munapeeker munakoorega, vasakul veel kolm poolikut koort.
4503.de: Against a dark reddish-brown background, which glows slightly in the upper left corner, a barely discernible, uniformly brown fragment of a table, on which, draped in an angular fashion from the left, a white cloth, a copper mortar with a pestle, a yellowish-brown clay bowl widening upward, a glass carafe with a knobbed stopper filled with water, and part of a brown clay vessel. In front of the carafe a bright white egg cup with an eggshell, on the left three more halved eggshells.

4505.d: 2/3 pildi pinnast võtavad enda alla allääres roheline-pruun kaldariba ning hall, silmapiiri juures tumenev peegelsile merepind. Taevas sinakashall, horisontaalsete pilvejoontega; ülal vasakus nurgas hele laik üksiku halli pilvetutiga.
4505.de: 2/3 of the picture's surface is taken up, along the lower edge, by a green-brown coastal strip and a grey, mirror-smooth sea surface darkening near the horizon. The sky bluish-grey, with horizontal cloud lines; in the upper left corner a light patch with a single grey cloud tuft.

4506.d: Samblarohelisel alusel, pildi keskel hall kõhukas, väikese sangaga kann suure kimbu lillades toonides astrite ja kahe oranži saialillega. Kannust paremal roheline plekk-kruus. Valgus langeb vasakult. Foon tume.
4506.de: On a moss-green base, in the middle of the picture a grey-bellied jug with a small handle holding a large bouquet of purplish-toned asters and two orange marigolds. To the right of the jug, a green tin mug. Light falls from the left. Dark background.

4542.d: Arvutusmasina taustal pildi paremas servas kolme seisva ja ühe prillidega istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguurid. Samas tool, millel tuhatoos põleva sigaretiga. Vasakul ning ülal servas punased, roosad, sinised ebakorrapärased laigud.
4542.de: Against the background of a calculating machine, in the right part of the picture, three-quarter figures of three standing men and one seated man with glasses. In the same place a chair on which stands an ashtray with a burning cigarette. On the left and upper edge irregular red, pink, blue patches.

4543.d: Tumepruunil foonil kitsa erkpunase ribaga maali allääres kerges pöördes vasemale põlvini kujutatud seisev naisakt, puusast kerge paindega vasakule. Näo ees lai, õlgadeni ulatuv valge draperii. Vasak käsivars sirgena, käega reiel, parem üle vöökoha küünarnukist murtuna hoiab kergelt teist küünarvart.
4543.de: Against a dark brown background, along the lower edge of the painting with a narrow bright red stripe, a standing female nude depicted to the knees in a slight turn to the left, with a slight bend at the hip to the left. In front of the face, a wide white drapery reaching to the shoulders. The left arm straight, hand on the thigh, the right bent at the elbow above waist height, lightly holding the other forearm.

4544.d: Kompositsiooni vasakpoolsel kahel kolmandikul, vaadatuna ülalt alla, kogu antud pinda täitvalt rohekaspruunidena maalitud grupp sõdureid (ülakehad) lillekimpudega käes. Paremal all, seljaga vaataja poole, musta looriga naise pea. Parempoolsel kolmandikul mustal, valkjashallide pindadega lõhutud foonil alumises nurgas musta leinalooriga naise profiil (vasemale), punase nelgiga rinna kohale tõstetud kätes. Ülal paremal äärel fragment hallist urnist mustas nišis.
4544.de: In the left two-thirds of the composition, viewed from above, filling the entire given surface, a group of soldiers (upper bodies) painted in greenish-brown with bouquets of flowers in their hands. On the lower right, back to the viewer, the head of a woman in a black veil. In the right third, against a black background broken up with whitish-grey surfaces, in the lower corner the profile of a woman in a black mourning veil (facing left), with a red carnation in hands raised to the chest. In the upper right edge a fragment of a grey urn in a black niche.

4545.d: Habemiku mehe poolfiguur pöördes paremale, lahendatud heledates, kohati ulatuslikes värvilaikudes, vältides sealjuures kontuure. Foonist eendub plastilisemalt keha hallis särgis kuna käed on sulatatud fooni. Värvidest domineerivad kollane ja roosa pea ümber, milledele kontrasteeruvad sinine, roheline ja lilla näopartiis. Kuldne liist.
4545.de: Half-figure of a bearded man turned to the right, rendered in light, at times extensive patches of colour, avoiding contours in the process. The body in a grey shirt projects more plastically from the background, since the hands are merged with the background. Yellow and pink dominate around the head, contrasted by blue, green and purple in the face area. Golden frame moulding.

4546.d: Esiplaanil hallides toonides valge ja kollasega joonestatud sõidutee käänak, mille taga madal hoonestik intensiivsetes toonides (kollane, sinine, oranž) siltide ja plakatitega.
4546.de: In the foreground, in grey tones, a bend of a road drawn in white and yellow, behind which low buildings in intense tones (yellow, blue, orange) with signs and posters.

4547.d: Kadrioru motiiv Luigetiigiga, maalitud erksa rohelise tooniga - vesi ja puud; üksikud aktsendid erinevates toonides.
4547.de: Motif of Kadriorg with the Swan Pond, painted in vivid green tones - water and trees; individual accents in various tones.

4548.d: Valge linaga kaetud laual klaaskannus punased, lillad ja roosad astrid. Laudlinale on kukkunud üks astrileht. Erksinisel foonil, horisontaalsest keskjoonest veidi allpool, servades kaks valget nelinurka.
4548.de: On a table covered with a white cloth, a glass jug with red, purple and pink asters. One aster leaf has fallen onto the tablecloth. Against a bright blue background, slightly below the horizontal centre line, two white rectangles at the edges.

4550.d: Vaskpunaste juustega, heleda näoga, hästi vormitud suujoonega tütarlapse rinnaportree. Seljas punakaspruun jakk, pitskraega valge pluus, roosa kohev kaunistus rinnaesisel. Foon hall.
4550.de: Bust portrait of a girl with copper-red hair, light face, well-formed mouth line. Wearing a reddish-brown jacket, a white blouse with a lace collar, a pink fluffy decoration on the chest. Background gray.

4551.d: Rohelisel murul kirju rahvamass suvistes rõivastes. Esiplaani viis figuuri selgemalt antud: vasakul sinistes pükstes, valges särgis ja nokkmütsis, punast ja rohelist triipu lipsuga mees, pruun jakk paremal põlvel. Temast paremal vasekarva juustega kollases kleidis naine, käed taha toetumas ja kott kõrval. Edasi käsipõsakil istuv lühikeste juustega tütarlaps. Paremal all servas naeratava näoga punase-rohelisekirjus pihikus blondiin, kelle kõrval profiilis tumedapäine naine. Kompositsiooni keskplaanis on inimesed antud eredate värvilaikude mänguna. Ülaosas erksinine taevas.
4551.de: On green grass a colourful crowd of people in summer clothing. Five figures in the foreground given more clearly: on the left a man in blue trousers, white shirt and peaked cap, tie in red and green stripes, brown jacket over his right knee. To his right a woman with copper-coloured hair in a yellow dress, hands leaning back, a bag beside her. Further on a short-haired girl sitting with her chin resting on her hand. In the lower right corner a smiling blonde in a red-and-green patterned pinafore, beside her a dark-haired woman in profile. In the middle ground of the composition, people are rendered as a play of bright colour patches. Above, a bright blue sky.

4562.d: Helesinistes ja lillakates toonides maalitud meri, pildi allservas kolm rida siniseid ja roosasid katkendlikke jooni. Silmapiiril erksinine triip. Silmapiirist kõrgemal hallikas taevas.
4562.de: A sea painted in light blue and purplish tones, at the bottom edge of the picture three rows of broken blue and pink lines. On the horizon a bright blue stripe. Above the horizon a grayish sky.

4563.d: Erinevates sinistes toonides, üksteisesse sulavate horisontaalsete triipudena maalitud meri. Esiplaanil all katkendlike siniste ja oranžide joonte read. Ülal helesinine pilvitu taevas.
4563.de: The sea painted in various shades of blue as horizontal stripes merging into one another. In the foreground below, rows of broken blue and orange lines. Above, a light blue cloudless sky.

4568.d: Ühtlaselt helesinise taeva all värvikas figuuride grupp üheksast noorest, napilt riietatud naisest koosnev. Ees, aimatava spordiraja kõrval, vaataja suunas ette kummargil kolm ergutavat, hõiskavat neidu. Nende taga, värvilaikude vahel vehklevad, juubeldavad kujud. Taga keskel, taeva taustal tõstetud kätega naine. Hallikasbeežiga modelleeritud figuuride vahel säravad, erksad toonid. Hoogne lopsakas maalilaad.
4568.de: Under a uniformly light blue sky a colourful group of figures consisting of nine young, scantily dressed women. In front, next to a suggested sports track, three cheering, exclaiming young women lean forward towards the viewer. Behind them, amid patches of colour, figures wave and rejoice. In the background centre, against the sky, a woman with raised arms. Between the figures modelled in greyish beige, bright, vivid tones shine. A vigorous, lush painting style.

4642.d: Ovaalne lint kirjaga, selle sees põimuvad kujundid ning sõõris tükk taevalaotust.
4642.de: An oval ribbon with an inscription, inside it intertwining figures and, within a circle, a piece of sky.

4643.dm: graafikaplaadi kõrgus: 5.8 cm; lehe laius: 21.6 cm; lehe kõrgus: 19.4 cm; graafikaplaadi laius: 8.9 cm
4643.de: Two stylized human figures with spruce motifs on the shoulder.

4644.dm: lehe laius: 22.4 cm; lehe kõrgus: 19.5 cm; graafikaplaadi laius: 7.7 cm; graafikaplaadi kõrgus: 7.0 cm
4644.d: Ruudulisel linal pudel akti kujutava sildiga ja saiapäts.
4644.de: On a checkered cloth, a bottle with a label depicting a nude, and a loaf of bread.

Paremal ülal, osalt lauale toetumas ovaalne peegel, selles peegeldub vertikaalne punase valguse riba ja heledasti valgustatud naiserind. Peegli paremas servas, umbes horisondi keskjoone kohal paunase värvi pritsmed.
4832.de: A dark corner of a room: on the left a table bathed in bluish night light, on which a black telephone lies on red cloth, the cord winding across the table. On the upper right, an oval mirror, partly resting on the table, reflecting a vertical strip of red light and a brightly lit woman's breast. In the mirror's right edge, roughly at the level of the horizon's midline, splashes of a buff colour.

4835.d: Allservas pruun triip, millest vaatab välja lõvi nägu. Triibust kõrgemal pime ruum, mida kahelt poolt vertikaalselt piiravad mererohelised triibud. Pimedas ruumis sinisega maalitud lõvi kroon ja lõvi õrnalt markeeritud keha. Loomast paremal tõuseb pimedusest pruun pind, mille kohal voluudiga konstruktsioon, vaasid, pudelid jm. esemed peal. Konstruktsioonist vasakul ripub pungil niidist võrk.
4835.de: In the lower part a brown stripe from which a lion's face looks out. Above the stripe a dark space, vertically bounded on both sides by sea-green stripes. In the dark space a lion's crown painted in blue and the lion's faintly marked body. To the right of the animal a brown surface rises from the darkness, above which a construction with volutes, vases, bottles and other objects on top. To the left of the construction hangs a net of taut thread.

4836.d: Pildi pind pikitriibuliselt jagatud kaadriteks linnaelust nähtuna läbi sõrestiku. Vasakul all triibulistes bikiinides naisekeha, keskel fragmente mootorratturist, paremal neoonreklaami, autokummide jm. detaile.
4836.de: The surface of the image is divided lengthwise into stripes forming frames of urban life seen through a lattice. Lower left, a woman's body in striped bikini, in the middle fragments of a motorcyclist, on the right neon advertising, car tires and other details.

5129.d: Esiplaanil keskel madal vaas kimbu nurmenukkudega. Vasakus servas piimapudel ühe nurmenukuga. Kontuurid hajutatud. Foon maalitud üksteisesse sulatatud lillades-hallides toonides. Paremas alumises nurgas kaarjas, ühtlane tume pind.
5129.de: In the middle of the foreground, a low vase with a bunch of cowslips. In the left margin, a milk bottle with one cowslip. Contours diffused. Background painted in purple-grey tones blended into one another. In the lower right corner, an arched, even dark surface.

5130.d: Viiest figuurist koosnev kompositsioon: ühe käsipõsakil ja teise jalg üle põlve istuva naise vahel mehefiguur. Paremal servas seljaga vaataja poole kollakasrohelises kleidis tumedate juustega naine rohelist rätikut õlgadel kandmas. Vasakul ülal foon tume, all paremas nurgas kollane. Iste bordoopunane.
5130.de: A composition of five figures: between one woman sitting with her cheek resting on her hand and another with her leg crossed over her knee, a male figure. On the right edge, a dark-haired woman in a yellowish-green dress, seen from behind, wearing a green shawl over her shoulders. Upper left the background is dark, lower right corner yellow. The seat is burgundy red.

5131.d: Tumeda figuraalse kompositsiooni alumises osas vastandsuundades liikuvad hallid inimfiguurid. Ülaosas keskel tumedas pikas kuues ja pükstes mehefiguur, kellest vasakul pruunil foonil ähmaselt markeeritud teised figuurid. Maalitud hajusalt, otsekui läbi udu.
5131.de: In the lower part of a dark figural composition, grey human figures moving in opposite directions. In the upper part, in the middle, a male figure in a dark long coat and trousers, to the left of whom other figures are vaguely marked against a brown background. Painted diffusely, as though through fog.

5141.d: Hallis vines mereäärse avara maastiku taustal neljast figuurist koosnev grupp: vasakul keskel otsevaates tikksirgelt seisev mees, pilk suunatud üles. Tema eest vasakule mööduv noore naise kuju. Naisel pikad tumedad juuksed, pilk kohkunud, paokil suu. Paremal otsevaates seisev noor naine sinises õlapaeltega kleidis, pikad pruunid juuksed langemas seljale. Tema eest paremale möödavilksatav varjutaoline meesfiguur.
5141.de: Against the background of a grey, hazy, spacious seaside landscape, a group of four figures: on the left in the middle, seen frontally, a man standing ramrod straight, his gaze directed upward. Past him, to the left, the figure of a young woman passing by. The woman has long dark hair, a startled look, her mouth slightly open. On the right a young woman standing, seen frontally, in a blue dress with shoulder straps, long brown hair falling down her back. Past her, to the right, a shadow-like male figure flitting by.

5144.d: Vasakul tumedas kuues mehe kuju õlgadeni kaabut kergitamas, pea suunatud vasakule alla. Temast paremal laia äärega kübaras heledapäise naise pea profiilis paremale. Tumedad summutatud toonid. Ülaosas heledam, aimatav taevafoon.

The woman's hair is twisted into a bun at the back of the head, with a fringe on the forehead, wearing a red jacket and also a greyish-green skirt.
