5240.d: Pildil ruum, kus allääres esiplaanil valge, katkise linaga kaetud laud. Laual hülge pealuu, nöör, värvituub. Lauast vasakul alumises nurgas pruuni elektriradiaatori osa, millele on tilkunud sinist värvi. Suurema osa pildist võtab enda alla maastikumaal ruumi pruunil seinal. Sellel on kujutatud meri, liivarand, kivid ja tuules kooldunud rohupuhmad. Rohututtide piirkonnas pruuni värvi voolamise laike.
5240.de: The picture shows a room, at the bottom in the foreground a table covered with a white, torn cloth. On the table a seal's skull, a cord, a tube of paint. In the lower left corner from the table part of a brown electric radiator, onto which blue paint has dripped. Most of the picture is occupied by a landscape painting on the brown wall of the room. It depicts the sea, a sandy beach, stones and grass tufts bent by the wind. In the area of the grass tufts there are stains of brown paint running down.

5241.d: Heleda tellisseina taustal massiivne, kumerate vormidega diivanitaoline kujund. Ümaral käetoel sinistes toonides draperiisid meenutavad pehmed vormid, seljatoe polster värvikatest rakutaolistest vormidest. Parempoolse käetoe kohal erkkollane ühtlane kaarjas pind.
5241.de: Against the background of a light-coloured brick wall a massive, curved-form sofa-like shape. On the rounded armrest soft forms resembling drapery in blue tones, the backrest upholstery of colourful cell-like forms. Above the right armrest a bright yellow, evenly curved surface.

5242.d: Esiplaanil vasakul molbert poolelioleva lõuendiga, sinise pintsakuga, näota mees pildist välja astumas. Vasakul õlgadelt tugevasti kroogitud pruunis kleidis naise rinnaportree. Temast kõrgemal, valgel seinal, hallides toonides naise portree. Esiplaanil olevast pildist paremal paljugiruudiline kompositsioon (grupiportree), millel eriti silma hakkavad ülespandud juustega naisakt, temast paremal olev pikkade mustade juuste ja prillidega naine ning allservas paažisoengus ja mustas kleidis naine. Väga maaliline, kohati pastoosne.
5242.de: In the foreground on the left an easel with an unfinished canvas, a faceless man in a blue jacket stepping out of the picture. On the left the bust portrait of a woman in a brown dress strongly gathered at the shoulders. Above her, on a white wall, a portrait of a woman in grey tones. To the right of the picture in the foreground is a multi-square composition (group portrait), in which especially striking are a female nude with upswept hair, to her right a woman with long black hair and glasses, and at the bottom edge a woman with a pageboy hairstyle in a black dress. Very painterly, in places pastose.

5246.d: Maalil ülal ja vasakul avatud aknaid meenutavad hallid konstruktsioonid. Vasakul alumises neljandikus kaks inimest: vasakpoolsel paistavad jalad ja alakeha peaaegu vöökohani. Parempoolne - kollases sportliku lõikega pluusis mees hoiab käes valget paberilehte või plaati, mida ümbritsevad värvilised spiraaljooned.
5246.de: In the painting, above and to the left, grey constructions resembling open windows. In the lower left quarter two people: on the left the legs and lower body are visible almost to the waist. On the right - a man in a yellow sportily cut blouse holds a white sheet of paper or a board, surrounded by colourful spiral lines.

5251.d: Roosa ja tumepunase, pikkade lehtedega rootaimestiku kohal nelinurksel puualusel valge kajaka topis, sinine silm peas kiiskamas. Topise all roostikus tumepunane, topise puualuse nelinurgast jäänud jälg. Ülal valge, kohati sinisega varjutatud foon. Ülal vasakust servast valgub foonile tumesinine värvilaik.
5251.de: Above pink and dark red, long-leaved reed vegetation, on a square wooden base a stuffed white gull, blue eye gleaming in its head. Under the mount, in the reeds, a dark red trace left by the square wooden base. Above, a white background, in places shaded with blue. From the upper left edge a dark blue patch of colour spreads onto the background.

5252.d: Keskel suur, vormitu, pisut jõehobu meenutav loom. Esiplaanil ja taga tumepruunid trellid. Looma taga vasakul sinine merd meenutav piirkond. Ülal sinine, keskel ähvardava ilmega taevas, ümberringi hallikad pilved.
5252.de: In the centre a large, shapeless animal, somewhat resembling a hippopotamus. In the foreground and background dark brown bars. Behind the animal on the left a blue, sea-like area. Above, blue, in the middle a sky with a menacing look, surrounded by greyish clouds.

5253.d: Ühtlaste laiade püst-, rõht- ja diagonaaljoonte taga maastikuelementidega põimitud kolme naise kuju. Vasakpoolne, paokil suuga ja keskmine, avatud hõlmadega, vaataja suunas. Luaba kohalt katab päid ühtlane must pind. Parempoolne külgvaates paremale. Neli ühesugust selgepiirilist pinda kahel pool. Alumine äär punane.
5253.de: Behind uniform broad vertical, horizontal and diagonal lines, the figures of three women interwoven with landscape elements. The left one, with mouth ajar, and the middle one, with open lapels, facing the viewer. From the hairline the heads are covered by a uniform black surface. The right one in profile facing right. Four identical clearly bounded surfaces on either side. The lower edge red.

5259.d: Helesinine kompositsioon grupi inimestega. Esiplaanil neli seljaga vaataja poole seisvat täiskasvanut, kellest üks vaatab tagasi. Neist vasakul ja nende ees üks ja sama hüppava poisslapse figuur korduses ning paremal toolil istuv prillidega mees, jalg üle põlve. Inimgrupi vahelt paistavad eemalt kahe naise figuurid, taust helesinine, nurkadest roosatriibuline.
5259.de: A light blue composition with a group of people. In the foreground, four adults standing with their backs to the viewer, one of whom looks back. To their left and in front of them, one and the same figure of a jumping boy repeated, and on the right a bespectacled man sitting on a chair, one leg crossed over the other. Between the group of people, the figures of two women can be seen further away; the background is light blue, striped pink at the corners.

5261.d: Dekoratiivne kompositsioon lopsaka lainetava veetaimestikuga, milles jalgupidi kahe supelpükstes lapse alakeha paistmas. Maali piiravad sümmeetriliselt kahelt poolt kumerad käsipuud meenutavad puna-kollase triibulised torud. Erksavärviline, selgepiiriline popilik kujutamisviis.
5261.de: A decorative composition with lush undulating water plants, in which the lower bodies of two children in swimming trunks, standing feet-down, are visible. The painting is symmetrically bordered on both sides by curved handrails resembling red-yellow striped pipes. Brightly coloured, sharply defined, pop-like manner of depiction.

5262.d: Mees seisab keset maastiku, taustaks puud.
5262.de: A man stands in the middle of a landscape, with trees in the background.

5263.d: Esiplaanil ühevärvilise erkrohelise pinnana maalitud muru taustal punasekollase triibuline tõkkepuu, paremal pool üles tõstetud. Taamal ühtlase ribana mets. Selle kohal taevas, millel vasakust nurgast viltu paremale üle kogu taeva laia ribana kollakasmust suur suitsupilv. Taevas pilvest allpool maalitud ühtlase helesinise pinnana, pilve kohal tumesinise pinnana.
5263.de: In the foreground, against a background of grass painted as a monochrome bright green surface, a red-yellow striped barrier pole, raised on the right side. Beyond it, forest as an even band. Above it, sky, on which a large yellowish-black cloud of smoke stretches diagonally from the left corner to the right across the whole sky as a wide band. Below the cloud the sky is painted as an even light blue surface, above the cloud as a dark blue surface.

5902.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud vasakul üleval nurgas roosaka vammusevarrukaga kilplase pruun käsi, milles tugev malakas sea jaoks.
5902.de: Depicted on the film storyboard, in the upper left corner, a brown hand of a Kilplane in a pinkish jerkin sleeve, holding a strong club for a pig.

5903.d: Filmiplanšetil paremal kilplane kõhuli, hoiab üht kätt pea juures ja vaatab silmad-suud pärani ettepoole. Tema kõrval, planšetil vasakul, kilplane istukil, käed üles tõstetud, suu pärani lahti.

5904.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud roosakas ülikonnas kilplane kükakil (planšetil ainult keha ülemine osa), pea kallutatud selga, suu lahti.

5905.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud suures plaanis kilplase poolportree avatud terakotiga. Kilplane hoiab ühe käega ümber koti, teisega võtab kotist teri.

5906.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud kilplane kükakil asendis, sõrm suus.

5907.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud kaks kilplast seisavad vastamisi ja tegelevad nende vahel oleva kollaka köiega. Parempoolne kilplane tõstab köit kõrgele, vasakpoolne kisub ka nööri, endal silmad ja suu pärani.
5907.de: The film storyboard depicts two Kilplased standing facing each other, dealing with a yellowish rope between them. The Kilplane on the right lifts the rope high, while the one on the left also pulls the rope, his eyes and mouth wide open.

5908.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud kilplase pea, väikeses formaadis.
5908.de: A kilplane's head depicted on a film storyboard, small format.

5909.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud langev pisaratilk. Ülemine ots terav, valkjas, altosas ümmargune ja sinakas.
5909.de: A falling teardrop depicted on a film plate. The upper end sharp, whitish, the lower part round and bluish.

5910.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud nirisemas kilplaste pisaraid. Üleval väikesed valkjad nired ja nende keskelt saavad alguse kolm pikka sinakat niret.
5910.de: On a film storyboard the tears of the Kilplased trickling. Above small whitish trickles, from the middle of which three long bluish trickles begin.

5911.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud roosakas ülikonnas kilplane, kes on tõstnud helekollase varrega lilla labida kõrgele löömisasendisse.
5911.de: A Kilplane depicted on a film storyboard, wearing a pinkish suit, who has raised a purple shovel with a light yellow handle high into a striking position.

5912.d: Filmiplansetil kujutatud kahte kilplast, kes kogu jõuga hoiavad oma peade ja kätega palkseina püsti.
5912.de: Depicted on a film storyboard are two Kilplased, who with all their strength hold up a log wall with their heads and hands.

5913.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud roosakates ülikondades kilplasi, kes seisavad suures ringis, hoiavad kätest kinni, suud lahti. Kokku 27 kilplast.

5914.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud neli kanderaami hoidvat ja jooksvat kilplast, suud pärani. Kanderaamil põlvili viies kilplane, kes on tõstnud nuia kõrgele pea kohale. Ees lippab suur ümmargune roosa siga, suu pärani lahti, saba püsti.
5914.de: On the film storyboard, four kalevipoeg [ancient hero] figures depicted holding and running with a stretcher, mouths wide open. On the stretcher a fifth kalevipoeg kneeling, having raised a club high above his head. In front runs a large round pink pig, mouth wide open, tail upright.

5915.d: Filmiplanšetil kujutatud neli kanderaami hoidvat ja jooksvat kilplast, suud pärani. Kanderaamil põlvili viies kilplane, kes äigab ees sibavale suurele ümmargusele roosale seale nuiaga.

6034.d: Ees- ja keskplaanil hallikates ja valkjates toonides rannaluited ning tumedad männid. Taga hallikas, kerge sinise varjundiga tasane merepind ja hall taevariba.
6034.de: In the foreground and middle ground, in greyish and whitish tones, coastal dunes and dark pines. Behind, a greyish, faintly blue-tinged calm sea surface and a grey strip of sky.

6055.d: Punastes ja rohelistes toonides Rootsi künklik maastik: esiplaanis all punaste ja kollaste lehtedega sügisesed põõsad ning kaks rohelist kuuske paremas nurgas. Keskplaanis rohelised mäeveerud, tagaplaanis punased künkaharjad. Ülaservas hallikasvalgeis pilvedes taevas, pilvede vahelt paistab siin-seal taevasina. Kohati maalitud pastoosselt, spaatlit kasutades.
6055.de: A hilly Swedish landscape in red and green tones: in the foreground below, autumnal bushes with red and yellow leaves and two green spruces in the right corner. In the middle ground, green mountain slopes, in the background red hill ridges. At the upper edge, a sky in greyish-white clouds, with patches of sky blue showing through here and there. In places painted pastosely, using a palette knife.

6058.d: Hallikassinisel foonil kollastes, mitut tooni pruunides ja lillades voolavatest kärgjatest kujunditest abstraktne kompositsioon.
6058.de: On a greyish-blue background an abstract composition of flowing, honeycomb-like shapes in yellow, several tones of brown and purple.

6085.d: Sürrealistlik kompositsioon militaarsetest ja erootilisest kujunditest ulmelise türhermaa taustal.
6085.de: A surrealist composition of military and erotic imagery against a background of a fantastical wasteland.

6102.d: Kahvatuhallis, -beežis toonis udune kõrbemaastik raagus puudega. Ees paremal, veekogu ääres kaks kaelkirjakut, taga vasakul sarvedega loom udust välja joonistumas. Õrn, unenäoline kujutamisviis.
6102.de: A pale grey-beige hazy desert landscape with bare trees. In front on the right, by a body of water, two giraffes, behind on the left a horned animal emerging from the haze. A delicate, dreamlike manner of depiction.

6103.d: Avar vaade lõunamaisele kõrbemaastikule silmapiiril kõrguvate ookertoonis mägedega roosaka taeva all. Ees rohekas jõgi, liivasel kaldal üle vee paremal kolm lõvi, vasakpoolne istub. Summutatud toonid, õrn udune kujutamisviis.
6103.de: A wide view of a southern desert landscape with ochre-toned mountains rising on the horizon under a pinkish sky. In front a greenish river, on the sandy bank on the right, above the water, three lions, the one on the left sitting. Muted tones, a soft hazy manner of depiction.

6104.d: Õrnades beežikates, ooker- ja halltoonides kujutatud lõunamaine kõrbemaastik, vasakul heledate ogadega puu-põõsas. Paremal helenduva taeva taustal heledas riietuses sammuv naine, kandam pea peal ja seljale seotud.
6104.de: Rendered in delicate beige, ochre and grey tones, a southern desert landscape, on the left a bush-like tree with pale thorns. On the right, against a glowing sky, a woman walking in light-coloured clothing, a load on her head and tied to her back.

6105.d: Ülaltvaade avarale, käärulise jõega, kalda ümbruses rohelisele maastikule. Uduses ookertoonis maastikul eespool paistmas kolm lõvi, teiselpool jõge kollakaspruun maa kaetud puude hallika mustriga kahvaturoosa taeva all.
6105.de: A top view of a wide, meandering river, with a green landscape around the banks. In the hazy ochre-toned landscape three lions visible in the foreground, on the other side of the river yellowish-brown land covered with a greyish pattern of trees under a pale pink sky.

6134.d: Lühikeste punakate juustega kahvatunäolise noormehe otsevaates portree paljaste õlgadeni,peas tume okaskroon. Ühtlane õrnroheline taust helesinise taevatriibuga.
6134.de: A frontal portrait of a pale-faced young man with short reddish hair, down to the bare shoulders, a dark crown of thorns on his head. A uniform pale green background with a light blue sky stripe.

6135.d: Sügavroheline kompositsioon aimatavatest põõsapuhmastest sügavuses, mis maali
6135.de: Deep green composition of vaguely discernible clumps of bushes in the depth, which the painting

6137.d: Maaliline abstraktsioon: ühtlase sügavsinise maalipinna vasakul ja sinkjasroheka paremal jagab poolviltu kaheks heledatest joonte-pindade rägastikust koosnev kõrge faktuuriga tuulispesa-sarnane kujund.
6137.de: A painterly abstraction: a deep blue painted surface on the left and a bluish-green one on the right are divided diagonally by a high-textured, whirlwind-like shape composed of a tangle of light lines and planes.

6284.d: Stiliseerivas laadis kujutatud otsevaates istuva noore naise kolmveerandfiguur. Näoovaali ümbritseb tumedate pikkade juuste kaar, sama vormi kordab foonil olev ukseorva motiiv. Noorikul seljas punane lühikeste käistega pluus, kaeluses valge krae paistmas, ja sinine seelik. Üks käsi toetub istmele, teine kõverdatult ees. Taustal sinakashallid mustjassinised selgepiirilised pinnad.
6284.de: A stylised, three-quarter-length figure of a young woman shown seated, facing frontally. Her oval face is framed by an arc of dark long hair, the same shape being echoed in the background by a doorway motif. The young woman wears a red short-sleeved blouse, with a white collar showing at the neckline, and a blue skirt. One hand rests on the seat, the other, bent, in front. In the background, bluish-grey, blackish-blue clearly outlined areas.

6353.d: Kollase põrandaga ruum. Esiplaanil laud, voodi, pesukauss, keskel toolil istuv naine.
6353.de: A room with a yellow floor. In the foreground, a table, a bed, a washbasin, and in the middle a woman sitting on a chair.

6354.d: Heleda põrandaga ruum ümmarguse laua ja tooliga. Akna- ja ukseavadest paistab kolane maastik.
6354.de: A room with a light floor, a round table and a chair. Through the window and door openings a yellowish landscape is visible.

6355.d: Rohelise kleidi ja roosa kübaraga naine ning punase pintsakuga mees laua taga istumas. Laual pudel ja vaas puuviljadega.
6355.de: A woman in a green dress and pink hat, and a man in a red jacket, sitting at a table. On the table a bottle and a vase with fruit.

6357.d: Esiplaanil põllul kaks vankrit juurviljadega, kõrval seljaga vaataja poole sinise jakiga naisefiguur. Taga sügisene mets ja majad. Eskiisilik käsitluslaad.
6357.de: In the foreground in a field two carts with vegetables, beside them a female figure with her back to the viewer, wearing a blue jacket. Behind, an autumn forest and houses. Sketch-like manner of treatment.

6358.d: Rohelises maastikus esiplaanil viis istuvat meesfiguuri ümber rohule laotatud lina, millel pudel, leivapäts ja taldrikud. Puude vahelt paistavad majad ja taga veekogu paadiga.
6358.de: In a green landscape, in the foreground five seated male figures around a cloth spread on the grass, on which a bottle, a loaf of bread and plates. Houses can be seen between the trees, and a body of water with a boat behind.

6364.d: Kummutil istub mürkrohelises seelikus paljasjalgne naine, kuklaga vaataja poole. Peas kollakas-roheline kübar. Tema kõrval kummutil vaas valgete lilledega. Tagaplaanil kaarjas avaus, millest paistab kahvatutes toonides maastik.
6364.de: On a chest of drawers sits a barefoot woman in a poison-green skirt, her back with the nape of the neck towards the viewer. On her head a yellowish-green hat. Beside her on the chest of drawers a vase with white flowers. In the background an arched opening, through which a landscape in pale tones is visible.

6365.d: Pruunikais toonides foonil hele laua nelinurk, millel valge kann oranžides, roosades, lillades värvides lilledega ja punane klaasnõu valgete õitega. Esiplaanil sinisemustriline kruus ja kaks kastanimuna.
6365.de: Against a brownish background, a light rectangle of a table on which stands a white jug with flowers in orange, pink and purple tones, and a red glass vessel with white blossoms. In the foreground a blue-patterned mug and two chestnuts.

6366.d: Vaade beežikalt, punase käsipuuga valge barjääriga vasakul, terassilt mererannale. Esiplaanil kolm fragmenti valge linaga kaetud laudadest, vasakul keskel valge laud, kaetud kahele inimesele, selle all magav koer. Paremal laual vaas kollaste lilledega, selle ees avatud vihmavari ja viini tool. Paremas kuldlõikes tagapool linata tühi laud ning selle taga kahe valgustiga laternapost. Vahetult terrassi taga lehtpuudegrupp. Tagaplaanil sopiline merelaht, vasemal puude vahel väike punane maja. Äiksepilvine taevas.
6366.de: View from a terrace with a white barrier with a beige, red handrail on the left, to the seashore. In the foreground three fragments of tables covered with white cloth, on the left in the middle a white table, set for two people, under it a sleeping dog. On the right table a vase with yellow flowers, in front of it an open umbrella and a Vienna chair. In the right golden section, further back, an empty table without a cloth and behind it a lamppost with two lights. Immediately behind the terrace a group of deciduous trees. In the background a jagged sea bay, on the left among the trees a small red house. A thundery cloudy sky.

6367.d: Intensiivsetes toonides pilt suvisest loodusest: esiplaanil paremal tütarlaps sinises kleidis, paremal heinaniidumasin ja veenõu. Paremalt viib tee avatud ukseni. Maali keskel punases seeliku tüdruk redelil puu otsa küünitamas. Vasakpoolsel pildipoolel kollased viljaväljad ja hobune.
6367.de: A picture of summer nature in intense tones: in the foreground on the right a girl in a blue dress, on the right a hay mower and a water vessel. A path leads from the right to an open door. In the middle of the painting a girl in a red skirt reaching up into a tree on a ladder. On the left side of the picture yellow grain fields and a horse.

6368.d: Punases tugitoolis istub alasti tütarlaps, parem käsi toetub põsele, vasak toolileenile. Keha käsitletud teravalt varja ja heledusega, kusjuures vari on sügavalt sinine. Taustas intensiivseid toone: sinised, punased, pruunid, rohelised. Paremalt paistev servaga lõigatud vaas ja kuu peegeldus.
6368.de: A nude girl sits in a red armchair, her right hand resting on her cheek, her left on the armrest of the chair. The body is treated with sharp contrasts of shadow and light, the shadow being deeply blue. Intense tones in the background: blues, reds, browns, greens. On the right a vase cut off at the edge is visible, and the reflection of the moon.

6369.d: Helesinisel riidel lamab alasti naisefiguur diagonaalselt üle pildipinna, selg vaataja suunas, vasak labajalg pööratud parema peale põlve kohal, pea roosakal padjal, ümber pea asetatud vasak käsi, parem küünarnukist ette sirutatud. Tagapool valge post, ülalt alla rippuv valge rõivas, muu isa maalitud rohekates ja pruunikates toonides. Must tuhm raam.
6369.de: A nude female figure lies diagonally across the picture plane on light-blue cloth, back turned toward the viewer, left foot turned over the right above the knee, head on a pinkish pillow, left arm placed around the head, right arm bent at the elbow and extended forward. Behind, a white post, white clothing hanging from top to bottom, the rest painted in greenish and brownish tones. A dull black frame.

6370.d: Valgel riidel paremal punastes toonides pind, istukil väga hele naisakt. Käed tõstetud üle pea, mis pööratud profiili. Jalad pahkluu lähedalt helerohelise lainelise ribaga ära lõigatud. Fooniks sinistes toonides maastik, silmapiiril helendava veekoguga.
6370.de: On white fabric, on the right a surface in red tones, a very light-toned female nude sitting. Arms raised above the head, which is turned in profile. Legs cut off near the ankles by a light green wavy band. Background a landscape in blue tones, with a glimmering body of water on the horizon.

6371.d: Pruunikatoonilisel laual keskel valge sangaga kann valkjate lilledega, sellest vasakul jäävad kaks purki pintslitega ja raamatuvirn. Paremal lauanurgal sinakas rätik, millel klaasvaas saialilledega ning taldrik õuntega. Ees, lauaserval merikarp. Foon pruunikates-sinakates toonides.
6371.de: On a brownish-toned table in the middle a jug with a white handle with whitish flowers, to its left two jars with brushes and a stack of books. On the right corner of the table a bluish towel, on which a glass vase with marigolds and a plate with apples. In front, on the edge of the table, a sea shell. The background in brownish-bluish tones.

6372.d: Maali esiplaanil asuvas punakas-pruunis nahkkattega tugitoolis istuv naisakt. Keha kallutatud vasakule, pea toetub käsivarrele. Lühikesed heledad juuksed. Tooli taga roheliste lehtedega palm. Interjöör maalitud külmades toonides, etüüdlikult.
6372.de: Female nude in the foreground, sitting in an armchair with reddish-brown leather upholstery. Body leaning to the left, head resting on the arm. Short light hair. A palm with green leaves behind the chair. Interior painted in cool tones, in an étude-like manner.

6373.d: Paremal ülemises pildineljandikus avatud uksel helesinises lahtises suvekleidis blond noor naine korviga, maalitud pinnalises, skitseerivas, vähe läbimaalitud maneeris, figuur mõjub pigem siluetina. Allosas valge laua fragment, millel erksinine kirevate põllulilledega vaas ning lillakasroosa kauss. Vasakul osa toast punakaspruunil, kummuti ja laias raamis peegliga rohelisel, selgelt eralduvate pintslilöökidega maalitud foonil. Toa põrand ookritoonides.
6373.de: In the upper right quarter of the painting, in an open doorway, a blonde young woman in a light blue loose summer dress with a basket, painted in a flat, sketch-like, thinly painted manner, the figure appears more like a silhouette. Below, a fragment of a white table on which stands a bright blue vase with colourful meadow flowers and a lilac-pink bowl. On the left, part of a room painted in a reddish-brown background with a chest of drawers and a mirror in a wide frame, against a green background with clearly distinguishable brushstrokes. The floor of the room is in ochre tones.

6374.d: Esiplaanil fragment valge linaga kaetud lauast, millel hele kann punakates toonides lilledega. Laua kõrval pruun viini tool, millest näha ainult 1/4. Tagaplaanil seisab avatud uksel külgvaates naisfiguur. Foon on antud erksate värvilaikudega, tugevate pintslilöökide abil.
6374.de: In the foreground a fragment of a table covered with a white cloth, on which a light-coloured jug with flowers in reddish tones. Next to the table a brown Vienna chair, of which only 1/4 is visible. In the background, in an open doorway, a woman's figure seen in side view. The background is rendered with vivid patches of colour, with strong brushstrokes.

6375.d: Vasakul punakaspruunide käsipuudega kivist kaldarinnatis ja jõgi, millel paistab kollakaspruuni paadi nina. Keskel, peaaegu küljega, valges suvekübaras naisakt, käed kübara serva kohendama tõstetud. Akti foonil tumeroheliste kroonidega puud ja kaks helesinistes suvekleitides naist, üks neist puust kinni hoidmas. Paremal all suurte ratastega käru, millel roosa-valgetriibuline madrats ning pruun kaabu. Paremal ülanurgas suurte klaasakende, rõdu, trepi ja kaaruksega maja, mille poole kõnnib kaabuga mees, väikesel kollase kleidiga tüdrukul käest kinni hoides. Vasakul ülanurgas punakaspruunides ja ookerjates toonides linna siluett, mille väljaku keskel postamendil skulptuur.
6375.de: On the left, a stone embankment parapet with reddish-brown handrails, and a river on which the bow of a yellowish-brown boat can be seen. In the centre, almost in profile, a female nude in a white summer hat, her hands raised to adjust the brim of the hat. Against the background of the nude, trees with dark green crowns and two women in light blue summer dresses, one of them holding on to a tree. Below on the right, a cart with large wheels, on which lies a pink-and-white striped mattress and a brown hat. In the upper right corner, a house with large glass windows, a balcony, a staircase and an archway, towards which a man in a hat is walking, holding by the hand a small girl in a yellow dress. In the upper left corner, the silhouette of a town in reddish-brown and ochre tones, with a sculpture on a pedestal in the middle of the square.

6378.d: Pildi ülemises paremas osas sopiline kaarakendega valge kivimaja, mille ukse kohal sepistatud tugedele toetuv varikatus. Maja jätkab pruuni katusega kivimüür, mille kõrgest kaarväravast paistavad rohekad-sinised puud ja põõsad. Pildi keskel seisab päevitunud kollase kübara ja valge rüüga mees seljaga vaataja poole. Mehest vasakul erkroheline puudemassiiv. Keskjoonest kõrgemal on foonil kollakasrohelistes toonides aimatav maastik, mille kohal valgete pilvedega taevas. All punased, rohelised ja kollased kandilised pinnad.
6378.de: In the upper right part of the picture an irregular, arcaded white stone house, above whose door a canopy rests on forged supports. The stone wall continues from the house with a brown roof, through whose high arched gate greenish-blue trees and bushes are visible. In the centre of the picture stands a tanned man in a yellow hat and a white robe, his back to the viewer. To the left of the man a bright green mass of trees. Above the midline, in the background, a landscape can be discerned in yellowish-green tones, above which a sky with white clouds. Below, red, green and yellow rectangular surfaces.

6379.d: Keskel, valge maja taustal, pisut paremale pöördunud, pea ümber põimitud kätega naisakt, nägu profiilis, lühikesed juuksed punakaspruunid. Akt maalitud modelleerivas, kumerusi rõhutavas laadis. Aktist paremal all lasipuu ning musta lehviga kingituskorv, ülal vasakul vanamoodsa auto nina. Auto taga olev foon on ooker-punane, ülejäänud fooni moodustavad põhiliselt külmrohelised ja sinakad pinnad.
6379.de: In the centre, against the background of a white house, a female nude turned slightly to the right, hands interlaced around the head, face in profile, short reddish-brown hair. The nude is painted in a modelling manner emphasising curves. Below right of the nude a wisteria and a gift basket with a black bow, above left the nose of an old-fashioned car. The background behind the car is ochre-red, the rest of the background consists mainly of cold green and bluish surfaces.

6382.d: Ateljees, avatud akna all selili asendis naisakt: pea pööratud akna poole, parem käsi kõverdatult õla juures, vasak lebab küljel heledal draperiil, mis ulatub üle aknalaua välja. Parem jalg põlvest kõverdatud, vasak sirgelt teisel lebamas. Modelli pea juures nahktugitooli nurk, osa kannust. Aknast langev valgus muudab keha heledaks, luues siniseid varje. Ümbritsev foon maalitud sinakaspruunide abstraktsete laikudena. Ligi pool ülemisest pildiosast kujutab aknast ülaltvaadet roosakaspruunile, rohekale männimetsa-alusele, mis peegeldub aknaklaasidel.
6382.de: In a studio, under an open window, a female nude lying on her back: her head turned towards the window, her right arm bent at the shoulder, her left lying on her side on a light-coloured drapery that extends over the windowsill and out. Her right leg is bent at the knee, her left lying straight on the other. Near the model's head is the corner of a leather armchair, part of the heel visible. The light falling from the window makes the body pale, creating blue shadows. The surrounding background is painted as abstract patches of bluish brown. Almost half of the upper part of the picture depicts a view from above through the window onto a pinkish-brown, greenish forest floor under pines, which is reflected in the window panes.

6427.d: Õrnades sinakates ja roosakates toonides kõrged hambulised mäetipud.
6427.de: In delicate bluish and pinkish tones, tall jagged mountain peaks.

6429.d: Kuldpruunil foonil, pruunide, veidi laines juustega ja kahvatusiniste silmadega pruunis kleidis naise rinnaportree, otsevaates.
6429.de: Bust portrait of a woman in a brown dress, in frontal view, with brown, slightly wavy hair and pale blue eyes, on a golden-brown background.

6430.d: Keskplaanil tumehall suur kivi, ümbritsetud pruuniga, taevas sinkjas. Ees õrnades toonides taimemotiivid.
6430.de: In the middle ground a large dark grey stone, surrounded by brown, the sky bluish. In front, plant motifs in delicate tones.

6433.d: Kollasel foonil suure, turjaka mehe rinnaportree vaatega paremale. Mees lühikese lõuahabemega, punaste põskedega, seljas tume kuub sinise kampsuniga.
6433.de: Bust portrait against a yellow background of a large, sturdy man looking to the right. The man has a short chin beard, red cheeks, wearing a dark coat with a blue jumper.

6435.d: Noore naise portree kerge pöördega vasakule. Hele näonahk, punased põsed, juuksed kammitud pealaele. Tumeroheline pullover, kaelas peen kett. Foon kollakas-roheline. Valge läikiv raam.
6435.de: Portrait of a young woman with a slight turn to the left. Light facial skin, red cheeks, hair combed up to the crown. Dark green pullover, a fine chain around the neck. Yellowish-green background. White glossy frame.

6438.d: Maal sinakas-rohelistes toonides, keskosa tume, servades helenev - kus ebamäärselt  eraldatavad maastiku piirjooned.
6438.de: Painting in bluish-green tones, dark in the centre, glowing at the edges - where the outlines of the landscape are vaguely discernible.

6439.d: Poole pildi pinnast võtab enda alla erksinine, kergete õrnlillade varjunditega veepind, milles suured pruunikad kivipangad. Taamal kõrguvad teravatipulised mäed.
6439.de: Half of the picture surface is taken up by a bright blue water surface with light lilac shades, in which large brownish rock masses lie. In the distance, sharp-peaked mountains rise.

6440.d: Kogu lõuend maalitud summutatud sinistes toonides, mõnes kohas kergelt rõhutatud mägede kontuurid. Ülal servas hajuvate servadega valkjas-hall pilveviirg. Paremal järsult alla langev veejuga.
6440.de: The whole canvas painted in muted blue tones, in places the contours of mountains lightly emphasised. Along the top edge a whitish-grey streak of cloud with diffuse edges. On the right a waterfall plunging steeply downward.

6441.d: 2/3 pildipinnast võtab enda alla lumine rannariba. Tagaplaanil tumehall veepind kolme jääpangaga ning kitsas taevariba.
6441.de: 2/3 of the picture surface is taken up by a snowy strip of shore. In the background a dark grey water surface with three ice floes and a narrow strip of sky.

6442.d: Hallide, kergelt lainjate juustega vanema naise portree otsevaates. Näole annavad ilme eriti suured silmad. Kaelus eest avatud. Portree on maalitud heledas, hallis koloriidis, värvikiht õhuke.
6442.de: Frontal portrait of an older woman with grey, slightly wavy hair. Her expression is marked especially by large eyes. Collar open at front. The portrait is painted in a light, grey colour scheme, the paint layer thin.

6443.d: Suures plaanis tugevate põsesarnade ja energilise lõuaga, veidi melanhoolse ilmega noore naise rinnaportree otsevaates. Suurte pruunide silmade pilk suunatud vasakule. Seljas kirsipunane sviiter. Lühikesed pruunid juuksed sulavad ühte tumeda taustaga. Vasakul foon helendav.
6443.de: A close-up bust portrait, frontal view, of a young woman with strong cheekbones and an energetic chin, with a slightly melancholic expression. The gaze of the large brown eyes is directed to the left. She is wearing a cherry-red sweater. Short brown hair merges with the dark background. On the left the background is luminous.

6444.d: Süngevõitu kipraskulmulise mehe rindportree otsevaates, seljas tume ülikond punase pulloveriga. Taust jaotatud järsult tumedaks pinnaks ülaosas ja heledaks allpool.
6444.de: Frontal bust portrait of a somewhat sombre, frowning man, wearing a dark suit with a red pullover. The background divided sharply into a dark surface in the upper part and a light one below.

6445.d: Hallikasvalgel foonil naise portree otsevaates, valges baretis, väikeste kuldsete kõrvarõngastega. Roosad huuled, helesinised silmad, kõrged peened kulmukaared. Seljas helehall sinakate varjudega sviiter viie beeži vertikaaljoonega rinnal.
6445.de: Against a greyish-white background, a frontal portrait of a woman, in a white beret, with small gold earrings. Pink lips, light blue eyes, high thin arched eyebrows. Wearing a light grey sweater with bluish shadows and five beige vertical lines on the chest.

6446.d: Pruunis pintsakus ja mustas ballonis noore mehe portree otsevaates, pea kerges pöördes paremale, veidi kallutatud vasakule (vaataja suhtes). Lai nägu tahtejõulise lõuaga. lühike sirge nina, rasked laud, hallid silmad. Tumesinine foon, maali vasakus servas oranžikas valguskuma. Maali vasakus servas kogu kompositsiooni kõrgust läbiv hallikassinine kitsas liist.
6446.de: Portrait of a young man in a brown jacket and black balloon-sleeved garment, frontal view, head slightly turned to the right, tilted slightly to the left (relative to the viewer). A broad face with a strong-willed chin, a short straight nose, heavy eyelids, grey eyes. Dark blue background, an orangeish glow of light in the left edge of the painting. In the left edge of the painting, a narrow greyish-blue strip running the full height of the composition.

6447.d: Maalipind jaotatud pruuni liistuga neljaks. Vasakul ülal pruunide juustega tütarlapse pea ning tumedapäise noormehe pea proofilis vasakule. Samas paremal valget mütsi kandva noore naise pea, pöördes vasakule; tema taga, kuklaga vaataja poole valges sviitris, tumedate juustega naine. All paremal vana, tugevate põsesarnadega ja kitsaste, kokkusurutud huultega naise rinnaportree. Samas vasakul tumedal taustal keskel punane ning hallikas horisontaalne lainjas joon, ülal vasakus nurgas kollakas kuma. Ülaosas taustaks meremaastik. Maalitud tumedates, pastelsetes toonides. Kontuurid hajuvad.
6447.de: The painting surface is divided into four by a brown strip. Upper left, the head of a brown-haired girl and, in profile facing left, the head of a dark-haired young man. In the same section, on the right, the head of a young woman wearing a white cap, turned to the left; behind her, seen from the back facing the viewer, in a white sweater, a dark-haired woman. Lower right, a bust portrait of an old woman with strong cheekbones and narrow, pressed-together lips. In the same section, on the left, against a dark background, in the middle a red and greyish horizontal wavy line, in the upper left corner a yellowish glow. In the upper part, a seascape as background. Painted in dark, pastel tones. The contours are blurred.

6557.d: Suur figuraalne kompositsioon tähtsamate eesti vanema ja noorema põlvkonna kunstnike portreedega. Vasakpoolsel tiival all paremal E. Okka autoportree. Teiste kunstnike portreed vahelduvad mitmesuguste reaaliatega. Vasakul tiival all koer ning maalimistarbed, tort, ülaservas ehituskonstruktsioonid. Keskosas all roosas õhulises kleidis ja punase parukaga mannekeen, klaasmull ning aktifiguur ülal. Paremal tiival all avatud raamat pildil kujutautud kunstnike numbrite ja nimedega, sulg, öökull. Parempoolse tiiva ülaservas treppide ja sammastega ehitused ning tormav hobune. Portreede vahel taimi, lilli ja kõrsi.
6557.de: A large figural composition with portraits of the most important Estonian artists of the older and younger generations. On the left wing, lower right, a self-portrait of E. Okas. The portraits of other artists alternate with various realia. On the left wing below, a dog and painting implements, a cake, and building structures at the upper edge. In the middle section below, a mannequin in a pink airy dress with a red wig, a glass bubble, and a nude figure above. On the right wing below, an open book with the numbers and names of the artists depicted in the picture, a quill, an owl. At the upper edge of the right wing, buildings with stairs and columns and a galloping horse. Between the portraits, plants, flowers and stalks.

6582.d: Esiplaanil üle kogu pildi pinna roheka mere taustal suur mitmeharuline puutüvi.
6582.de: In the foreground, across the entire surface of the picture, against a background of a greenish sea, a large multi-branched tree trunk.

6748.d: Pildil keskel tumedal foonil, valgel riidel, tumesinine vaas nartsisside ja krookustega.
6748.de: In the middle of the picture, against a dark background, on white cloth, a dark blue vase with narcissi and crocuses.

6749.d: Hämar, sumedalt elektrilampidega valgustatud ruum, laes mitut tüüpi valgustatud ruum, laes mitut tüüpi valgusteid. Vasakus nurgas heledapäine, roosa pluusiga ja tumedapäine rohelises naine. Tagaplaanil paistab läni klaasuste ja -akende hele päev. Sees domineerivad kuldpruunid toonid, kõik piirjooned on hajutatud.
6749.de: Dim room softly lit by electric lamps, several types of light fixtures on the ceiling, several types of light fixtures on the ceiling. In the left corner a fair-haired woman in a pink blouse and a dark-haired woman in green. In the background bright daylight is visible through glass doors and windows. Golden-brown tones dominate inside, all contours are diffused.

6767.d: Esiplaanil keskel pildi sügavusse, kahel pool asetsevate puude vahele kaduv pargitee. Teest vasakul ja paremal põõsad, kaugemal ühtse massiivina antud rohelus, millest kerkib punaste katustega Kuressaare loss. Suurema osa pildist võtab enda alla illusioorsete pilvedega sinine taevas.
6767.de: In the foreground in the middle, a park path disappearing into the depth of the picture between trees standing on both sides. To the left and right of the path bushes, further away greenery given as a solid mass, out of which rises Kuressaare Castle with red roofs. Most of the picture is taken up by a blue sky with illusory clouds.

6808.d: Suurte pehmetooniliste värvipindadena, laiade pintslitõmmetega maalitud järvepinnal peegelduv kaldamaastik. Veepiir kompositsiooni horisontaalteljel. Tagaplaanil vasemal ja paremal kõrgemad puudesalud, esiplaanil lauskmaa üksikute põõsastega. Paremal veepiiril väike maanina, kaldal kõrge väike puudesalu.
6808.de: A shoreline landscape reflected on the surface of a lake, painted in large soft-toned patches of colour with broad brush strokes. The waterline on the horizontal axis of the composition. In the background, on the left and right, taller groves of trees, in the foreground flat land with solitary bushes. On the right at the waterline a small spit of land, on the shore a tall small grove of trees.

6809.d: Kompositsiooni vasemal poolel roheliste täppidega kollases kleidis tüse blond naine profiilis paremale, suur münt sõrmede vahel. Paremal kaks kätt ulatavad talle kolme karikakart. Ülemise serva ääres paremal hele lillakassinine kuu.
6809.de: On the left half of the composition, a plump blonde woman in a yellow dress with green dots, in profile facing right, a large coin between her fingers. On the right two hands reach out to her, offering three daisies. Near the upper edge on the right a pale lilac-blue moon.

6810.d: Pildil tehaseruum. Esiplaanil paremal nokaga mütsis ja kaitsevärvi töörõivastes mees tööpingi taga, käised üles kääritud. Tagapool teise tööpingi juures töötava mehe siluett. Foonil suur väikestest ruutudest koosnev klaasaken, millest paistab läbi helesinine sõiduauto. Laest ripub kaks massiivset kraanakonksu ja juhtmeid. Kogu pilt sinakas-hallides värvitoonides.
6810.de: The picture shows a factory room. In the foreground on the right a man in a peaked cap and camouflage-coloured work clothes at a workbench, sleeves rolled up. Further back the silhouette of a man working at another workbench. In the background a large window made of small squares, through which a light blue automobile is visible. Two massive crane hooks and wires hang from the ceiling. The whole picture in bluish-grey colour tones.

6858.d: Aknalaual vaasides ja purkides punaseid roose, nelke ja muid lilli. Aknast avaneb vaade männimetsale.
6858.de: On the windowsill, red roses, carnations and other flowers in vases and jars. From the window a view opens onto a pine forest.

6860.d: Vaade vana Tallinna mere lähedusse jäävale osale kõrgelt ülalt: esiplaanil Lai t., punaste katustega majad, tagapool Oleviste kirik. Silmapiiril meri, sadamakraanad paremal ja kahvatu hall taevas. Maalitud hõredate, aluspinda läbi kumada laskvate pintslilöökidega, objektide kontuure rõhutades.
6860.de: A view of the part of old Tallinn near the sea, from high above: in the foreground Lai t., houses with red roofs, further back St. Olaf's Church. On the horizon the sea, harbour cranes on the right and a pale grey sky. Painted with sparse brushstrokes through which the underlying surface shines through, emphasising the contours of the objects.

6881.d: Kolmest figuuripaarist kompositsioon: vasakul servas külitsi kaks vestlevat noormeest, paremal tumedapäise noormehe käsi ümber traksidega pükstes tüdruku õla. Keskel vasakul peaaegu kiilaspäine keskealine mees, käed vaheliti, pilk kontsentreeritult vaatajal.
6881.de: A composition of three pairs of figures: on the left edge, two young men conversing side by side, on the right the arm of a dark-haired young man around the shoulder of a girl wearing trousers with suspenders. In the middle left, an almost bald middle-aged man, hands folded, gaze concentrated on the viewer.

6899.d: Teravas valguse-varju kontrastis antud figuur pöördes paremale. Lühikesed tumedad juuksed, pilusilmad, naeratav suu, käed põlvedel. Peast paremal diagonaalis kollane ja punane laserikiirt meenutav triip. Foon tume, risti-rästi värvilistest joontest läbi põimitud, vasakul ülemises neljandikus kaks nelinurka, all valge, punaste horisontaaljoontega tahvel või paberileht. Kohati väga pastoosne.
6899.de: A figure given in sharp light-shadow contrast, turned to the right. Short dark hair, narrow eyes, a smiling mouth, hands on the knees. To the right of the head, diagonally, a yellow and red stripe resembling a laser beam. Background dark, criss-crossed with colourful lines, in the upper left quarter two rectangles, below a white board or sheet of paper with red horizontal lines. In places very impasto.

6905.d: Sinises sportliku lõikega mantlis istuva prillidega naise täisfiguur en-face, vasem õlg kergelt tahapoole, pea kerges pöördes paremale. Seljas beež sviiter, helepruun seelik, parem jalg üle põlve tõstetud. Täidlased jalad, pruunid sukksaapad. Parem käsi vabalt süles, vasak vabalt rippuva käelabaga toetub toolileenile. Käharad helepruunid juuksed, lai nägu. Summutatud üldtoon, neutraalne foon.
6905.de: A full figure, en-face, of a bespectacled woman sitting in a blue sportily cut coat, left shoulder slightly turned back, head slightly turned to the right. Wearing a beige sweater, a light brown skirt, right leg crossed over the knee. Plump legs, brown suede boots. Right hand resting loosely in the lap, left hand with a loosely hanging palm resting on the arm of the chair. Curly light brown hair, a broad face. Muted overall tone, neutral background.

6974.d: Istuva, rohelises riietuses vanema naise kolmveerandfiguur poolpöördes vasakule, käed toolileenil. Foon kollakates ja pruunikates toonides.
6974.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated older woman dressed in green, turned halfway to the left, hands resting on the chair back. The background is in yellowish and brownish tones.

6975.d: Kolme istuva tütarlapse kolmveerandfiguurid.Vasakus ääres olev tütarlaps poolpöördes paremale, ülejäänud kaks otsevaates. Kõigil kolmel käed kokkupandult süles.
6975.de: Three-quarter figures of three seated girls. The girl on the left edge in a half-turn to the right, the other two in frontal view. All three have their hands folded in their laps.

6976.d: Ees suures plaanis põlvele toetuv palja ülakehaga mees, kes suure kruvivõtmega töötab rööbastel. Maalitud pruunikates ja helesinistes toonides, plastilist vormi tükeldavalt modelleerides.
6976.de: In the foreground, in large scale, a bare-chested man resting on his knee, working on the rails with a large wrench. Painted in brownish and light blue tones, modelling the plastic form in a fragmenting manner.

6980.d: Kõrge horisondiga, perspektiivilise kahanemiseta laual, mida katab ristuvate sirgete mustade ja hallide joontega ruuduline laudlina, asetsevad paremal ees suure tila ja käepidemega metallist kohvikann, selle taga vasemal 3-liitriline klaaspurk ja paremal kruus. Kompositsiooni vasemal osal tagapool etiketiga pudel selle kõrval asuva pruuni kõrge, pealt lahtitehtud paberist pakiga ning nende ees väikesemustriline punane pearätik. Fooniks pruun draperii punakaspruunide ja sinakasmustade varjudega.
6980.de: On a table with a high horizon and no perspective diminution, covered with a checked tablecloth of crossing straight black and grey lines, there stands in front on the right a metal coffee pot with a large spout and handle, behind it on the left a 3-litre glass jar and on the right a mug. In the left part of the composition, further back, a bottle with a label next to a tall brown paper package opened at the top, and in front of them a small-patterned red headscarf. The background is a brown drapery with reddish-brown and bluish-black shadows.

6981.d: Kompositsiooni kõrguse alumisel kolmveerandil meri, mis on maalitud sirgete horisontaalsete, enamasti paralleelsete joonte vahele jäävate värvipindadega (pruunikad, kollakad, helesinised, mustad, rohekad, lillakas-sinised). Esiplaanil ees kolm väikest ja vasakul keskplaanil suurem kivi, modelleeritud sirgete teravate kontuuride ja joontega. Pilvine taevas.
6981.de: In the lower three-quarters of the composition's height, the sea, painted with patches of colour between straight, mostly parallel horizontal lines (brownish, yellowish, light blue, black, greenish, purplish-blue). In the foreground, three small stones, and in the left middle ground a larger stone, modelled with straight, sharp contours and lines. Cloudy sky.

6982.d: Kompositsiooni vertikaalteljest veidi paremal hallide ja pruunide sirgjoontega modelleeritud kortsulise näoga vana naise portree otsevaates, kerges pöördes vasemale, pea veidi paremale kallutatud. Hallid, tagasikammitud juuksed lahuga vasakul pool (vaataja suhtes), kolmnurkse rinnasisselõikega ja suure kraega pruunis kleidis. Hallid silmad. Hallikassinine, kohati kollakaspruun foon.
6982.de: Slightly to the right of the vertical axis of the composition, a frontal portrait of an old woman with a wrinkled face modelled with grey and brown straight lines, in a slight turn to the left, head tilted slightly to the right. Grey, combed-back hair with a parting on the left side (in relation to the viewer), wearing a brown dress with a triangular neckline and a large collar. Grey eyes. Greyish-blue, in places yellowish-brown background.

6991.d: Punastes ja rohelistes toonides abstraktsetest värvilaikudest koosnev kompositsioon. Keskel üksikud kollased laigud.
6991.de: Composition of abstract colour patches in red and green tones. Isolated yellow patches in the centre.

6992.d: Tugevasti geometriseeritud vormidega natüürmort: ees keskel äratuntavamalt antud pika kaelaga vaas, millel keerulise konfiguratsiooniga sang. Kompositsiooni põhiosa moodustab kollaste ja lillakaspruunide värvipindade kombinatsioon.
6992.de: Strongly geometricised still life: in the middle foreground, a more recognisably rendered long-necked vase with a handle of complex configuration. The main part of the composition consists of a combination of yellow and purplish-brown colour areas.

6993.d: Osaliselt selgepiirilistest, enamasti pinnalistest värvikatest kujunditest poolabstraktne kompositsioon. Ülal türkiissinisel taustal aimatavad hoonete kujutised. Keskel, rohekaskollakal põhjal tinglikult maalitud taimemotiive.
6993.de: Semi-abstract composition of partly sharply defined, mostly flat, coloured shapes. Above, against a turquoise-blue background, discernible images of buildings. In the centre, on a greenish-yellowish ground, conventionally painted plant motifs.

6994.d: Figuraalne kompositsioon rannal lebavatest ja istuvatest inimestest. Ees vasakul raamatuga mehe kuju, vasakus ülanurgas paistavad naisterahva jalad. Keskel heledapäine külitav naine helesinises trikoos, tagapool kollases päevituskostüümis lebav naine, päikeseprillidega mees. Paremal istuv mees, tops käes, osa naisfiguurist sinises kostüümis. Mahedad hallikaspruunid toonid, üldistav maalilaad.
6994.de: A figural composition of people lying and sitting on a beach. In front on the left a man's figure with a book, in the upper left corner a woman's legs can be seen. In the centre a light-haired woman lying on her side in a light blue swimsuit, further back a woman lying in a yellow sunbathing costume, a man with sunglasses. On the right a sitting man with a cup in his hand, part of a female figure in a blue costume. Mellow greyish-brown tones, generalising painting manner.

6995.d: Lillakal maastikulisel foonil kikkhabeme ja vuntsidega mehe poolfiguur veerandpöördes paremale, mantel üle käe. Paremal, vaataja suunas hundikoera kuju. Heledad pastelsed toonid, pooltinglik maalilaad.
6995.de: Against a purplish landscape background, the half-figure of a man with a goatee and moustache in a quarter-turn to the right, coat over his arm. On the right, facing the viewer, the figure of a wolfhound. Light pastel tones, semi-conventional painterly style.

6996.d: Kääruline rannaäär üksikute rohekate kõrkjatuttidega. Keskel kolm seisvat figuuri rannarõivais. Vasakpoolne, kollases trikoos naine jalgupidi vees. Hallikad ja ookertoonid, tinglik käsitlus.
6996.de: A curving shoreline with solitary greenish tufts of sedge. In the middle three standing figures in beach clothing. On the left, a woman in a yellow leotard standing in the water. Greyish and ochre tones, conventional treatment.

7020.d: Ühtlasel heledal sinakasrohelisel taustal fragmente interjöörist: paremal vana õmblusmasin, tooli seljatugi selle tagant paistmas, paremal ülal raaminurk mööbli kaunistusmotiiv, vasakul ülal jalaga õmblusmasina väike kujutis. Maali keskosas leentoolis istuvad heledapäine noor naine ja naerusuine tüdruk, kass süles. Naisel seljas täpiline pluus, jalas pikad püksid, hoiab käevangus tüdrukut ja kassi, pilk neile suunatud. Nende taga taburetitaolisel alusel mehe pea, kaabu silmadel. Kasutatud slaidi, refleksid, varjud selgepiiriliste toonilaikudega pinnaliselt maalitud.
7020.de: Against an even, light bluish-green background, fragments of an interior: on the right an old sewing machine, the back of a chair visible behind it, in the upper right corner of a frame a furniture decoration motif, in the upper left a small depiction of a treadle sewing machine. In the centre of the painting, a fair-haired young woman and a laughing girl with a cat in her lap are sitting in an armchair. The woman is wearing a spotted blouse and long trousers, holding the girl and the cat in her arms, her gaze directed at them. Behind them, on a stool-like stand, a man's head, hat over his eyes. A slide has been used, reflections, shadows painted flatly with clearly delineated patches of colour.

7021.d: Kõrge, ühtlaselt helesinise taeva taustal, ererohelisel, üksikute põõsastega niidul naerunäoga neiu istumas. Noorikul seljas tumesinine, punaste natide, tikitud käiste, punase põllega setu rahvarüiivad, peas pärg. Kasutatud slaidi, jätab suurendatud värvifoto mulje.
7021.de: Against a background of a high, evenly light blue sky, a smiling-faced girl sits on a bright green meadow with solitary bushes. The young woman wears dark blue Setu folk costume with red details, embroidered sleeves, a red apron, a wreath on her head. A slide has been used, giving the impression of an enlarged colour photograph.

7037.d: Pruunis vestis ja särgis istuva prillidega mehe poolfiguur, kehaga kerges pöördes paremale, pea kallutatud veidi vasemale, poolprofiilis paremale, terav pilk suunatud vaatajale; käed vabalt süles. Sirge lühike, veidi esiletungiv nina, taha kammitud hallikassegused juuksed, kortsuline nägu tahtejõulise lõuaga, alaspidiste suunurkadega huultega, kõik modelleeritud teravate sirgete joontega. All vasemal, lauanurgal väike lapik pudel tumeda korgiga. Hallikasroheline neutraalne foon ülalpool, all geometriseeritud tumerohelised ja pruunid pinnad.
7037.de: Half-figure of a bespectacled man sitting in a brown waistcoat and shirt, his body slightly turned to the right, head tilted slightly to the left, in three-quarter profile to the right, a sharp gaze directed at the viewer; hands resting loosely in his lap. A straight, short, slightly protruding nose, grayish-mixed hair combed back, a wrinkled face with a determined chin, lips with downturned corners of the mouth, all modelled with sharp straight lines. At lower left, at the corner of the table, a small flat bottle with a dark cork. A greyish-green neutral background above, below geometricised dark green and brown surfaces.

7038.d: Kollakasbeežil alusel, mida katab pruun draperii, mis moodustab tagaplaanil fooni maali laiuse enamiku osas ning mille äär langeb vabalt üle aluse esiserva, asetsevad keskteljest veidi paremal kõrge laia kaelaga klaaskann, vasakul vormileib paberil, selle ees, vasakus kuldlõikes kaks suurt sibulat. Paremal väikesel supitaldrikul suur glasuuritud hele hallikassinine kruus.
7038.de: On a yellowish-beige base covered by a brown drapery, which forms the background across most of the width of the painting and whose edge falls loosely over the front edge of the base, slightly right of the central axis stand a tall, wide-necked glass jug, on the left a loaf of bread on paper, in front of it, in the left golden section, two large onions. On the right, on a small soup plate, a large glazed light greyish-blue mug.

7040.d: Kompositsioon kööginõudest ja -tarvetest pruunil alusel ning teravalt kontuuridega modelleeritud voldistikuga kollase draperii taustal,  milles esinevad beežikad, sinepikollased, helepruunid, lillad teravalt piiritletud varjundid. Esiplaanil keskel gaasipliidi küttekolde nõudealus, paremal äärel spiraalvahusti. Tagaplaanil vasakul emaileeritud roheline teekann, selle kõrval seebitoos roosaka seebiga, nende ees suur sinise triibuga valge kruus. Paremas kuldlõikes tagaplaanil valgel paberilehel priimus, sellest paremal tagapool suur klaaspurk.
7040.de: A composition of kitchen dishes and utensils on a brown base, against the background of a sharply contoured, modelled folded yellow drapery in which sharply delineated beige, mustard-yellow, light brown, and lilac shades appear. In the foreground, in the centre, a pot stand from a gas stove burner, on the right edge a spiral whisk. In the background at left, an enamelled green teapot, next to it a soap dish with pinkish soap, in front of them a large white mug with a blue stripe. In the background, in the right golden section, on a white sheet of paper, a primus stove, to the right and behind it a large glass jar.

7041.d: Istuva mehe rinnafiguur, pea ja ülakeha kergelt vasemale pööratud, vasak käsi toetub kõrgemale alusele. Pruunid juuksed, sinakashall pintsak, pruun vest ja beež pullover. Eriti mehe nägu ning käsi on modelleeritud tihedate erivärviliste pintslilöökidega. Elektri- ja hallikassinine foon.
7041.de: Half-length figure of a seated man, head and upper body turned slightly to the left, left hand resting on a raised support. Brown hair, bluish-grey jacket, brown waistcoat and beige pullover. Especially the man's face and hand are modelled with dense brushstrokes of varying colours. Electric and greyish-blue background.

7044.d: Tallinna panoraamvaade. Esiplaanil vasakul jämedad kanalisatsioonitorud ja lage tühermaa, keskplaanis väikeste majade katusteräga, tagaplaanil eralduvad foonil hotell "Viru" ja Oleviste kiriku siluetid. Maalitud pastelltoonides joonte, geomeetriliste värvipindade kombinatsioonina kohati krunti paista lastes.
7044.de: Panoramic view of Tallinn. In the foreground on the left thick sewage pipes and bare wasteland, in the middle ground the roof ridges of small houses, in the background the silhouettes of the hotel "Viru" and St. Olaf's Church stand out against the background. Painted in pastel tones as a combination of lines and geometric colour surfaces, with the ground occasionally allowed to show through.

7048.d: Esiplaanil kaks mehe- ja kaks naisefiguuri. Figuuri üksikelemente markeeriv nurgeline joonistus selgelt näha. Vasakus ülanurgas veekogu, keskel hooned, pildi ülaosas silmapiiril rohelistes, sinistes ja ookritoonides mägine maastik. Kogu kompositsioon geomeetriliselt liigendatud ning värviga kaetud.
7048.de: In the foreground two male and two female figures. The angular drawing marking the individual elements of the figures is clearly visible. In the upper left corner a body of water, in the centre buildings, at the top of the picture on the horizon a mountainous landscape in green, blue and ochre tones. The whole composition articulated geometrically and covered with colour.

7053.d: Otsevaates, istuva hallipäise mehe portree. Mõlemad käed toetuvad põlvedele, seljas mereroheline kindralimunder aumärkidega rinnal ja pagunitega õlal. Kortsuline nägu sinakashallil foonil, mis vasakul läheb üle helesiniseks ja paremal kollaseks, all vasakus servas on foon pruun. Maalitud kunstnikule tüüpilises värvilaikudest ja -joontest tervikut kombineerides.
7053.de: A frontal-view portrait of a seated grey-haired man. Both hands rest on the knees, wearing a sea-green general's uniform with decorations on the chest and epaulettes on the shoulders. A wrinkled face against a bluish-grey background, which turns light blue on the left and yellow on the right, and in the lower left corner the background is brown. Painted in the artist's typical manner of combining the whole from patches and lines of colour.

7069.d: Istuva vanema mehe põlvportree. Mehel seljas lahtise kaelusega helesinine särk ja hallid püksid, käed puhkavad põlvedel. Nägu tõmmu, kergelt kongus ninaga, kitsa suu ja esileulatuva lõuaga. Hallid lühikesed juuksed, juustepiir meelekohtadelt taandunud. Fooniks majade, trammi ja bussiga skematiseeritud linnavaade. Maalitud joonte ja värvipindade räguna heledates pastelsetes toonides.
7069.de: Knee-length portrait of a seated elderly man. The man is wearing a light blue open-collared shirt and grey trousers, his hands resting on his knees. His face is swarthy, with a slightly hooked nose, narrow mouth and a protruding chin. Short grey hair, hairline receded at the temples. The background is a schematised cityscape with houses, a tram and a bus. Painted in a jumble of lines and colour surfaces in light pastel tones.

7070.d: Paremalt ookrikarva, vasakult taevasinisel foonil soliidne hallis ülikonnas vanem mees käetugedega toolis istumas. Mehel hallid lühikesed juuksed, kolmnurgaks kokkupigistatud suu ja otsast punetav nina. Vasak käsi puhkab tooli käetoel, parem põlvel. Figuuriosa antud väikeste värvikildude kombinatsioonina.
7070.de: Against an ochre-coloured background on the right and a sky-blue background on the left, a solid elderly man in a grey suit sitting in an armchair. The man has short grey hair, a mouth pressed into a triangle, and a reddening tip of the nose. Left hand resting on the armrest, right hand on the knee. The figure part rendered as a combination of small patches of colour.

7072.d: 3/4 alumisest maaliosast kujutab osalt selgepiirilisi geometriseeritud, osalt abstraktseid kollase-rohelise-halli kooskõlas pindu. Vasakul puutüve motiiv. Selle kohal arhitektuuridetailidega linnavisioon. Paremal ülal, vesihalli taeva foonil Niguliste tornikiiver.
7072.de: 3/4 of the lower part of the painting depicts partly clear-outlined geometricised, partly abstract surfaces in a harmony of yellow-green-grey. On the left a tree-trunk motif. Above it a city vision with architectural details. At the upper right, against a watery-grey sky background, the spire of St. Nicholas' Church (Niguliste).

7073.d: Poolenisti erksinise taeva ja roheluse taustal keskel kaks puud. Paremal joonterägastikuga oksi markeeriv kuuse motiiv, vasakul lehtpuu. Maal rohelistes-sinistes toonides rahutu pintslikäiguga.
7073.de: Against a background half bright blue sky and half greenery, in the centre two trees. On the right a fir motif marking branches with a tangle of lines, on the left a deciduous tree. The painting is in green-blue tones with a restless brushstroke.

7079.d: Rohekaspruunil taustal, punasel alusel pruunikas ümar vaas suure buketi kirevate põllulilledega (karikakrad, kellukesed, ohakad jm.). Maalitud väga pastoosselt, iga õit värviga plastiliselt vormides.
7079.de: On a greenish-brown background, on a red base, a brownish round vase with a large bouquet of colourful field flowers (daisies, bluebells, thistles etc.). Painted very pastosely, each flower plastically shaped with colour.

7087.d: Tuhmile temperaga alusmaalile kantud puhta värvi plekkidega sõudjate figuurid ja veepinna läiked.
7087.de: Figures of rowers and the gleam of the water's surface applied in patches of pure colour over a dull tempera underpainting.

7167.d: Tumedal palkseinal ripub pommidega seinakell ja kolme valge luigega vaip. Esiplaanil vana, puust kirst.
7167.de: On a dark log wall hangs a pendulum wall clock and a rug with three white swans. In the foreground an old wooden chest.

7168.d: Keset rohelist välja rohtusöövate lammaste kari. Silmapiiril tumesinine viirg. Taevas kaks suurt valget pilve.
7168.de: A flock of grazing sheep amid a green field. On the horizon a dark blue stripe. In the sky two large white clouds.

7192.d: Ebamäärases, värvilistest valgustest täidetud ruumis keskel vertikaaljoonel mannekeenitaoline inimene sinise nelinurga taga. Sellest eespool suurt küpsist meenutav kujund ning üks lillas, teine oranžis valguses saabas. All vasakus nurgas pika antenniga raadiovastuvõtja. Vasakus ülemises neljandikus lendavat taldrikut või kosmoseaparaati meenutav ese. Ruumi markeerivad värvilised pinnad.
7192.de: In an indeterminate space filled with coloured lights, in the centre on a vertical line a mannequin-like figure behind a blue quadrangle. In front of it a shape resembling a large biscuit, and one boot in purple light, another in orange light. In the lower left corner a radio receiver with a long antenna. In the upper left quarter an object resembling a flying saucer or spacecraft. Coloured surfaces mark the space.

7292.d: Esiplaanil Emajõgi. Paremalpoolsel kaldal suured mullahunnikud; pildi servaga osaliselt äralõigatud turuhoone. Kaugemalt paistab sild ning linn. Koloriit tume - hallid, pruunid toonid.
7292.de: In the foreground the Emajõgi river. On the right-hand bank large piles of earth; the market hall, partly cut off by the edge of the picture. In the distance a bridge and the town can be seen. The colouring is dark - grey, brown tones.

7299.d: Vaade järvele ja kahele ümarikule rohelisele saarele. Hoogsalt maalitud sinistes, rohelistes toonides Lõuna-Eesti maastik. Taamal sinavad kõrgendikud.
7299.de: A view of a lake and two roundish green islands. A South Estonian landscape painted vigorously in blue and green tones. Highlands loom bluish in the distance.

7302.d: Hallikas-sinistes toonides staatiline järvevaade. Vasakul tumedatest metsamassiividest kallas, taamal laugjad sinised mäed, ees pruunikas liivariba. Sinakashall veepind peegeldab kaldaid. Taevas hall.
7302.de: A static lake view in greyish-blue tones. On the left a shore with dark forest masses, in the distance gently sloping blue mountains, in the foreground a brownish strip of sand. The bluish-grey water surface reflects the shores. The sky is grey.

7372.d: Pildil keskel ning vasakus ääres kolm mahajäetud taluhoonet; keskmise maja ees kaev. Poole pildipinnast võtab enda alla pilvitu taevas. Maapind ja majade katused faktuursed.
7372.de: In the middle and on the left edge of the picture, three abandoned farm buildings; in front of the middle house a well. Half of the picture surface is taken up by a cloudless sky. The ground and the roofs of the houses are textured.

7373.d: Esiplaanil, keset viljapõldu, suur punane vilja koristav kombain vaataja poole sõitmas. Kombaini katusel punane lipp, juhisillal seisab mees. Horisontaalsest keskjoonest kõrgemal helesinine taevas üle selle ulatuva pilvesäbruga. Kombain vaarikpunane, viljapõld pruunikaskollane, väga pastoosselt maalitud.
7373.de: In the foreground, in the middle of a grain field, a large red combine harvester harvesting grain, driving towards the viewer. A red flag on the roof of the combine, a man standing on the driving platform. Above the horizontal centre line, a light blue sky with a fringe of clouds extending across it. The combine raspberry-red, the grain field brownish-yellow, painted very impasto.

7374.d: Pastoossetes, lopsakates, võbisevates vormides rohuaed katkeva puittaraga keskplaanil ning selle taga kõrgete lehtpuudega. Vasemas ülemises nurgas, teineteise peal, kaks abstraktset, ristkülikukujulise tahveldisega toaseina, nendel rippuvate kahe pruunikaspunase, raamitud pildiga. Paremal äärel, rohu seest väljaarenev, kliiverpurje kujuline, valge, vormitute rohekate ja roosakate varjunditega pind ning selle juures väike, kollane, peen mastike ühe vandiga. Faktuurne pintslikäsitlus. Ülal valkjas-helesinine, horisondi kohal hallikas-valge taevas.
7374.de: A pasty, lush, quivering vegetable garden with a broken wooden fence in the middle ground, and behind it tall deciduous trees. In the upper left corner, one above the other, two abstract room walls with rectangular panelling, on which hang two brownish-red framed pictures. On the right edge, emerging from the grass, a jib-sail-shaped, white surface with formless greenish and pinkish shades, and beside it a small, yellow, slender mast with one shroud. Textured brushwork. Above, a whitish light-blue sky, greyish-white above the horizon.

7375.d: Väga heledal õhulisel foonil hoogsate pintslitõmmetega visandatud abstraktsed punakad, oranžid ja pruunikad kujundid.
7375.de: Abstract reddish, orange and brownish shapes sketched with vigorous brushstrokes on a very light, airy background.

7460.d: Pruunil laual hele kann paljude mitmevärviliste astrite ja leekivpunaste gladioolidega. Kannu kõrval kaks õuna ja astriõit. Foon hallikas-sinine.
7460.de: A light-coloured jug on a brown table with many multicoloured asters and flaming red gladioli. Beside the jug two apples and an aster blossom. The background greyish-blue.

7484.d: Autori nimi, töö nimetus ja mõõdud Asukoht objektil: pöördel keskel pliiatsiga autorikäaekirjas
7484.de: Author's name, title of the work and dimensions. Location on the object: on the verso, in the centre, in pencil, in the author's handwriting

7485.d: Talvine, sombuse ilmaga linnavaade: esiplaanil paremal kolm raagus puud. Taamal paistavad majade tagant tornikiivrita Niguliste ja temast vasakule jääv Oleviste kirik.
7485.de: Winter city view in gloomy weather: in the foreground on the right three bare trees. In the distance, behind the houses, St. Nicholas' Church without its spire and, to its left, St. Olaf's Church can be seen.

7488.d: Esiplaanil pruunide seinte ja lumiste katustega väikesed majad. Keskplaanis raagus, akvarellilike pintslilöökidega antud puud. Taamal, puude taga pastelseis toonides vanalinn kahe kirikutorniga. Ülal valkjassinine taevas.
7488.de: In the foreground small houses with brown walls and snowy roofs. In the middle ground bare trees, rendered with watercolour-like brushstrokes. Beyond, behind the trees, the old town in pastel tones with two church towers. Above, a whitish-blue sky.

7503.d: Erksinise taeva all liivapruun kaldajärsak heledate madalate majadega. Järsaku all teel kihutav sinine limusiin, paar jalakäijat. Esiplaanil, teisel pool kallast kaks antiikskulptuuri: vasakpoolne kätetu, ühel põlvel põlvitav naisfiguur, parempoolne lamav meesfiguur.
7503.de: Under a bright blue sky, a sandy-brown steep bank with light-coloured low houses. At the foot of the bank, a blue limousine speeding along the road, a couple of pedestrians. In the foreground, on the other side of the bank, two antique sculptures: on the left an armless female figure kneeling on one knee, on the right a reclining male figure.

7514.d: Valges kitlis mehe otsevaates figuur tehaseinterjööris.
7514.de: Frontal figure of a man in a white coat in a factory interior.

7515.d: Pildil keskel kirjutuslaua taga istuva vanema mehe täisfiguur, kerges pöördes paremale. Käed lebamas laual, vasak jalg tõstetud üle põlve. Figuuri ebakorrapäraste siniste värvipindade rahutule rütmile on kontrastseks fooniks ruumi sisustust markeerivate korrapäraste hall-pruunide geomeetriliste pindade rahulik rütm.
7515.de: In the centre of the picture, the full figure of an older man sitting behind a writing desk, in a slight turn to the right. Hands resting on the desk, left leg raised over the knee. The restless rhythm of the figure's irregular blue colour surfaces is contrasted by the calm rhythm of the regular grey-brown geometric surfaces marking the furnishing of the room as background.

7572.d: Keskjoonest pisut paremal istuva naise otsevaates poolfiguur, nägu veidi vasemale pööratud, vasak käsi toetub küünarnukiga toolileenile, parem puhkab süles. Tugeva, pisut lihava ninaga nägu, hallid juuksed. Seljas kirju pluus ning tumesinine seelik. Vasakus servas keskjoonest kõrgemal aimatav tehaseinterjöör. Foon ja kogu pilt lahendatud peamiselt siniste, punaste ja roheliste värvilaikude kõrvutamise ja põimimisega.
7572.de: Half-figure of a seated woman slightly to the right of the centre line, viewed frontally, her face turned slightly to the left, her left hand resting with the elbow on the chair's armrest, her right hand resting in her lap. A face with a strong, somewhat fleshy nose, grey hair. Wearing a colourful blouse and a dark blue skirt. In the left edge, above the centre line, a factory interior is faintly suggested. The background and the whole picture are rendered mainly through the juxtaposition and interweaving of patches of blue, red and green colour.

7573.d: Sinakasrohelistes ja punastes toonides portreekompositsioon: hoolikalt läbimaalitud pindadest aimub vasakul arhitektoonilisi konstruktsioone. Paremal niššis (või kaare all) punaste juuste, siniste silmade, lopsaka suu ja püstja ninaga noor naine profiilis. Naise käed rinnal vaheliti, vasakus käes hele õiekujuline sõrmus.
7573.de: A portrait composition in bluish-green and red tones: carefully worked surfaces suggest architectural constructions at left. At right, in a niche (or under an arch), a young woman in profile with red hair, blue eyes, full lips and an upturned nose. The woman's hands are crossed on her chest, and on her left hand there is a light flower-shaped ring.

7723.d: Esiplaanil töökitlis ja valges särgis mees pintsli ja paletiga käes. Lühikesed sirged juuksed liibuvad vastu pead, sirge nina, prillid. mehest vasakul laual liivakell, selja taga aken, millest paistab kirikutornide ja katustega Tallinna vanalinn. Maalitud pastelsetes roosades, sinistes ja hallides toonides.
7723.de: In the foreground a man in a work smock and white shirt, holding a brush and palette. Short straight hair combed close to the head, straight nose, glasses. To the man's left on a table an hourglass, behind him a window through which the Tallinn Old Town with its church towers and roofs can be seen. Painted in pastel pink, blue and grey tones.

7731.d: Sajandialguse perekonnapilti meenutav maal, maja ees pingil istuv ja fotograafile poseeriv pere. Vasakul pereisa tumedas ülikonnas, hoiab põlvedel lamedat ovaalset eset, tema kõrval suurem poiss, kelle ees pikkade heledate juustega laps väikesel pingil, madruseülikond seljas, poisi kõrval pereema, valges kleidis beebi süles, ema kõrval seisab madruseülikonnas väike poiss, vasak käsi mänguhobusel. Taustal vasakul, valge majaseina ääres punakad tellised, virn torusid, lillepõõsas ja hulk mitmesuguseid keraamilisi nõusid. Maali ülemisel poolel kujutatud vaadet maakohale, kus kaks talumaja kahe kõrge korstnaga valge hoone vahel. Valdavalt kahvaturohelised toonid.
7731.de: A painting reminiscent of a family portrait from the turn of the century, depicting a family sitting on a bench in front of a house, posing for the photographer. On the left the father of the family in a dark suit, holding a flat oval object on his knees, next to him a larger boy, in front of whom a long fair-haired child sits on a small bench, wearing a sailor suit; next to the boy the mother of the family, in a white dress, with a baby in her lap; next to the mother stands a small boy in a sailor suit, his left hand on a toy horse. In the background on the left, along the white wall of the house, reddish bricks, a pile of pipes, a flowering bush and a number of various ceramic vessels. The upper half of the painting depicts a view of a rural area, with two farmhouses between a white building with two tall chimneys. Predominantly pale green tones.

7774.d: Esiplaanil paremal rühm inimesi rannal, vasakul meri, kaldal paadid.
7774.de: In the foreground on the right a group of people on the beach, on the left the sea, boats on the shore.

7775.d: Tumedas koloriidis talvine rannamaastik. Esiplaanil paremal ja vasakul madalad kalurihütid ning tuulest sasitud latvadega puud. Taamal, rannas kobaras koos laevad. Tagaplaanil ujuvate jääpankadega meri ning pilvine taevas. Värvipind osaliselt faktuurne.
7775.de: A winter coastal landscape in dark coloring. In the foreground on the right and left, low fishermen's huts and trees with wind-tousled tops. Further back, on the shore, ships clustered together. In the background, a sea with floating ice floes and a cloudy sky. The paint surface is partly textured.

7861.d: Esiplaanil vasakul, poolprofiilis paremale, seisev mees kaitsekiivriga, ülestõstetud paremas käes keevitusjuhe, mida ta hoiab puusa kõrguselt vasema käega. All vasakul kükitav keevitaja kaitseprillides. Alumises vasemas nurgas väike transportöör. Paremas kuldlõikes avaneb vaade keskplaanile (meri kaide vahel) ning tagaplaanile (dokis seisev laev tellingutega taglase osas). Domineerib sinine ja rohekassinine ültoon.
7861.de: In the foreground on the left, in half-profile facing right, a standing man with a protective helmet, in his raised right hand a welding cable which he holds at hip height with his left hand. In the lower left a crouching welder wearing protective goggles. In the lower left corner a small conveyor. In the right golden section a view opens onto the middle plane (sea between quays) and the background (a ship standing in dock with scaffolding around part of the rigging). Blue and greenish-blue overtone dominate.

7862.d: Paremas nurgas esiplaanil pruunis laia kraega mantlis ja pruuni salliga mehe rinnaportree. Hall lopsakas habe, peas sonimüts. Foonil talvised, härmatisega kaetud raagus puud. Foon hall.
7862.de: In the right corner in the foreground a chest portrait of a man in a brown coat with a wide collar and a brown scarf. A lush gray beard, wearing a fur hat. In the background winter, frost-covered bare trees. The background is gray.

7947.d: Esiplaanil all ruudukujuline metallnelinurkadest ja suurtest kruvikujulistest kraanidest koosnev kompositsioon. Paremal ülanurgas relssidest konstruktsioonid, keskel kollane kumav pind, millest paremal pritsib kollast auru. Ülaosas foon sinine. Allservas vasakul kükitab pruun jänes.
7947.de: In the foreground below, a composition consisting of square metal quadrangles and large screw-shaped cranes. In the upper right corner, structures of rails, in the middle a shimmering yellow surface from which yellow steam sprays on the right. The background at the top is blue. At the bottom left a brown hare is crouching.

7967.d: Kõrged, metsaga kaetud künkad, mis peegelduvad esiplaanil olevas järves. Taevas hallides toonides.
7967.de: High, forest-covered hills reflected in a lake in the foreground. Sky in grey tones.

7968.d: Hallide kaljumägede vahel tume veekogu, taustaks kauged mäed.
7968.de: A dark body of water between grey rocky mountains, with distant mountains in the background.

7969.d: Hallil foonil ning pruunil aluspinnal tumeda keskosaga ja hallikasvalgete, pastoosselt maalitud servadega küna. Selle ees sinakate ja lillade varjunditega poolik käsikivi. Käsikivi ees vslge, stiliseeritud lille kujutis.
7969.de: On a grey background and brown underlying surface, a trough with a dark middle section and greyish-white, pastosely painted edges. In front of it a half hand-mill with bluish and lilac shades. In front of the hand-mill, the image of a white, stylised flower.

7970.d: Ühele horisontaalile ning vertikaalile rajatud kompositsioon mustadest, valgetest ning hallidest pindadest. Osa ühe vertikaalse kujundi pinnast krobeline. Taust tume; alt üles järk-järgult heledamaks minev.
7970.de: A composition built on a single horizontal and vertical, of black, white and grey planes. Part of the surface of one vertical form is rough. Background dark; gradually becoming lighter from bottom to top.
