7971.d: Vasakul esiplaanil must teravatipuline teetulp. Maastiku plaanidel kolm pruunikas-hallikais toonides lainelist riba; esiplaanil olev faktuurse pinnaga. Taevas pruunides toonides, silmapiiri poole helenev.
7971.de: In the left foreground a black sharp-pointed roadside post. In the planes of the landscape, three wavy strips in brownish-greyish tones; the one in the foreground has a textured surface. The sky is in brown tones, brightening towards the horizon.

7972.d: Parempoolne kolmnurk pildi pinnast viljapäid markeeriv fraktuurne pind, ookrivärvis. Vasemale jääb ühtlaselt tumeda värviga kaetud veepind, mida piiravad silmapiiril kolm erineva kõrgusega rannarahnu. Kaugus hele, taevas läheb järk-järgult tumedamaks, ülaservas ripub faktuurse pinnaga, sakiliste servadega raske pilve moodustis.
7972.de: The right-hand triangle of the picture surface is a fractured surface marking ears of grain, in ochre colour. To the left is a uniformly dark-coloured water surface, bounded on the horizon by three shore boulders of different heights. The distance is light, the sky gradually becomes darker, at the top edge hangs a heavy cloud formation with a textured surface and jagged edges.

7973.d: Poole pildipinnast võtab enda alla kaheks osaks jaotatud rannariba. Esiplaanil kasutatud kollaži kolme pitsist kujundiga. Tagaplaanil silmapiiri poole helenev sinine mereviig.
7973.de: Half of the picture surface is taken up by a strip of beach divided into two parts. In the foreground a collage of three lace-like shapes is used. In the background a blue sea strip growing lighter towards the horizon.

7974.d: Öine industriaalmaastik. Vasakul pildiääre keskelt ja paremal ülemisest nurgast horisondini kulgevad kaks suure läbimõõdulist torejuhet, ees keeruliselt ümber musta vertikaalvaia painutatud tumesinine  peen toru. Vasakul pool all maapinnal üksik punane tuleleek, taamal neli vabrikukorstent. Horisondil keskel kolm horisontaalset rohelist triipu. Ülal vasemal täiskuu.
7974.de: A night industrial landscape. On the left from the middle of the picture edge, and on the right from the upper corner, two large-diameter pipelines run to the horizon; in front, a thin dark blue pipe bent intricately around a black vertical stake. On the lower left, on the ground, a single red flame, further off four factory chimneys. In the middle of the horizon three horizontal green stripes. Above left, a full moon.

7975.d: Keskel kanelüüritud hall sammas, sellest paremal, esiplaanil kannelüürideta hall sammas. Ees paremal ja vasakul pruunikashallid, sambatüükaid meenutavad, ajahambast puretud ülespidi pürgivad vormid, neist paremas kuldlõikes asuv vorm on kroonitud tuleleeki meenutava pruunika-kollase massiga. Maali vasakpoolsel kolmandikul kogu kompositsiooni kõrgust täitvad kaks struktuuritut vabalt vooglevat sambataolist vormi, mis alt ja ülevalt on omavahel horisontaalselt ühendatud. Nende vahel kitsas kindlapiiriline, ülal kõverduv värvitriip (all rohekassinine, ülevalt tumedaks rohekassiniseks muutuv). Helesinine taevas, horisondil tume. Maapind tume sinakasroheline. Faktuurne, pastoosne, kohati hangunud
7975.de: In the middle a grey fluted column, to its right, in the foreground, a grey column without fluting. In front, on the right and left, brownish-grey forms resembling column stumps, weathered by time and striving upward; the form situated at the right golden section is crowned by a brownish-yellow mass resembling a flame. In the left third of the painting, filling the entire height of the composition, two structureless, freely undulating column-like forms, connected to each other horizontally at the bottom and top. Between them a narrow, clearly bounded strip of colour curving upward (greenish-blue below, turning into a dark greenish-blue above). Light blue sky, dark at the horizon. The ground surface is dark bluish-green. Textured, impasto, in places congealed

7976.d: Kompositsiooni kõiki servi piiravad industriaalsed vormid, mille vahelt avaneb vaade kaugusesse (ülalt tumepunane, läbi oranži alla jõudes kollane). Selle taustal vasemas kuldlõikes ülestõstetud kinnastatud kätega mees selgvaates, valgete varjunditega mererohelises alussärgis ja punastes pikkades pükstes. Alumises vasakus nurgas tumesiniste ja lillade refleksidega kaks suurt metalset, madalate hammastega ratast, paremas alumises nurgas viis paralleelselt kulgevat S-kujulist vormi. Ülemises paremas nurgas kaarjalt kulgev suur ventilatsioonitoru. Mehe pea kohal metalltala kolme punakollase ümaravaga.
7976.de: All edges of the composition are bordered by industrial forms, between which a view opens into the distance (dark red at the top, passing through orange down to yellow). Against this background, in the golden section on the left, a man seen frontally with gloved hands raised, in a sea-green undershirt with white shading and long red trousers. In the lower left corner, two large metal wheels with low teeth, with dark blue and purple reflections; in the lower right corner, five parallel S-shaped forms. In the upper right corner, a large curving ventilation pipe. Above the man's head, a metal beam with three reddish-yellow round protrusions.

8010.d: Töö allääres kaks halli, roosade uimede ja sabadega lestakala, tumehallil, tugevasti reljeefse faktuuriga foonil. Horisontaalsest keskjoonest ülalpool hallid liivaluited, erksinine meri, mis silmapiiril läheb üle halliks taevaks.
8010.de: At the bottom edge of the work two grey flatfish with pink fins and tails, on a dark grey, strongly relief-textured background. Above the horizontal centre line grey sand dunes, bright blue sea, which on the horizon turns into a grey sky.

8011.d: Maal jaotatud vertikaalselt kaheks. Paremal noore naise kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates, pea pööratud vasakule. Naisel päevitunud nägu, pikad juuksed seljal. Pea taga, mustal taustal neljakandiline ava helesinise, valgete pilvedega taevaga. Naise käisteta kleit reljeefselt vormitud. Maali vasak pool must-valges gammas tehismaastik silmapiiri suunas aheneva ruudustiku ja musta, avadega seinaga.
8011.de: The painting is divided vertically into two. On the right a three-quarter figure of a young woman in frontal view, head turned to the left. The woman has a tanned face, long hair down her back. Behind her head, against a black background, a rectangular opening with a light blue sky with white clouds. The woman's sleeveless dress is shaped in relief. The left side of the painting, in a black-and-white scale, an artificial landscape with a grid narrowing towards the horizon and a black wall with openings.

8012.d: Esiplaanil tumesinistes ja hallides toonides merepõhi, mis all segatehnikas reljeefseks markeeritud. Põhjas lillakate ja sinakate õitega lilled, varred püsti, väga pastoosselt maalitud. Lillede kohal erinevates sinistes toonides merevesi. Mere kohal valkjassinine, ülal tublisti tumenev sünge taevas.
8012.de: In the foreground, a seabed in dark blue and grey tones, marked in relief below using mixed media. On the bottom, flowers with lilac and bluish blossoms, stems upright, painted very impasto. Above the flowers, sea water in various shades of blue. Above the sea, a whitish-blue, at the top considerably darkening, gloomy sky.

8047.d: Kolmeosalisel maalipinnal kujutatud meeletult tormavaid hobuseid lehvivate lakkadega punastes, sinistes, roosades toonides. Nende vahel figuure.
8047.de: The three-part painted surface depicts frantically galloping horses with flowing manes in red, blue, pink tones. Figures between them.

8048.d: Paremas kuldlõikes sinises teksaülikonnas ja kollases triibulises avatud kaelusega särgis prillidega noormehe poolfiguur en face, käed püksitaskutes, ulatudes pealaega perspektiivjooneni. Tumedad vurrud, pikad, kergelt lainetavad tumedad juuksed. Ees vasakul, noormehe kõrval laud joonestusvahenditega. Fooniks abstraktne ruum, mis on perspektiivis sirgjoonte ja värvipindadega kärjetaoliselt jaotatud mõttelisteks kuubikukujulisteks ruumiosadeks. Sinaks-roosa-rohekas taevas joonestatud geomeetriliste kujunditega.
8048.de: In the right golden section, the half-figure of a bespectacled young man in blue jeans and a yellow striped open-collared shirt, en face, hands in trouser pockets, reaching with the crown of his head to the perspective line. Dark moustache, long, slightly wavy dark hair. In front on the left, beside the young man, a table with drafting instruments. The background is an abstract space divided in perspective by straight lines and colour surfaces into honeycomb-like conceptual cube-shaped spatial sections. A bluish-pink-greenish sky with drawn geometric shapes.

8049.d: Kompositsioon suitsevast lahinguväljast, millel on äsja lõppenud võistlus. Esiplaanil keskel suur kõrge, paremal äärel servani, vasemal vaatajast veidi kaugemal põlenud, väändunud, deformeerunud püstjased teraserusud, mis on maalitud sirgete, kohati ümarate, paindunud teravate joontega (peamiselt pruunide ja mustade, tumedatel suurematel pindadel ka helesiniste, punaste, kollaste, roheliste jt.). Maapind sirge pruuni joonena kujutatud horisondini kaetud mitmevärviliste värvipindadega. Pilvine ning suitsune taevaas, milles väikeste laikudena paistab helesinist. Keskmise ning vasakpoolse rusukuhila vahel horisondil - põlev tank.
8049.de: A composition of a smoking battlefield on which a contest has just ended. In the foreground in the centre, large and tall, reaching to the edge on the right, and slightly further from the viewer on the left, burnt, twisted, deformed upright piles of steel wreckage, painted with straight, in places rounded, bent sharp lines (mainly brown and black, with light blue, red, yellow, green and other colours also on the larger dark surfaces). The ground, depicted as a straight brown line up to the horizon, is covered with multicoloured patches of colour. A cloudy and smoky sky, in which light blue shows through as small patches. Between the middle and left-hand piles of wreckage, on the horizon - a burning tank.

8052.d: Suureformaadiline kompositsioon, millest umb. 6/7 võtab enda alla rohelus: puud, põõsad, rikkalikult kõikvõimalikke taimi ja lilli. Paremas alumises neljandikus äratuntavalt antud kolm helelillat astrit; vasakul all, horisontaalsest keskjoonest veidi allpool neli tumepunast roosiõit kandilises vaasis või pudelis. Sellest vasakul suur klaaspurk lillekimbuga. Alumises servas keskel nukk ja klaaskauss õuntega, neist paremal üksik klaas kollase lilleoksaga. Ülaservas aimatav, rangeil horisontaalidel ja vertikaalidel põhinev linnavaade. Töö tihedate pintslilöökidega läbi maalitud, valdavalt tumerohelises koloriidis.
8052.de: A large-format composition, of which about 6/7 is taken up by greenery: trees, bushes, an abundance of various plants and flowers. In the lower right quarter, three recognisably rendered light-purple asters; lower left, slightly below the horizontal centre line, four dark red rose blossoms in a rectangular vase or bottle. To its left a large glass jar with a bouquet of flowers. At the bottom edge, centre, a doll and a glass bowl with apples, to their right a single glass with a yellow flower branch. At the top edge a cityscape based on strict horizontals and verticals can be discerned. The work is painted throughout with dense brushstrokes, predominantly in dark green colouring.

8054.d: Heledates toonides maalitud Ateena Akropoli vaade pildi keskel sügavsinise taeva taustal. Pildi alumises pooles tume maastik aimatavate puude siluettidega, all pildi servas üksikud reaaliad: kaks antiikset skulptuurpead, coca-cola pudeli silt. Värvimulje annab paljude erivärviliste pintslilöökide kokkusulamine.
8054.de: A view of the Athenian Acropolis painted in light tones, in the centre of the picture against a deep blue sky. In the lower half of the picture a dark landscape with the suggested silhouettes of trees, at the bottom edge of the picture a few individual realia: two antique sculpture heads, a label from a Coca-Cola bottle. The colour impression is created by the fusion of many differently coloured brushstrokes.

8056.dm: laius: 300.0 cm (kolm osa koos); kõrgus: 200.0 cm
8056.d: Vasak tiib: Hoogsalt maalitud smaragdrohelise lopsaka taimestiku taustal puhmastena pruunikaspunased lilled, nende vahel skulptuurpea. Ülemises neljandikus heledal taustal sõrestikulised ehituskonstruktsioonid, vasakus äärs pea fragment profiilis.
8056.de: Left wing: Boldly painted brownish-red flowers in clusters against a background of lush emerald-green vegetation, among them a sculptural head. In the upper quarter, against a light background, skeletal building structures, in the left margin a fragment of a head in profile.

8057.d: Pildi keskel seda kaheks jaotav ehituskonstruktsioonide kuhil. Sellest paremal ja vasakul õrnalt valgega märgitud kraanade kontuurid. Silmapiiril, mürkrohelise maapinna taustal paremas nurgas uue linnaosa siluett, vasakul jupike tööstusmaastikku väävlisuitsu ajava korstnaga. Ülaääres tumesinine taevas.
8057.de: In the middle of the picture, a pile of building constructions dividing it in two. To its right and left, faintly white-marked outlines of cranes. On the horizon, against a poison-green ground, in the right corner the silhouette of a new city district, on the left a piece of an industrial landscape with a chimney emitting sulphurous smoke. At the top edge, a dark blue sky.

8058.d: Sinakate arhidektuuridetailide taustal ühteistkümnest inimesest grupiportree. Keskosas lühikeste heldate juustega istuv vana naine otsevaates, parem käsi süles. Tema ees paremal helepunases kleidis seisev tüdruk. Tüdruku taga paremal seisavad prillidega noor mees, käed vaheliti rinnal ja helepruunide juustega noor naine. Nende vahel taga paistab vanema mehe (E. Okas) pea veerandpöördes paremale. Keskosast vasakul lühikeste heledate juustega üle keskea naise portree veerandpöördes paremale. Naise taga tumedates prillides noor mees otsevaates. Esiplaanil vasakul lamav hundikoer ja istuv suur must  koer. Koerte taga poolselgvaates, pea pööratud vaatajale, noor naine, imik süles. Tagapool vasaku
8058.de: Against a background of bluish architectural details, a group portrait of eleven people. In the centre, a seated old woman with short light hair, seen frontally, right hand in her lap. In front of her, on the right, a girl in a light red dress. Behind the girl, on the right, stand a young man with glasses, arms crossed on his chest, and a young woman with light brown hair. Between them, further back, the head of an older man (E. Okas) is visible, turned in a quarter profile to the right. To the left of the centre, a portrait of a woman past middle age with short light hair, in a quarter turn to the right. Behind the woman, a young man with dark glasses, seen frontally. In the foreground on the left, a lying wolfhound and a sitting large black dog. Behind the dogs, in half profile, head turned toward the viewer, a young woman with an infant in her lap. Further back on the left

8091.d: Erinevatest tekstiilitükkidest, tikandiga ühendatud värvikas pilt kujutamas jaanipäeva ringmängu ümber lipu ja pärgadega ehitud masti suvemaastikul veekogu ääres.
8091.de: A colourful picture made of various pieces of textile joined with embroidery, depicting a Midsummer round dance around a mast decorated with a flag and wreaths in a summer landscape by a body of water.

8093.d: Erinevatest kangatükkidest kombineeritud, tikitud pilt. Musta linnasilueti kohal lennukid, valguskiirte vihud, tuleleegid, suitsune öötaevas. Keskel linna kujutisest lähtuv tee vaataja suunas, millel puntras inimkujusid kompsudega, tee kõrval põllul kaks tormavat hobust.
8093.de: An embroidered picture composed of various pieces of fabric. Above a black city silhouette, aeroplanes, bundles of light beams, tongues of flame, a smoky night sky. In the centre, a road leading from the depiction of the city towards the viewer, on which a tangle of human figures with bundles; beside the road in a field, two galloping horses.

8094.d: Üle terve maali 6 ruuduga katkine aken, osa klaase puudu, liistud murdunud, naelad turritamas. Tervetel tükkidel taeva peegeldus. Aknalaual heledad nutsakad. Maaliline ekspressiivne kujutamisviis.
8094.de: A broken window with 6 panes across the whole painting, some glass missing, the bars broken, nails sticking out. On the intact panes a reflection of the sky. Pale knick-knacks on the windowsill. Painterly, expressive manner of depiction.

8095.d: Tilgutite ja voolikutega haigevoodil vanem naine suletud silmil valge lina all lebamas. Taustal aknavaade suvemaastikuga roheliste kaskede, skvääriga kaugemal sinitaeva all.
8095.de: An elderly woman lying in a hospital bed with drips and tubes, eyes closed, under a white sheet. In the background a window view with a summer landscape, green birches, a square further away under a blue sky.

8098.d: Kolmest osast koosnev maal. Vaade mägise lõunamaa väikelinna sillutatud väljakule vihmase ilmaga. Platsi piiravad värviliste luukide, keerdtreppide, kaldteede, erinevate
8098.de: A painting consisting of three parts. A view of a paved square in a mountainous southern small town in rainy weather. The square is bordered by colourful shutters, spiral staircases, ramps, various

8099.d: Tumedas kleidis vanem naine avatud aknal toetumas aknaesisele metallkeerdudega
8099.de: An older woman in a dark dress at an open window, leaning on the windowsill with metal spirals

8117.d: Ookerkollaste ja pruunikashallides toonides erinevatele faktuuridele rajatud abstraktne
8117.de: An abstract [work] built on different textures in ochre-yellow and brownish-grey tones

8199.d: Suvehommikune inimtühi tänavaristmik. Esi- ja keskplaanil perpendikulaarselt kulgevasse tänavasse suubuv klassitsistlike hoonetega ääristatud kitsas tänavalõpp. Esiplaanil vasakul kahekorruseline kitsas maja ärkliga, selle kõrval keskplaanil nurgamaja: kõrge järsu katusega kolekordne hoone varahommikusest päikesest valgustatud ülakorrusega. Paremal kolmekorruselised majad, neist üks balkoniga. Tagaplaanil Toompea nõlv ookerkollaste, kõrgete katustega ja korstnatega päikesest valgustatud hoonetega.Tagaplaanil all künka jalamil, lehtpuudemass sellest esilekerkiva punase majakatusega. Tumedam erksinine taevas.
8199.de: A people-free early summer street crossing. In the foreground and middle ground, a narrow street end lined with classicist buildings leading into a street running perpendicular. In the foreground on the left, a narrow two-storey house with an oriel window; next to it in the middle ground, a corner house: a tall, steep-roofed three-storey building with its upper floor lit by the early morning sun. On the right, three-storey houses, one of them with a balcony. In the background, the slope of Toompea with ochre-yellow, tall-roofed and chimneyed buildings lit by the sun. In the background below, at the foot of the hill, a mass of deciduous trees with a red house roof rising above it. A darker bright blue sky.

8291.d: Esiplaanil, köögiviljadega kaetud laua ümber istub rõõmsameelne seltskond mehi, naisi, lapsi, ahv nende vahel. Tagapool läbisegi üksteise vahel vasakult veis, traktor, lõvi pojaga, mees papagoiga, eesli- ja põdrapea. Paremas nurgas kähar puu eksootilise linnuga. Dekoratiivne laad, rohelised, punakaspruunid toonid.(eesti)
8291.de: In the foreground, a cheerful group of men, women and children sits around a table covered with vegetables, with a monkey among them. Further back, intermingled with each other from left to right, are a cow, a tractor, a lion with a cub, a man with a parrot, and a donkey's and an elk's head. In the right corner, a curly tree with an exotic bird. Decorative style, green and reddish-brown tones.

8292.d: Esiplaanil puud ja majad rohekates toonides. Nende taga, vasakul, paistab meri majakaga.(eesti)
8292.de: In the foreground trees and houses in greenish tones. Behind them, on the left, the sea with a lighthouse is visible.

8294.d: Pisut ülalpool keskjoont paiknevale silmapiirile koonduvad ähvardav-punane rünkpilvedega kaetud taevas ja hekkide ning puudega pargimaastik. Esiplaanil bassein heleda draperiitaolise kujundiga. Maalitud akvarellilikult punastes, rohelistes, valkjates toonides.
8294.de: Slightly above the centre line, a threatening reddish sky covered with cumulus clouds converges at the horizon with a park landscape of hedges and trees. In the foreground a pool with a light drapery-like shape. Painted in a watercolour-like manner in red, green and whitish tones.

8300.d: Kollase ja sinakasrohelisega markeeritud toasisustuse foonil istuv keskealine mees. Tumedad juuksed, prillid, seljas roheline särk, pruunid püksid ja vest, tumesinine lips, rohelised sokid, mustad läikivad kingad, ees pikk valge põll. Mees kerges pöördes vasakule, parem jalg üle põlve.
8300.de: A middle-aged man sitting against a background of an interior marked in yellow and bluish-green. Dark hair, glasses, wearing a green shirt, brown trousers and waistcoat, dark blue tie, green socks, black shiny shoes, a long white apron in front. The man turned slightly to the left, right leg crossed over the knee.

8323.d: Esiplaanil kaks figuuri alusservaga poolenisti lõigatud; parempoolne alasti en face, vasakpoolne rohelises pluusis seljaga. Nende taga rand geometriseeritult pindadeks maalituna, domineerib heleroheline, vasakus servas intensiivset oranži, sinist. Tagaplaanil sügavates rohelistes toonides meri ja kitsas taevariba.
8323.de: In the foreground two figures cut off at the lower edge; the one on the right nude en face, the one on the left in a green blouse, seen from the back. Behind them a beach painted in a geometricised manner as planes, dominated by light green, with intense orange and blue in the left edge. In the background, the sea in deep green tones and a narrow strip of sky.

8339.d: Esiplaanil tänava ja majade taustal inimeste poolfiguurid.
8339.de: In the foreground, half-figures of people against a background of a street and houses.

8356.d: Hallil kumaval taustal valkjate pintslilöökidega markeeritud foonil ja heledates nüansseeritud toonides ning pastoosselt maalitud alusel roosa vaas, milles kitsalt kõrgusesse suunatud bukett punastest õitest ja rohelistest lehtedest.
8356.de: On a grey shimmering background marked with whitish brushstrokes, and on a base painted in light nuanced tones and impasto, a pink vase holding a narrow, upward-directed bouquet of red flowers and green leaves.

8358.d: Tumedal foonil piimanõu siniste, oranžide ja valgete lilledega.
8358.de: On a dark background a milk vessel with blue, orange and white flowers.

8360.d: Rohelisel aasal kuus hobust tiheda grupina.
8360.de: Six horses in a tight group on a green meadow.

8366.d: Punasel foonil keskealise, tugevate näojoontega mehe rinnaportree. Paksud, tumedad juuksed laubalt taha kammitud. tihedate, ülemist laugu katvate kulmude alt suunatud vaatajale uuriv pilk; huuled veidi avatud. Käed vaheliti rinnal. Seljas tumepruun pallon ning valge kittel. Allääres lai punakaspruun horisontaalne pind.(eesti)
8366.de: On a red background, a bust portrait of a middle-aged man with strong facial features. Thick, dark hair combed back from the forehead. From beneath dense eyebrows covering the upper eyelid, an inquiring gaze directed at the viewer; lips slightly parted. Hands crossed on the chest. Wearing a dark brown paletot and a white smock. A broad reddish-brown horizontal surface at the lower edge.

8413.d: Esiplaanil läbipaistvaks ja peegelsiledaks maalitud veepind. Taga paremal seisavad kalalaevad ja neist veidi eespool valge, purjedeta jaht. Vasakul kõrguvad kolm vabrikukorstent. Käsitlus eskiislik, kohati kasutatud laia pintslitõmmet.
8413.de: In the foreground, a water surface painted transparent and mirror-smooth. Behind on the right stand fishing boats, and slightly ahead of them a white yacht without sails. On the left three factory chimneys rise. Sketch-like handling, in places using broad brushstrokes.

8414.d: Laiade pastoossete pahtlitõmmetega maalitud sügavsinine järvepind ning erksates toonides kõrged kaljused kaldad, taevast on näha ainult kitsa ribana ülaservas.
8414.de: Deep blue lake surface painted with broad pastose strokes of putty, and high rocky shores in vivid tones, of the sky only a narrow strip is visible at the top edge.

8415.d: Munajad üksteisest läbikasvanud kujundid, maalitud üksteisesse sulavates toonides. Tumepunased, roosad ja sinised kujundid terava musta kontuuriga piiritletud. Väga laseeritud, sile maalipind.
8415.de: Egg-shaped forms growing through one another, painted in tones blending into each other. Dark red, pink and blue forms bounded by sharp black contours. Very glazed, smooth paint surface.

8449.d: Geomeetrilistest kujunditest kompositsioon: keskosa erinevatest valgetest ja helehallidest kujunditest, paremas servas tumedamas hallis, vasakul eri heledusastmetes kollased kolm- ja nelinurgad.
8449.de: A composition of geometric shapes: the central part made up of various white and light grey shapes, on the right edge in a darker grey, on the left yellow triangles and quadrangles in various degrees of lightness.

8450.d: Valgete pikemate juustega prillidega vanema mehe rinnaportree poolpöördes avasakule. Mehel kõrge paljas otsmik, suunurgad pisut allapoole. Lahtiste hõlmade vahelt paistmas sinakas sall, tume kuub sinise särgi ja heleda lipsuga. Jõuline maalilaad, kohati väga pastoosne.
8450.de: Bust portrait of an older man with longer white hair and glasses, in a half-turn to the left. The man has a high bare forehead, the corners of his mouth turned slightly downward. A bluish scarf visible between the open lapels, a dark coat with a blue shirt and light-coloured tie. Vigorous painting style, at times very impasto.

8453.d: Pruuni põranda ja siniste seintega toa nurgas lillepotid, lopsakate lehtede ja sinakaslillade õitega taimed sees. Domineerivad külmad rohelised ja pruunid toonid, maalitud värvilaikude maalilist kokkukõla silmas pidades.
8453.de: In the corner of a room with a brown floor and blue walls, flower pots with plants with lush leaves and bluish-purple blossoms inside. Cold green and brown tones dominate, painted with an eye to the picturesque harmony of the patches of colour.

8454.d: Hoogsa, laia pintslitõmbega, osaliselt pastoosselt maalitud lopsakas lillekimp, valkjatest, roosakaspunastest ning kollakaist õitest.
8454.de: A lush bouquet of flowers painted with bold, broad brushstrokes, partly impasto, with whitish, pinkish-red and yellowish blossoms.

8455.d: Esiplaanil maariba, paremale ning vasakule jäävad kolletavad puud ja põõsad. Puude vahelt paistab maja ja katused.
8455.de: In the foreground a strip of land, to the right and left yellowing trees and bushes. Through the trees a house and roofs can be seen.

8480.d: Pikliku näo, veidi krimpsus ilmega, poolpalja pealaega mehe 4 portreed erinevais vaadetes. Vasakpoolne otsevaates, keskmine profiilis paremale, taga otse, taga keskel pea poolpöördes vasakule. Ühtlaselt värvikas laad heledate valguslaikudega, kohati katmata lõuend läbi kumamas.(eesti)
8480.de: 4 portraits, in different views, of a man with an elongated face, a slightly wrinkled expression, and a half-bald crown. The left-hand one frontal, the middle one in profile to the right, behind it straight on, behind in the middle the head in half-turn to the left. A uniformly colourful manner with light patches of light, in places the uncovered canvas shining through.

8488.d: Esiplaanil pisut klassitsistlikus stiilis alasti naise figuur lõunamaise maastiku taustal istumas. Naise käed külgedel, pea pisut paremale kallutatud, põlvel valge lina. Fooniks helesinise veega lahesopp purjekatega, kaljud ja taamal silmapiiril aimatavad majad.
8488.de: In the foreground a nude female figure in a somewhat classicist style, seated against the background of a southern landscape. The woman's arms are at her sides, her head tilted slightly to the right, a white cloth on her knee. The background shows a bay of light blue water with sailing boats, cliffs, and houses faintly visible on the horizon in the distance.

8497.d: Pika kollase laua taga esiplaanil kuus ja teisel pool lauda seitse meest. Erinevates poosides, kõikides värvitoonides juustega, kolm habemega. Laual üheksa kollase joogiga täidetud pokaali, vasakul laua servas roheline korvpudel punase korgiga, paremal lauaserval kitarr, millest on pruun riie üle visatud. Esiplaanil paremalt kolmanda mehe vööl pussnuga pruunis tupes, mehe kõrval valge lill. Foon sinine, võlvistikku markeeriv.
8497.de: Behind a long yellow table, six men in the foreground and seven men on the other side of the table. In various poses, with hair of all colours, three with beards. On the table nine goblets filled with yellow drink, on the left edge of the table a green wickerwork bottle with a red cork, on the right edge of the table a guitar with a brown cloth thrown over it. On the belt of the third man from the right in the foreground a sheath knife in a brown sheath, beside the man a white flower. Background blue, marking a vaulted structure.

8507.d: Jõeäärsel rinnatisel istuvad kolm naist: äärmistel sinine kleit ja käsipõsakil poos, keskmine oranzis kleidis ja mõlemad käed pihkudega rinnatisele toetumas. Parempoolse naise ees roheline, väikeste sangadega urn. Foonil jõgi ja mäerinnakul tihedalt kivimaju. Maalitud heledates sinistes ja kollakais toonides vorme tahkudena modelleerides.
8507.de: Three women sit on a riverside parapet: the outer ones in blue dresses in a chin-in-hand pose, the middle one in an orange dress with both hands resting palms-down on the parapet. In front of the right-hand woman a green urn with small handles. In the background a river and a hillside densely covered with stone houses. Painted in light blue and yellowish tones, modelling the forms as facets.

8529.d: Helehallil foonil keskealise mehe rinnaportree kerges pöördes paremale. Heledad, pisut lokkis juuksed, prillid. Seljas kollane särk, käe peal kell, kaelas keti otsas rippuv azuurne kaelaehe. Parem käsi hoiab ketti.
8529.de: Chest portrait of a middle-aged man against a light grey background, turned slightly to the right. Light, slightly curly hair, glasses. Wearing a yellow shirt, a watch on the hand, an azure pendant hanging from a chain around the neck. Right hand holding the chain.

8542.d: Sinisel lauanurgal esiplaanil kaks pronksjalt helkivat skulptuuri (näod profiilis). Nende kohal suurte valgete ja kohevate pallidena lilled. Foon helesinine, roosade ja lillade helkidega.
8542.de: On the blue corner of a table in the foreground two sculptures gleaming bronze (faces in profile). Above them flowers as large white and fluffy balls. Background light blue, with pink and lilac glimmers.

8556.d: Vaade liivakünka tagant üles, vastvalminud paneelmaja nurgale erksinise taeva taustal. Taamal paremal näha veelgi uusehitiste ülakorruseid. Esiplaanil suured liivakünkad, millest turritav välja oksarämu.
8556.de: View from behind a sand dune upward, to the corner of a newly completed panel building against a bright blue sky background. Further away on the right, the upper floors of more new buildings are visible. In the foreground large sand dunes, with brushwood sticking out of them.

8559.d: Erksa sinise taeva all hoogsate laiade pintslitõmmetega pastoosselt maalitud mägine maastik. Keskosas heledamal taustal harulise puu võra, paremal kolm saledat männitüve, tagaplaanil vasakul grupp mände.
8559.de: A mountainous landscape painted impastoly with bold broad brushstrokes under a bright blue sky. In the centre, against a lighter background, the crown of a branching tree, on the right three slender pine trunks, in the background on the left a group of pines.

8671.d: Talvemaastik lume seest paistvate hallikasroheliste kadakatega. Esiplaanil vasakus nurgas üks suurem kadakapõõsas ja lagunenud lattidest aed lume all. Taamal, keset kadakavälja, veel kaks lagunenud aiajuppi, ülal servas kitsas riba sinakashalli taevast.
8671.de: A winter landscape with greyish-green junipers showing through the snow. In the foreground, in the left corner, a larger juniper bush and a dilapidated pole fence under snow. Further back, amid the juniper field, two more dilapidated fence fragments, at the top edge a narrow strip of bluish-grey sky.

8713.d: Sinisel alusel lopsakate lehtede ning oranžide õitega begoonia. Foon hele - kollakas-beežides toonides. Kontuur rõhutatud.
8713.de: On a blue base a begonia with lush leaves and orange flowers. The background is light - in yellowish-beige tones. The contour is emphasized.

8720.d: Esiplaanil all kaks vestlevat figuuri: vasakul tumedas pluusis, pruunide juustega noormees, parem käsi välja sirutatud, paremal heledapäine bordoopunases pluusis nooruk. Toolid sinepikarva. Foonil keerulise struktuuriga geomeetriline kompositsioon triipudest, ringidest, kolm- ja nelinurkadest. Domineerib valge, hall, must ja sinine toon üksikute eredate aktsentidega.
8720.de: In the foreground below, two conversing figures: on the left a young man with brown hair in a dark blouse, right hand stretched out, on the right a fair-haired youth in a wine-red blouse. The chairs are mustard-coloured. In the background a geometric composition of complex structure made of stripes, circles, triangles and squares. White, grey, black and blue tones dominate, with a few bright accents.

8721.d: Tumedal foonil, paremal tumepruun vaas kollase- ja punaseõieliste lillede kimbuga. Maalipind faktuurne.
8721.de: On a dark background, on the right a dark brown vase with a bouquet of yellow- and red-flowered flowers. The painted surface is textured.

8722.d: Ees keskel kõrgendikul neljajalgsel olevusel sabakuues ja kübaraga ratsanik selgvaates kaugusesse vaatamas, käsi tõstetud. Tagapool avar värvikas maastik.(eesti)
8722.de: In the front centre, on an elevation, a rider in a tailcoat and hat on a four-legged creature, looking into the distance in direct view, hand raised. Behind, an expansive, colourful landscape.

8733.d: Vaade Laialt tänavalt Oleviste kiriku poole. Esiplaanil päikesepaisteline tänav, ääristatud kõrgete viilkatustega majadega. Vasak tänavapool jääb varju. Tagaplaanil keskel kõrgub kirik, mille torn on pildi üleservaga äralõigatud.
8733.de: View from Lai Street towards St. Olaf's Church. In the foreground a sunlit street, lined with houses with high gabled roofs. The left side of the street remains in shadow. In the background in the middle rises the church, whose tower is cut off by the upper edge of the picture.

8807.d: Rohelisel, veetaimedega kaetud foonil ümmargused ja sigarikujulised, ülalt ahenevad miinid. Ülaosas kolm tehnilist konstruktsiooni ja punased suitsupilved spektritaolisel foonil.(eesti)
8807.de: On a green background covered with water plants, round and cigar-shaped mines tapering at the top. In the upper part three technical constructions and red clouds of smoke on a spectrum-like background.

8808.d: Butafoorne maastik: esiplaanil vasakul klumbil kooniliseks pügatud põõsad, neist keskmise ümber hekk ja suured roosad õied. Pildi sügavusse suunduvast pargiteest vasakul sirges reas korrapäraseks pügatud põõsad, teest paremal suurele nelinurgale maalitud jupp maastikku kadakatega. Ruumi tagaseinas roheline mets, lael kujutatud pilvist taevast.
8808.de: A stage-set landscape: in the foreground on the left a flowerbed with bushes trimmed into cone shapes, around the middle one a hedge and large pink flowers. To the left of a park path leading into the depth of the picture, a straight row of regularly trimmed bushes; to the right of the path a fragment of landscape with junipers painted onto a large rectangle. In the rear wall of the space a green forest, on the ceiling a cloudy sky is depicted.

8809.dm: kõrgus: 80.0 cm; laius: 41.0 cm; laius: 41.0 cm; kõrgus: 80.0 cm
8809.d: Kahest osast koosnev kompositsioon: siniste, roheliste ja punaste draperiide taustal mänguasjad - kollaste juuste ja kleidiga nukk, punane kala, kollane ratastel lambatall, roheline ninasarvik ja lambipirn.
8809.de: A composition of two parts: against a background of blue, green and red draperies, toys - a doll with yellow hair and a dress, a red fish, a yellow sheep on wheels, a green rhinoceros and a light bulb.

8810.d: Koosneb kahest teineteise peale asetatud lõuendist. Ülemise ruudu allääre lähedal kauge, tumeda metsatriibuga silmapiir, kuhu koonduvad ähvardav hallikas-punakas toonis pragunenud maa taoline taevas ja erepunane, sinkjasvalgete lumelaikudega soomaastik, esiplaanil tumedad kõrkjad. Kaugemal, kahel pool pruunikas-hallid põõsapuhmad.
8810.de: Consists of two canvases placed one above the other. Near the lower edge of the upper square, a distant horizon with a dark strip of forest, where a threatening greyish-reddish, cracked-earth-like sky and a bright red bog landscape with bluish-white patches of snow converge, with dark sedges in the foreground. Further away, on both sides, brownish-grey clumps of bushes.

8811.d: Horisontaalsel keskjoonel traatvõrgust aed, millest tagapool üksteisesse sulavates rohelistes toonides puud ning leekivpunaste taimede viirg. Esiplaanil valge trepiaste punaste sulgjate taimetuttidega kahel pool. Astmest viib vertikaalsel keskjoonel asetsev autoratta jälgedega aiatee kaarvärava suunas. Aiatees kahel pool rohelised muruplatsid. Pildi ülaosas heleroheline akvarellilaadselt antud taevas.
8811.de: On the horizontal centre line a wire-mesh fence, behind which trees in blending green tones and a strip of flaming red plants. In the foreground a white step with tufts of red feather-like plants on both sides. From the step, along the vertical centre line, a garden path with car-wheel tracks leads toward an arched gate. On both sides of the garden path green lawns. In the upper part of the picture a light green, watercolour-like sky.

8871.d: Tumeda viiruna silmapiiril, lilla-rohekas vaikne meri üksiku valge kiviga paremas kuldlõikes ning roosaka leetseljakuga vasemas kuldlõikes ning paremal äärel. Esiplaanil taganenud veest paljastatud kollakas-roosakas-rohekas merepõhi üksikute lompide ja kividega, üleni kaetud teravate vesitaimedega. Vormitute rünkpilvedega helesinine taevas.
8871.de: A dark streak on the horizon, a purple-greenish calm sea with a lone white stone in the right golden section and a pinkish sandbank ridge in the left golden section and on the right edge. In the foreground, the sea floor exposed by the receded water, yellowish-pinkish-greenish, with occasional puddles and stones, entirely covered with sharp aquatic plants. Light blue sky with shapeless cumulus clouds.

8882.d: Neli roosasse rõivastatud olevust (kahel kollane, kahel lillakasroosa pea), igal punane vari selja taga, tumeroosa, ühe koroonanupuga koroonalaua ümber. Vasakpoolseim olevus löögiasendis, ülejäänutel sinakasrohelised kepid püsti peos. Mustade seinte ja tumepruuni põrandaga ruumi laes põleb rohelise lehtrikujulise kupliga lamp, vasakul ülal avaus õue, kust paistab pilves taevas.(eesti)
8882.de: Four beings dressed in pink (two with yellow heads, two with lilac-pink heads), each with a red shadow behind it, around a dark pink corona table with one corona knob. The leftmost being is in a striking pose, the others hold bluish-green sticks upright in their hands. In a room with black walls and a dark brown floor, a lamp with a green funnel-shaped shade burns on the ceiling, at the top left an opening to the outside, through which a cloudy sky can be seen.

8892.d: Keskosas, puude vahel suur rahvahulk, kelle kohal eredate laikudena loosungid. Kujutatu ümbritsetud alt ning külgedelt pruunides toonides laia ribaga.(eesti)
8892.de: In the middle section, among trees, a large crowd of people, above whom slogans stand out as bright patches. The depicted scene is surrounded from below and the sides by a wide band in brown tones.

8903.d: Kõrgete pruunides toonides raamaturiiulite vahel kolm tütarlast; üks pruunis kleidis seljaga, teine seelikus ja pluusis kolmveerandpöördes, näoga vaataja poole, kolmas vasemal kirjus kleidis, küljega. Taamal suur aken, millest paistavad puud ja stiliseeritud inimfiguurid. Keskel reas kaks perspektiivselt koonduvat tala, maas lillad vaibad. Ruumiliselt kogu pildi pinna ulatuses puuvõra.(eesti)
8903.de: Between tall bookshelves in brown tones three girls; one in a brown dress with her back turned, the second in a skirt and blouse in a three-quarter turn, face towards the viewer, the third on the left in a patterned dress, in profile. In the distance a large window, through which trees and stylised human figures can be seen. In the middle, in a row, two beams converging in perspective, on the floor purple carpets. Spatially, throughout the whole surface of the picture, a tree crown.

8904.d: Kompositsiooni keskel sõõrjas, vaataja poole liikuv grupp inimesi, kelledest igaüks on ülestõstetud käega. Esiplaanil, keskel naine ülestõstetud kätega, temast veidi espool, vasakul, üleskääritud käistega lillakasroosas pluusis, pilguga vaataja suunas ja paremal peaga profiilis paremal, noormees. Abstraksed värvilaigud fooniks, mis kohati toonivad ka figuure. Õrnhele värvigamma.(eesti)
8904.de: In the centre of the composition a circular group of people moving toward the viewer, each of whom has a raised hand. In the foreground, in the centre, a woman with raised hands, slightly in front of her, on the left, a young man in a purplish-pink blouse with rolled-up sleeves, gaze directed toward the viewer, and on the right, his head in profile facing right. Abstract patches of colour form the background, at places also tinting the figures. A delicately light colour range.

8905.d: Vaade aknast tuppa. Ees vasakul rohelisel aknalaual munajas pruunikates ja punakates toonies vaas, keskplaanil paremas kuldlõikes profiilis paremale kuklale kammitud juustega kahvatu naine kaelaehtega. Paremal mitmevärvilistes varjundites tume kardin. Tagaplaanil draperiid ning aknaraamistiku kujuliselt paigutatud geomeetrilised värvipinnad.(eesti)
8905.de: A view from a window into a room. In front on the left, on a green windowsill, an egg-shaped vase in brownish and reddish tones; in the middle ground, in profile in the golden section to the right, a pale woman with hair combed back to the nape, wearing a necklace. On the right a dark curtain in multi-coloured shades. In the background draperies and geometric colour surfaces arranged in the shape of a window frame.

8917.d: Pildi ülemises paremas osas rohekas tehasehoone suure, väikestest ruutudest koosneva aknaga. Selle ees seisab punane traktor, millest paremal esiplaanil viiest inimesest koosnev grupp. Esiplaanil vasakul seisva noormehe poolfiguur otsevaates, seljas punane pluus, peas roheline müts.  Maali pinnale on kruvidega kinnitatud üksikud puidust nikerdused, mis on kohati üle maalitud.(eesti)
8917.de: In the upper right part of the picture a greenish factory building with a large window made up of small squares. In front of it stands a red tractor, to the right of which, in the foreground, a group of five people. In the foreground on the left the half-figure of a young man in frontal view, wearing a red blouse, a green cap on his head. Individual wooden carvings are attached to the surface of the painting with screws, in places painted over.

8942.d: Pildi keskel kollases sviitris heledapäise tantsiva tütarlapse täisfiguur, ümbritsetud nelja tantsupaariga. Pildi allääres olevate tantsijate poosid ning ilmed staatilised; teised kaks paari kujutatud rütmilises liikumises. Koloriit särav; toonid kontrastsed.
8942.de: In the middle of the picture, the full figure of a fair-haired dancing girl in a yellow sweater, surrounded by four dancing couples. The poses and expressions of the dancers at the bottom edge of the picture are static; the other two couples are depicted in rhythmic movement. The coloring is bright; the tones are contrasting.

8954.d: Suvemaastik jämeda puuga vasakul. Puu all valge linaga kaetud ümar laud õunte ja klaaskannuga. Laua ääres, viini toolil istub heledas suvekleidis väike tüdruk poolpöördes vasakule, käed süles, jalad vaheliti rippu. Tema kõrval seisev tütarlaps otsevaates, parem käsi toetub tooli seljatoele. Taga paremal, puude vahel talumaja nurk. Rohekaspruun gamma, lühikeste peente pintslilöökidega maalilaad.
8954.de: A summer landscape with a thick tree on the left. Under the tree a round table covered with a white cloth, with apples and a glass jug. At the table, on a Vienna chair, sits a small girl in a light summer dress, half-turned to the left, hands in her lap, legs crossed and dangling. Beside her a standing girl in frontal view, right hand resting on the back of the chair. Behind on the right, between the trees, the corner of a farmhouse. Greenish-brown gamut, painting manner with short fine brushstrokes.

8955.d: Laual valge emaileeritud kann ja pruun pikakaelaline pudel. Nende ees leivapäts ning valgel riidel kaks sidrunit. Foon rohelistes-sinistes toonides.
8955.de: On the table a white enamelled jug and a brown long-necked bottle. In front of them a loaf of bread and two lemons on a white cloth. Background in green-blue tones.

8961.d: Rohelise lageda maastiku ja üksikute heledate pilvedega sinise taeva taustal kuldse vormitu ülakehaga ning ilma kaelata karmiinpunase sopilise peaga figuur. Näost hargnevad oranžid, kollased, pruunid, rohelised sopitaolised võsud. Tumepunased ebakorrapärasel paigutatud silmad hallide silmakoobastega.(eesti)
8961.de: Against a background of open green landscape and a blue sky with scattered light clouds, a figure with a golden, formless upper body and a crimson-red, lobed head without a neck. From the face branch orange, yellow, brown, green lobe-like shoots. Dark red irregularly placed eyes with grey eye sockets.

9000.d: Keskealise, kõhna kondise näoga mehe rinnaportree. Mehel seljas beez pluus, must, punaste triipudega kikilips ja valge pagarimüts. Foon sinakasroheline, keskjoonel kollaste aktsentidega.
9000.de: Chest-length portrait of a middle-aged man with a thin, bony face. The man is wearing a beige blouse, a black bow tie with red stripes and a white baker's cap. The background is bluish-green, with yellow accents along the centre line.

9033.d: Roosades ja lillades toonides mägede ning järve või lahesopi taustal seitse meeletus hoos ringi kappavat ratsanikku. Hobused enamasti tagajalgadel, ratsanikud erinevates kunstilistes poosides, nurgelised figuurid ja liigutused.
9033.de: In pink and lilac tones, against the background of mountains and a lake or bay, seven riders galloping around in frantic motion. The horses mostly on their hind legs, the riders in various artistic poses, angular figures and movements.

9057.d: Esiplaanil hele sadamakai ning raske sadamakraana, mille ees pruun vagun ning sügavsinine lossitav laev. Taamal Tallinna siluett, laevast paremal tõuseb eriti esile Oleviste kirik. Linna kohal kollaste ja siniste säpsivate pintslilöökidega antud taevas. Domineerivad sinised ja pruunid toonid.(eesti)
9057.de: In the foreground a light-coloured harbour quay and a heavy harbour crane, in front of it a brown wagon and a deep blue ship being unloaded. In the distance the silhouette of Tallinn, to the right of the ship the Oleviste Church stands out especially. Above the city a sky rendered with brisk yellow and blue brushstrokes. Blue and brown tones dominate.

9063.d: Perspektiivis kujutatud plangutaolise, vertikaalsete triipudega pinna taustal hõljuvad oranžikad, helesinised mügarjad kujundid, piiritletud tumeda kontuurjoonega. Paremal, pildi äärel mutrivõtmed, haamer jm. tööriistade kujutised.(eesti)
9063.de: Against a background depicting a plank-like surface with vertical stripes rendered in perspective, orange and light blue lumpy shapes float, delineated with a dark contour line. On the right, at the edge of the picture, depictions of wrenches, a hammer and other tools.

9064.d: Esiplaanil torude, purkide, vaaside, vana mööbli jms. ülekuhjatud tühermaa. Vasakul küngas, millel kasvab kollase-rohelisega maalitud puu. Teine, pikem puu on paigutatud paremasse serva. Parempoolse puu all vana mannerg. Äravisatud asjad hallikassinistes ja punastes toonides, nende kujutamisel on kohati kasutatud kangast. Künka taga horisontaalselt üle pildi pinna meri, künkast paremal puudega kaetud saar. Ülal rasketes kollastes, punastes ja sinistes toonides triibuline taevas.(eesti)
9064.de: In the foreground a wasteland overpiled with pipes, jars, vases, old furniture etc. On the left a hillock on which grows a tree painted in yellow-green. Another, taller tree is placed at the right edge. Under the tree on the right an old milk can. The discarded objects in greyish-blue and red tones, in their depiction fabric has been used in places. Behind the hillock, horizontally across the picture surface, the sea; to the right of the hillock an island covered with trees. Above, in heavy yellow, red and blue tones, a striped sky.

9065.d: Üksteisesse lõikuvate munajate vormide mass sinistes, punastes, lillades ja roosades toonides esiplaanil. Foonil tumesinine, ülaltpoolt helendav kosmiline ruum.
9065.de: A mass of intersecting egg-shaped forms in blue, red, lilac and pink tones in the foreground. In the background a dark blue, cosmic space glowing from above.

9066.d: Pruunides ning rohelistes toonides ebakorrapärastest pindadest kompositsioon. Paremal heledas toonis kolm geomeetrilist kujundit. Ülal keskel ning esiplaanil vasakul kaks kolletanud vahtralehte.
9066.de: A composition of irregular surfaces in brown and green tones. On the right, in a light tone, three geometric shapes. At the top centre and in the foreground on the left two yellowed maple leaves.

9152.d: Elusuuruses heledate pikkade juustega hallis kleidis noore naise põlvportree otsevaates (seisev figuur). Vasakus alumises nurgas viis kollast orhideed. Foon pruunides, ookri- ja rohelistes toonides, tihedate nähtavate pintslilöökidega läbi maalitud.
9152.de: Life-size knee-length portrait of a young woman with fair long hair in a grey dress, in frontal view (standing figure). In the lower left corner five yellow orchids. Background in brown, ochre and green tones, painted through with dense, visible brushstrokes.

9153.d: Helepruunide, veidi laines õlgadeni ulatuvate juustega, tugevate põsesarnadega, noore naise istuv kolmveerandfiguur. Seljas lühikeste varrukatega, ümara kaelusega sinakasroheline kleit. Käed vabalt süles.
9153.de: Seated three-quarter figure of a young woman with light-brown, slightly wavy shoulder-length hair and strong cheekbones. Wearing a bluish-green dress with short sleeves and a round collar. Hands resting loosely in her lap.

9155.d: Üleelusuuruses habemiku, kannatava ilmega trepil seisva paljasjalgse mehe figuur: seljas pruun mungarüü, süles suuri punaseid käsi meenutavad objektid. Paremas ülaservas, kaarjas ukseavas, millest paistab jupp kirgast ererohelist maastikku.(eesti)
9155.de: An over-life-size figure of a bearded, suffering-looking barefoot man standing on stairs: wearing a brown monk's robe, in his lap objects resembling large red hands. In the upper right corner, in an arched doorway, a glimpse of a bright green landscape.

9156.d: Groteskne stseen klounidega. Esiplaanil keskne figuur seisab paljajalu punasel alusel, pruunis riides, kroon peas, eest avatud kombinisoonist sirutub välja roosa olend inimkätega; parempoolne figuur ülestõstetud jalaga, vasakpoolne kasvatab tiritamme. Taga publik nagu pruunides maskides, helendavate silmaavadega.(eesti)
9156.de: A grotesque scene with clowns. In the foreground, a central figure stands barefoot on a red pedestal, dressed in brown, wearing a crown; from an open coverall in front, a pink creature with human hands protrudes; the figure on the right has a raised leg, the figure on the left is growing a dandelion. Behind them, an audience as if in brown masks with glowing eye openings.

9168.d: Kirjul foonil pruunikas, kõrge vaas mitut sorti aialilledega.(eesti)
9168.de: On a colourful background, a brownish, tall vase with several kinds of garden flowers.

9176.d: Keskealise, pikliku näoga mehe portree otsevaates. Tumedate juuste piir on otsmikult kahe kaarena taandunud prillid, hele särk, tumesinine lips pisut viltu. Foon hallikasroheline, kollaste helkidega.
9176.de: Portrait of a middle-aged man with an elongated face, in a frontal view. The hairline of dark hair has receded from the forehead in two arcs glasses, light shirt, dark blue tie slightly askew. Background greyish-green, with yellow highlights.

9185.d: Rohelistes toonids kompositsioon kahuritorude, püsside ja kiivrites sõduritega mererannal.(eesti)
9185.de: Composition in green tones with cannon barrels, rifles and soldiers in helmets on a seashore.

9189.d: Tumedas pruunikaspunases seinas, ülalt punane, alt roheline plekkradiaator, mille keskel valge pitsiline taskurätik monogrammidega "K" nurkades. Radiaatori kohal kolmest ruudukujulisest osast koosnev lai madal tumeroheliste raamidega aken. Sellest avanab vaade valgete postidega traatvõrkaiaga piiratud pargile. Keskel sinakas-punakas, ääres roheline ümmargune klump, väikeste pügatud põõsaste ning pargiteega läbi selle. Keskel kõrge, lopsakas eksootiline taim. Tara taga puisniit punakates ja pruunikasrohelistes toonides.
9189.de: In a dark brownish-red wall, a sheet-metal radiator, red at the top and green at the bottom, with a white lace handkerchief with monograms "K" in the corners in its middle. Above the radiator a wide low window with dark green frames, consisting of three square sections. From it opens a view of a park enclosed by a wire-mesh fence with white posts. In the centre a bluish-reddish, green-edged round clump, with small trimmed bushes and a park path running through it. In the centre a tall, lush exotic plant. Behind the fence a wooded meadow in reddish and brownish-green tones.

9211.d: Laua ääres istuvad kaks noort naist poolfiguuris, üks en face, teine profiilis ja vasakpoolse pildi servaga äralõigatud. Nende taga kolme mehe poolfiguurid, neist keskmine seljaga, teised kaks profiilis. Vasakpoolsel meesfiguuril habe.
9211.de: Two young women sit at a table, half-length, one en face, the other in profile and cut off by the left edge of the picture. Behind them, half-length figures of three men, the middle one with his back turned, the other two in profile. The male figure on the left has a beard.

9216.d: Vasakul valge draperii taustal roheline, korgiga klaaspudel. Paremal kaks kõrget, pruuni savipudelit. Nende ees valge kauss kahe roheka õunaga.
9216.de: On the left against a white drapery backdrop, a green glass bottle with a cork. On the right two tall, brown clay bottles. In front of them a white bowl with two greenish apples.

9218.d: Selgepiirilistest, dekoratiivsetest, geomeetrilistest kujunditest kompositsioon. Allosas kujutatud läbilõiget autobussist, juhi ja kolme reisijaga siluettidena, portreefiguuridena, profiilis vasakule. Ülal vasakul, hallis ruudus neli kollast inimese portreefiguuri siluetti, hallikas-rohekaid püramiide, mustal pinnal siniseid ringe. Keskel kaks vertikaalset, kaks korrapärastest ristkülikutest laotud tulpa. Paremal vasakpoolsete elementide kordusi.
9218.de: A composition of clearly outlined, decorative, geometric shapes. In the lower part, a cross-section of a bus is depicted, with the driver and three passengers shown as silhouettes, portrait figures, in profile facing left. Upper left, in a grey square, four yellow silhouette portrait figures of people, greyish-green pyramids, blue circles on a black surface. In the middle, two vertical columns built up of two regular rectangles each. On the right, repetitions of the elements on the left.

9219.d: Esiplaanil roosa näo ja nahka otsekui pragudena sisse lõigatud suu ja sinakasroheliste silmadega nägu, erkpunaste juuste ja pruuni kuuega, kaelas oranži värvi orgaaniline moodustis. Figuurist vasakul ja paremal õlgade kohal kaks punaste silmadega maski.(eesti)
9219.de: In the foreground a pink face with a mouth cut into the skin as if by cracks and bluish-green eyes, bright red hair and a brown coat, an orange organic formation on the neck. To the left and right of the figure, above the shoulders, two masks with red eyes.

9220.d: Ülevalt vaade rohetavate puudega väikesele pargile ja punakaspruunidele linnamajadele selle taustal. Vasakul torniga hoone, kiiver helesinise taeva foonil. Värelev maalilaad, lõuend kohati läbi kumamas.
9220.de: A view from above of a small park with greening trees and reddish-brown town houses in the background. On the left a building with a tower, its helmet against a light blue sky background. A shimmering painting style, the canvas showing through in places.

9236.d: Avar, üksikute mööbliesemete ja figuuridega täidetud ruum. Esiservas, heleda laua taga istuvad pruuni ja määrdunud kollast tooni figuurid. Neist vasakul, all nurgas, veinipunane, silindrikujuliste otsapatjadega diivan, roosa padi keskel. Ruumi tagaseinas, pruunis niššis kõrgete otstega helepruun voodi, milles kollase teki all pikutab roosa inimene. Nišši kõrval asuvast ukseavast on vaade kõrvalasuvasse ruumi. Ruumide seinad erinevates toonides punased.(eesti)
9236.de: A spacious room filled with a few pieces of furniture and figures. In the front edge, behind a light-coloured table, sit figures in brown and dirty yellow tones. To their left, in the lower corner, a wine-red sofa with cylindrical end cushions, a pink cushion in the middle. In the back wall of the room, in a brown niche, a light brown bed with tall ends, in which a pink person lies under a yellow blanket. From a doorway next to the niche there is a view into an adjacent room. The walls of the rooms are red in different tones.

9264.d: Esiplaanil viis nurgeliselt antud figuuri rinnatisel istumas: vasakult esimene on flööti puhuv mees siniste pükste ja pluusiga, teine pikas rohelises kleidis poolpikkade tumedate juustega naine aupaiste pea ümber, kolmas rohekassinises pikas kleidis naine istub valgel linal, süles valge õis, neljas sinises kleidis ja valge rätikuga naine on antud profiilis, viies naine on lühikeses sinises kleidis ja rätikus kaheharulist vilepilli puhumas. Foonil kitsad lahesopid ja sinakasroosad mäed.
9264.de: In the foreground, five figures given at angles, sitting on a parapet: the first from the left is a man playing a flute, in blue trousers and a blouse, the second a woman in a long green dress with shoulder-length dark hair and a halo around her head, the third a woman in a long greenish-blue dress sitting on a white cloth, with a white blossom in her lap, the fourth a woman in a blue dress and a white kerchief is given in profile, the fifth woman is in a short blue dress and kerchief, playing a double-piped whistle. In the background narrow bay inlets and bluish-pink mountains.

9268.d: Kunstnik istub punasel toolil kerges pöördes paremale. Pilk suunatud vaatajale, sigaretti hoidev käsi toetub põlvedele. Kunstnikul seljas veinipunane kuub, hallikassinine särk, tumedad püksid. Peas must barett, mille alt paistavad kõrvade juures terashallid juuksed. Selja taga ookerkollane sein, vasakul servas molbert puhta lõuendi või paberlehega.
9268.de: The artist sits on a red chair, slightly turned to the right. Gaze directed at the viewer, the hand holding a cigarette rests on the knees. The artist is wearing a wine-red coat, a greyish-blue shirt, dark trousers. On his head a black beret, from under which steel-grey hair shows near the ears. Behind him an ochre-yellow wall, on the left edge an easel with a blank canvas or sheet of paper.

9273.d: Esiplaanil kokamütsis ja valges põlles kondise näoga mehe poolfiguur. Seljas sinine pluus, prillid ees, käes vaheliti põlle all. Mehe selja taga kaaristu, foonil majad, lahesopp ja roosad mäed, kohati maalipind faktuurne (pahtli või noaga silumisjäljed).
9273.de: In the foreground, the half-figure of a bony-faced man in a chef's hat and white apron. Wearing a blue blouse, glasses on, hands crossed under the apron. Behind the man's back an arcade, in the background houses, a bay and pink mountains, in places the paint surface textured (traces of smoothing with putty knife or palette knife).

9294.d: Sürrealistlik rannamotiiv. Esiplaanil liival lebab akti poolfiguur. Sinakais-roosakais toonides naisaktist on näha lopsakate vormidega torso. Naise parema käe sõrmed hoiavad meresinise "rätiku" serva. Taamal pruunikas-sinises meres hulbib vasakul üksik kõrv.
9294.de: A surrealist beach motif. In the foreground, a half-figure nude lies on the sand. The female nude in bluish-pink tones shows a torso with lush forms. The fingers of the woman's right hand hold the edge of a sea-blue "kerchief". In the background, in a brownish-blue sea, a single ear floats on the left.

9316.d: Vanema mehe näopilt kerges pöördes paremale. Mehel tumedate raamidega prillid. Juustepiir laubal kahel pool taandunud, pikas kitsas näos ninast suuni pikad sügavad kortsud. Näoilme tõsine. Maalitud rohelistes, roosades ja kollastes toonides. Foon hallikasroheline, vasakus servas kollane.
9316.de: A facial portrait of an older man in a slight turn to the right. The man wears dark-framed glasses. The hairline receded on both sides of the forehead, in the long narrow face deep long wrinkles from nose to mouth. Serious facial expression. Painted in green, pink and yellow tones. Background greyish-green, yellow in the left edge.

9323.d: Esiplaanil all trepi ja roosakaspunaste rõdurinnatistega hoone osa. Rõdu külge on kinnitatud pikksilm. Rõdult avaneb vaade jääväljale, mille serva on kuhjunud jääpanku. Jääpankade ees inimeste grupid jääle kogunenud purjekaid jälgimas. Silmapiiri kohal romantiline helesinistes ja roosades toonides taevas, mõni murtud servaga pilvesagar.
9323.de: In the foreground below, part of a building with a staircase and pinkish-red balcony parapets. A telescope is attached to the balcony. From the balcony a view opens onto an ice field, at whose edge ice floes have piled up. In front of the ice floes, groups of people gathered on the ice watching sailing boats. Above the horizon a romantic sky in light blue and pink tones, with a few clouds with broken edges.

9335.d: Esiplaanil meri paatidega. Tagaplaanil tõusvale kaldaäärsele mäerinnakule tihedalt üksteise kõrvale ehitatud majad. Neist vasakul tagaplaanil mägi, ülal helesinine taevas. Maalitud sinistes, roosades ja kollastes toonides.
9335.de: In the foreground the sea with boats. In the background, densely built houses standing side by side on a rising mountain slope along the shore. To the left of them in the background a mountain, above a light blue sky. Painted in blue, pink and yellow tones.

9379.d: Ühest silmitust ja laialivalguva figuuriga ookrikarva naisest ja roosast, ühe silmaga mehest koosnev kompositsioon. Mõlema väljasirutatud käe pihus valge nelinurk. Roosa figuuri ees kolmest kaarest koosnev ehituskonstruktsioon. Vasakust servast sirutub pilti käsi. Foonil sipelgapesakujulised pruunid kuhilad, ülal erksinine taevas.(eesti)
9379.de: A composition consisting of an eyeless, dissolving-figured ochre-coloured woman and a pink, one-eyed man. Both have a white rectangle held in an outstretched hand's palm. In front of the pink figure a construction consisting of three arches. From the left edge a hand reaches into the picture. In the background brown mounds shaped like anthills, above them a bright blue sky.

9380.d: Esiplaanil, punasel, valge linaga kaetud pingil külitab roosa, priskete vormidega aktifiguur. Kõrgele tõstetud käest upitab suhu punast kirssi. Foonil vasakul sarlakpunane draperii, paremal ookrikarva, tõrjuvalt käed kokku pannud silmitu ja näotu figuur. Viimase selja taha jääva fooni osa taevasinine.(eesti)
9380.de: In the foreground, on a red bench covered with a white cloth, reclines a pink, plump-formed nude figure. From a raised hand she lifts a red cherry to her mouth. In the background on the left a scarlet-red drapery, on the right an ochre-coloured, eyeless and faceless figure with hands clasped together defensively. The part of the background behind the latter's back is sky-blue.

9400.d: Faktuursele aluspinnale pikkade pintslitõmmete ja selgelt eristavate värvipindadega maalitud vaikelu: keskpunktis kollane, sangaga anum, mille ees paremal pealtvaates kauss puuviljadega. Nõusid ümbritsevad igast küljest värviliste kaantega raamatud. Et värv pole kõiki pinnareljeefi õnarusi täitnud, kumab paiguti alt läbi hele krunt.
9400.de: A still life painted on a textured ground with long brushstrokes and clearly distinct areas of colour: in the centre a yellow vessel with a handle, in front of which, on the right, seen from above, a bowl with fruit. The vessels are surrounded on all sides by books with colourful covers. As the paint has not filled all the cavities of the surface relief, the light-coloured ground shines through in places.

9402.d: Keskplaanis pastelltoonides metsamassiiv. Esiplaanil kohati sulanud ja maa paljastanud lumi. Ülal sinine taevas. Maalitud tihedate, nähtavate pintslilöökidega.
9402.de: In the middle ground a forest massif in pastel tones. In the foreground, snow partly melted and revealing the ground. Above, blue sky. Painted with dense, visible brush strokes.

9419.d: Väikesel pruunil laual keraamiline vaas kimbu lillade, punaste ja oranzikate gladioolidega. Fooniks rohelistes - pruunides toonides pinnad.(eesti)
9419.de: On a small brown table a ceramic vase with a bunch of purple, red and orangey gladioli. Background surfaces in green-brown tones.

9420.d: Väike, ümaravormiline vaas sinistest, lillakatest ning oranžikaist väikeõielistest lilledest buketiga. Foon pruun.(eesti)
9420.de: A small, roundish vase with a bouquet of small blue, purplish and orangish flowers. Brown background.

9430.d: Punakas, vasakus servas siniste varjunditega taustal diagonaalselt üle kogu pildi pinna kaheharuline, valgete õitega kirsipuu oks.(eesti)
9430.de: Against a reddish background with bluish shades in the left margin, a two-branched cherry-tree bough with white blossoms diagonally across the entire picture surface.

9438.d: Vikerkaarevärviliste horisontaalsete, omavahel sulavate värviviirgudega (tumesinine, punane, kollane, helesinine, roheline, roosa) taeva foonil ning tumerohelises kollakasroheliste laikudega vees keskplaanil maali vasakust servast peaaegu parema servani ümarate liigendatud vormidega roheline laid, lillakasroosade värviaktsentidega põõsastikus, üksiku puuga. Paremas kuldlõikes ees vees jämedatüviline sihvakas, lopsaka krooniga puu. Pastoosne, faktuurne maalikäsitlus.(eesti)
9438.de: Against a sky background of rainbow-coloured horizontal, blending colour stripes (dark blue, red, yellow, light blue, green, pink) and in the middle ground in dark green water with yellowish-green patches, a green islet with rounded articulated forms stretching from the left edge of the painting almost to the right edge, with shrubbery in purplish-pink colour accents and a solitary tree. In the golden section on the right, in the foreground in the water, a slender tree with a thick trunk and lush crown. Pastose, textured painting technique.

9464.d: Pikemate juuste, kitsa näoga istuva noormehe poolfiguur poolpöördes vasakule, parem käsi põlvel, vasakus kõverdatud käes sigaret. Seljas sinine särk, tume pintsak, liivpruunid püksid. Taga vasakul osa aknast, selle ees rohekas lauanurk tumerohelise pokaaliga. Erksad värvitoonid, selgepiirilised vormid.
9464.de: A half-figure of a seated young man with longer hair and a narrow face, in a half-turn to the left, right hand on the knee, a cigarette in the bent left hand. Wearing a blue shirt, a dark jacket, sand-brown trousers. Behind on the left part of a window, in front of it a greenish table corner with a dark green goblet. Vivid colour tones, sharply defined forms.

9471.d: Hõõguvates soojades toonides panoraammaastik: esiplaanil punane küngas ja üksikud puutüved, kesk- ja tagaplaanil hoogsate pintslilöökidega antud küngastik ja tume, lehtedeta kevadine mets. Ülal kollane taevas.
9471.de: A panoramic landscape in glowing warm tones: in the foreground a red hillock and solitary tree trunks, in the middle and background a hilly terrain rendered with vigorous brushstrokes and a dark, leafless spring forest. Above, a yellow sky.

9478.d: Esiplaanil tumedal taustal poolviltu asendis klaviatuuriga muusikariist, selle taga musitseerib ovaalse deformeerunud inimnäo ja sopilise peaga kuju. Vasakul rombikujuliselt paigutatud neli figuuri, maskid ees, mille tagant paistavad sopilised pead. Kõik figuurid maalitud hõõguvpunastes, pruunides toonides.(eesti)
9478.de: In the foreground, against a dark background, a keyboard instrument set at an angle, behind which a figure with an oval, deformed human face and a hunched head is making music. On the left, four figures arranged in a rhombus, masks in front, from behind which hunched heads show. All figures are painted in glowing red and brown tones.

9479.d: Vasakul elektrisinise ja paremal punastes toonides, kollase käe siluetiga taustal roosades toonides maalitud üleelusuurune noormehe nägu, poolpöördes vasakule. Teineteisest kaugel asetsevate erksiniste silmade vaade suunatud vaatajale. Kollakaspruunide vuntside ning lõuahabeme vahelt paistavad täidlased huuled. Kõrva piiril punakaspruunid lainelised pinnad.(eesti)
9479.de: On the left in electric blue and on the right in red tones, against a background painted in pink tones with the silhouette of a yellow hand, an over-life-size face of a young man, in a half-turn to the left. The gaze of the bright blue eyes, set far apart, is directed at the viewer. Full lips show through between the yellowish-brown moustache and the chin beard. Reddish-brown wavy surfaces at the edge of the ear.

9480.d: Purpurroosal alusel ja madala horisondiga, alt punaka, läbi kollase ülal valgeks ja roosakaks muutuval foonil kaks sopiliste peadega abstraktset pooltorsot, vasemal tumedamas, paremal heledamas pruunis toonis. Nende vahel kaks ebamäärase kujuga vormi heldamas ja tumedamas punases toonis, millede ees lebab oranž käsi sidrunikollase sigaritaolise esemega sõrmede vahel.(eesti)
9480.de: On a purple-pink base with a low horizon, on a background reddish at the bottom, turning through yellow to white and pink at the top, two abstract half-torsos with lobed heads, the one on the left in a darker, the one on the right in a lighter brown tone. Between them two vaguely shaped forms in lighter and darker red tones, in front of which lies an orange hand with a lemon-yellow cigar-like object between the fingers.

9548.d: Kahvatubeežil taustal puuvõra-taoline abstraktsetest värvilistest pindadest kujund, kus domineerivad lillakashallid, roosad, sinised ja beežid toonid.
9548.de: Against a pale beige background a tree-crown-like shape formed of abstract coloured surfaces, in which purplish-grey, pink, blue and beige tones dominate.

9563.d: Lopsakas lõunamaine maastik: esiplaanil kirevad lilled, kollaste ja punaste õitega põõsad ja puud. Keskel telliskivikarva rannariba ja sügavsinine merelaht. Tagaplaanil vasakul mäed ja majad mäenõlvakul. Ülal helesinine taevas. Maalitud teravate, nähtavate pintslilöökidega.
9563.de: A lush southern landscape: in the foreground colourful flowers, bushes and trees with yellow and red blossoms. In the centre a brick-coloured shoreline and a deep blue sea bay. In the background on the left mountains and houses on a mountain slope. Above, a light blue sky. Painted with sharp, visible brushstrokes.

9616.d: Geomeetriliste värvipindade taustal ning neist moodustatud ruumiliste kujundite vahel grupp viiest inimesest, kellest kolm väljuvad osaliselt kehaga pildiväljast. Paremas kuldlõikes ees punasesse riietatud neiu kehaga en face, pea profiilis paremale. Tema taga pildivälja tsentris paljastatud ülakehaga noormees, seljaga vaataja poole, pea "profil perdu" vasakule. Paremal pildiäärel keskel sinises seelikus ja rohelises varrukateta pluusis neiu, käed vaheliti rinna ees, parem küünarnukk toetatud abstraktsele barjäärile. Kompositsiooni ülemises vasakus nurgas noormees abstraktse kuubi taga, küünarnukiga sellel toetuva püstitõstetud vasema käsivarrega; vasak käsivars lebab samal kuubil. Vasakus a
9616.de: Against a background of geometric colour surfaces and among the three-dimensional forms created by them, a group of five people, three of whom partly extend their bodies out of the picture field. In the right golden section, in front, a girl dressed in red, body en face, head in profile to the right. Behind her, in the centre of the picture field, a young man with a bared upper body, back to the viewer, head in "profil perdu" to the left. On the right edge of the picture, in the middle, a girl in a blue skirt and a green sleeveless blouse, arms crossed in front of her chest, right elbow resting on an abstract barrier. In the upper left corner of the composition, a young man behind an abstract cube, with his elbow resting on it and his raised left arm; the left arm lies on the same cube. On the left

9635.d: Prillidega vana mehe istuv kolmveerandfiguur, pöördes paremale. Parem käsi lebab tooli käetoel, parem jalg tõstetud üle põlve. Peas must barett.
9635.de: A sitting three-quarter figure of an old man with glasses, turned to the right. Right hand resting on the armrest of the chair, right leg raised over the knee. Black beret on his head.

9637.d: Kahel kolmandikul pildipinnast heledates toonides rohtunud liivakünkad. Nende taga, silmapiiril tume riba.
9637.de: On two-thirds of the picture surface, light-toned grassy sand dunes. Behind them, on the horizon, a dark strip.

9648.d: Roosakaslillades ja tumerohelistes toonides metsamassiiv. Esiplaanil kollakasrohelise kuluga maapind, ülal valkjashall taevas. Maalitud pikemate, selgelt eristuvate pintslilöökidega.
9648.de: A forest mass in pinkish-purple and dark green tones. In the foreground ground with yellowish-green dry grass, above a whitish-gray sky. Painted with longer, clearly distinguishable brushstrokes.

9649.d: Esiplaanil noore jumeka tütarlapse põlvportree: pikad lahtised juuksed, vasak labakäsi toetab paremat käsivart - istub toolil ja loeb paksu raamatut. Paremal vaas mitmesuguste taimedega. Tütarlapse pea kohal aken, mis katab üle poole pildi pinnast ja sealt avaneb vaade Tallinna majadele, nii et keskele jääb Toompea torn. Maalitud kollakas-pruunis gammas.
9649.de: In the foreground, a knee-length portrait of a young rosy-cheeked girl: long loose hair, her left hand supports her right forearm - she sits on a chair and reads a thick book. On the right a vase with various plants. Above the girl's head a window, which covers more than half of the picture surface, and from there opens a view of Tallinn's houses, so that Toompea Tower is in the centre. Painted in a yellowish-brown range.

9650.d: Pastelsetes toonides kahefiguuriline kompositsioon suvise looduse taustal. Paremal esiplaanil profiilis, pea poolprofiilis vasemale istub maali keskel ees asetseva valge linaga kaetud väikese laua ääres peadligi liibuvate tumedate juustega, hingestatud tumedate silmadega, tundelise suuga poiss oranžis lühikeste käistega pluusis, käes vabalt laual, paremas käes roheline õun. Laual taldrik kahe õunaga, ees paremal punetav õun. Esiplaanil kompositsiooni vasakul äärel istub en face, kerges pöördes paremale pikkade vabalt langevate juustega lugev noor neiu siniseruudulises pikkade käistega pluusis ja beežides pikkades pükstes. Tagaplaanil lehtpuusalu, vasakul üksiku taljumajaga. Vasakus kuldlõike
9650.de: A two-figure composition in pastel tones against a background of summer nature. In the foreground on the right, in profile, head in half profile to the left, sits a boy with dark hair closely framing his head, soulful dark eyes and a sensitive mouth, wearing an orange short-sleeved blouse, at a small table in the middle of the painting covered with a white cloth, his hand resting loosely on the table, a green apple in his right hand. On the table a plate with two apples, in front on the right a reddening apple. In the foreground, at the left edge of the composition, a young girl with long, loosely falling hair sits en face, slightly turned to the right, reading, wearing a blue-checked long-sleeved blouse and beige long trousers. In the background a grove of deciduous trees, on the left a single house with a hipped roof. In the left golden section

9655.d: Esiplaanil üleni kollane, mokahabeme, pikkade teravate otstega vurrude ja punaste silmadega mees üle õla vaataja poole vaatamas. Fooniks tühi tumepruun ruum, mille kaarjast väljapääsust paistab jupp maastikku. All vasakus nurgas lillakaspruun kolme punase triibu ja punase ovaaliga (silmaga?) kujund (olend?).(eesti)
9655.de: In the foreground, an entirely yellow man with a moustache-beard, long sharp-tipped whiskers and red eyes, looking over his shoulder at the viewer. The background is an empty dark brown room, through whose arched exit a piece of landscape can be seen. In the lower left corner a purplish-brown shape (creature?) with three red stripes and a red oval (an eye?).

9659.d: Esiplaanil peegelsile jõgi, kallastel tihe võsa. Paremal kaldal kaks inimfiguuri.
9659.de: In the foreground a mirror-smooth river, dense scrub on the banks. On the right bank two human figures.

9662.d: Pildi keskosas valge, kitsa raamiga piiratud ruumis kolm figuuri, kaks istuvad malelaua taga, kolma seisab. Pildi servades kahel pool malendeid meenutavad kujundid, allservas kaks liivakella, ülaservas raami kohal kroon.(eesti)
9662.de: In the middle of the picture, in a space bordered by a narrow white frame, three figures, two seated at a chess table, a third standing. On both sides of the picture's edges, shapes resembling chess pieces, at the bottom two hourglasses, at the top above the frame a crown.

9675.d: Käänuliste teedega maastiku taustal tumedajuukselise keskealise mehe istuv kolmveerandfiguur, käed kokkupandult süles. Näos tugevad kortsud, seljas nahkjopp, mille läikivat materjali on edasi antud.(eesti)
9675.de: Against the background of a landscape with winding roads, a sitting three-quarter figure of a dark-haired middle-aged man, hands clasped in his lap. Strong wrinkles on his face, wearing a leather jacket, the shiny material of which is rendered.

9688.d: Helesinises, kollaste, punaste ja lillade horisontaalviirgudega vees keskplaanil vasemast servast keskpaigani kahe teravatipulise koonilise võraga puuga (vasemal) lopsaka taimestikuga laid. Selle taga tagaplaanil paremas kuldlõikes teine laid. Pruunikas-punane taevas paremal kollakate, lillakate ja punaste pastoossete ristjoontega pilv. Faktuurne maalikäsitlus.(eesti)
9688.de: In light blue water with yellow, red, and purple horizontal streaks, in the middle ground from the left edge to the middle, an islet with lush vegetation and a tree with a sharp-tipped conical crown (on the left), two such trees. Behind it in the background, in the right golden section, another islet. The brownish-red sky on the right with a cloud of yellowish, purplish, and red pastose cross-hatching. Textured painting technique.

9689.d: Paremal servas kogu pildipinna suuruses rõhutatud kontuuriga maalitud mehefiguur. Vasakul veel neli mehefiguuri. Tagaplaanil auto ja meri. Maas suured teokarbid.(eesti)
9689.de: On the right edge, a male figure painted with emphasised contour, the size of the entire picture surface. On the left, four more male figures. In the background a car and the sea. On the ground, large conch shells.

9723.d: Pildi pind jaotatud vertikaalselt kaheks musta pinnaga, mida läbib pikuti hele triip. Vasakul sinise ning punase horisontaaljoonega lõhestatud roheline kvadraat; paremal ülal tumedast, rohelise ringiga lõppevast diagonaaljoonest läbistatud punane, all kollane nelinurk. Kogu töö pinnal kahes suuruses punased, mustad, kollased, sinised, rohelised ja pruunid ringid. Puhtad lokaaltoonid; ühtlane maalipind. Üldmulje dekoratiivne.
